quad-sets.name: Quad Sets
quad-sets.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your legs extended flat on the floor. Place a rolled towel under your knee for support.
quad-sets.endPoseDescription: Tighten your quadriceps muscle by straightening your knee completely, lifting your heel slightly off the ground. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds while keeping your leg straight.

straight-leg-raises.name: Straight Leg Raises
straight-leg-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg bent and one leg extended flat on the floor. Keep your extended leg straight with your quadriceps engaged.
straight-leg-raises.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your straight leg to about 12 inches off the ground, maintaining a locked knee position. Lower the leg back down without relaxing the quadriceps.

hamstring-curls-machine.name: Hamstring Curls on Machine
hamstring-curls-machine.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the hamstring curl machine with your knees just below the pad edge and ankles under the lever. Your hips should be flat against the bench.
hamstring-curls-machine.endPoseDescription: Curl your legs upward by bending your knees, bringing your heels toward your glutes. Stop just short of a 90-degree bend and squeeze your hamstrings at the top.

mini-squats.name: Mini Squats
mini-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, hands on a stable surface or in front of you for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
mini-squats.endPoseDescription: Bend your knees to approximately 30-45 degrees, as if sitting into a chair slightly. Keep your weight in your heels and return to starting position.

step-ups.name: Step-Ups
step-ups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a low step (4-6 inches high) with feet hip-width apart. Place one foot firmly on the step with your weight evenly distributed.
step-ups.endPoseDescription: Push through your front heel to step up, bringing your back leg onto the step so you're standing upright on the platform. Step down backwards and repeat.

single-leg-balance.name: Single Leg Balance
single-leg-balance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your feet together and hands available to touch a wall for safety if needed. Engage your core and look straight ahead.
single-leg-balance.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground with knee bent to 90 degrees, balancing on your opposite leg. Maintain an upright posture and steady gaze for 20-30 seconds.

knee-extension-resistance-band.name: Knee Extension with Resistance Band
knee-extension-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit on a bench or chair with a resistance band looped around your foot and held in your hands. Keep your back against the support with your leg slightly bent.
knee-extension-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Straighten your knee fully against the band resistance, extending your leg forward completely. Hold briefly at full extension, then slowly return to the bent starting position.

calf-raises.name: Calf Raises
calf-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, hands resting on a support bar or wall for light balance assistance. Keep your core engaged and posture tall.
calf-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as comfortably possible. Pause at the top before lowering your heels back down.

knee-flexion-stretch.name: Knee Flexion Stretch
knee-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your back flat and relaxed against the ground.
knee-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly bring one knee toward your chest, using your hands to gently pull your thigh closer to your body. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds while keeping your lower back relaxed.

stationary-bike.name: Stationary Bike
stationary-bike.startPoseDescription: Sit on the stationary bike seat with your back upright and hands on the handlebars. Adjust the seat height so your knee has a slight bend at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
stationary-bike.endPoseDescription: Pedal smoothly at a moderate pace with controlled movements, maintaining an upright posture. Focus on smooth, pain-free circular motions through the full range available.

hamstring-curls-band.name: Hamstring Curls with Resistance Band
hamstring-curls-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and loop a resistance band around both feet while holding the band ends for stability. Keep a slight bend in both knees.
hamstring-curls-band.endPoseDescription: Bend the knee of the affected leg, pulling your heel toward your glute against the band resistance. Return to starting position with controlled movement.

clamshells-band.name: Clamshells with Resistance Band
clamshells-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with both knees bent at 45 degrees and a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together.
clamshells-band.endPoseDescription: Open the top knee upward against the band resistance while keeping feet touching. Return to starting position with controlled movement.

glute-bridges.name: Glute Bridges
glute-bridges.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep arms at your sides with palms down.
glute-bridges.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower back down.

hip-abduction-band.name: Hip Abduction with Resistance Band
hip-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep a slight bend in both knees for stability.
hip-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Step the affected leg out to the side against the band resistance, maintaining an upright posture. Return to starting position with controlled movement.

quad-stretch.name: Quadriceps Stretch
quad-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on one leg with good balance, using a wall or chair for support if needed. Keep your core engaged.
quad-stretch.endPoseDescription: Bend the opposite knee and gently pull your foot toward your glute using a resistance band or your hand. Feel a stretch along the front of the thigh and hold.

hamstring-stretch.name: Hamstring Stretch
hamstring-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg extended on the floor and loop a resistance band around the foot of the opposite leg. Keep that leg straight.
hamstring-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the banded leg toward your chest using the band, creating a stretch along the back of the thigh. Keep the extended leg relaxed on the floor.

lateral-band-walks.name: Lateral Band Walks
lateral-band-walks.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees in a quarter-squat position. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
lateral-band-walks.endPoseDescription: Step the affected leg out to the side against the band resistance, then bring the other leg to meet it. Maintain tension in the band throughout the movement.

clamshells.name: Clamshells
clamshells.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, feet together, and head resting on your lower arm. Keep your bottom leg on the floor for stability.
clamshells.endPoseDescription: Keeping feet together, open your top knee upward like a clamshell opening, lifting it as high as comfortable. Return to starting position without moving the feet apart.

quadriceps-stretch.name: Quadriceps Stretch
quadriceps-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright next to a wall or chair for balance, with weight evenly distributed on both feet. Look straight ahead with good posture.
quadriceps-stretch.endPoseDescription: Bend one knee and gently pull your foot toward your buttock using your hand, feeling a stretch along the front of the thigh. Keep knees aligned and maintain an upright posture.

hip-flexor-stretch.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a staggered stance with one leg forward and one leg back, hands on hips or on a chair for balance. Keep your upper body upright and core engaged.
hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lunge forward into the front leg, dropping your hips forward and slightly down while keeping your back heel grounded. Feel a stretch along the front of the back hip and thigh.

seated-knee-extensions.name: Seated Knee Extensions
seated-knee-extensions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with back support, feet flat on the floor and knees at 90 degrees. Engage your core to maintain good posture.
seated-knee-extensions.endPoseDescription: Straighten one leg fully by extending the knee, tightening the thigh muscle as you lift the foot slightly off the ground. Hold for 1-2 seconds at full extension before lowering.

step-ups-low.name: Step-Ups (Low Step)
step-ups-low.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a low step, curb, or bottom stair (2-4 inches high) with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Maintain upright posture with shoulders back.
step-ups-low.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the low surface with one leg, pressing through the heel and straightening the knee fully. Step back down with control and alternate legs in a controlled manner.

single-leg-glute-bridge-dumbbell.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges with Dumbbell
single-leg-glute-bridge-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the ground, the other leg extended straight up. Hold a dumbbell across your hips with both hands.
single-leg-glute-bridge-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Drive through your planted foot to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knee to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top before lowering back down.

it-band-foam-roll-stretch.name: IT Band Foam Roll Stretch
it-band-foam-roll-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit on the ground and position a foam roller under your right hip, with your right leg extended over the roller. Support yourself with your hands behind you.
it-band-foam-roll-stretch.endPoseDescription: Roll your body weight forward and backward along the IT band from hip to just above the knee, pausing on tender points for 20-30 seconds.

lateral-band-walks-dumbbell.name: Lateral Band Walks with Dumbbell
lateral-band-walks-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent. Maintain an upright torso throughout the movement.
lateral-band-walks-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Take a controlled step to the side, maintaining your knee bend and keeping tension in your glutes. Step back to center and repeat in the same direction for all reps before switching sides.

pigeon-pose-stretch.name: Pigeon Pose Stretch
pigeon-pose-stretch.startPoseDescription: Start in a tabletop position with hands directly under shoulders and knees under hips. Bring your right knee forward toward your right wrist, flexing the hip.
pigeon-pose-stretch.endPoseDescription: Lower your torso forward over your right leg, keeping your hips square to the ground. Hold this deep stretch feeling the external rotators and IT band lengthen.

monster-walks-dumbbell.name: Monster Walks with Dumbbell
monster-walks-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand holding a dumbbell at chest height with feet hip-width apart and knees bent slightly in a quarter-squat position. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
monster-walks-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Step forward and outward at a 45-degree angle with your right foot, then bring your left foot to meet it. Continue walking forward in this diagonal pattern while maintaining the quarter-squat position.

glute-kickbacks-dumbbell.name: Glute Kickbacks with Dumbbell
glute-kickbacks-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Start in a tabletop position with a dumbbell resting in the crease of your right knee. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral throughout.
glute-kickbacks-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Drive your right leg backward and upward, extending your hip while keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees. Squeeze your glute at the top before returning to start position.

lateral-lunge-dumbbell.name: Lateral Lunge with Dumbbell
lateral-lunge-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet together holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands. Maintain an upright torso and engaged core.
lateral-lunge-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Step your right foot out to the side, shifting your weight onto that leg and lowering into a deep lateral lunge. Keep your left leg straight and return to standing by pushing through your right heel.

supine-figure-4-stretch.name: Supine Figure-4 Stretch
supine-figure-4-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross your right ankle over your left thigh just above the knee.
supine-figure-4-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your left thigh toward your chest, keeping your head and shoulders relaxed on the ground. Feel the stretch in your right hip and external rotators.

eccentric-hamstring-curls.name: Eccentric Hamstring Curls
eccentric-hamstring-curls.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or stability ball with legs extended and toes pointed toward the floor. Place hands by your sides for light support.
eccentric-hamstring-curls.endPoseDescription: Bend both knees to bring heels toward glutes, then use both legs to extend back. Slowly lower yourself using only the affected leg over 3-4 seconds.

quad-stretches.name: Quad Stretches
quad-stretches.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, using a wall or gym equipment for balance. Bring one heel toward your glutes.
quad-stretches.endPoseDescription: Hold your ankle and gently pull the heel further toward your buttocks, feeling a stretch across the front of the thigh. Maintain an upright posture without arching your lower back.

patellar-tendon-stretches.name: Patellar Tendon Stretches
patellar-tendon-stretches.startPoseDescription: Kneel on a soft mat with your toes tucked under and hips positioned over your knees. Place hands on the floor in front of you for light support.
patellar-tendon-stretches.endPoseDescription: Slowly shift your hips backward and downward, feeling a stretch along the front of the shin and patellar tendon. Hold the stretch without forcing excessive tension.

wall-sits.name: Wall Sits
wall-sits.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall and feet hip-width apart, positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Keep your arms at your sides or crossed over your chest.
wall-sits.endPoseDescription: Slide down the wall until your knees form a 90-degree angle, keeping your back flat against the wall. Hold this position while maintaining steady breathing.

resistance-band-knee-extensions.name: Resistance Band Knee Extensions
resistance-band-knee-extensions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your back against the backrest. Loop a resistance band around your thigh just above the knee and anchor it under your foot or to a stable object.
resistance-band-knee-extensions.endPoseDescription: Straighten your leg against the band resistance, extending the knee fully. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

resistance-band-hip-abduction.name: Resistance Band Hip Abduction
resistance-band-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Maintain a slight bend in both knees and keep your chest upright.
resistance-band-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Step laterally to one side, keeping tension on the band throughout the movement. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

hamstring-sets.name: Hamstring Sets
hamstring-sets.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your affected leg relaxed.
hamstring-sets.endPoseDescription: Bend the affected knee slightly and press the back of the knee down into the floor, tightening the hamstring muscle. Hold the contraction for 5 seconds without moving.

seated-knee-extension.name: Seated Knee Extension
seated-knee-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit in a firm chair with your back against the backrest and both feet flat on the floor. Keep your affected leg relaxed.
seated-knee-extension.endPoseDescription: Straighten the affected leg by tightening the thigh muscle and extending the knee fully. Hold for 2-3 seconds at the top before slowly lowering back down.

calf-stretches.name: Calf Stretches
calf-stretches.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with your hands placed on the wall at shoulder height for balance. Step the affected leg back about 12 inches.
calf-stretches.endPoseDescription: Keep the back heel on the ground and gently lean toward the wall, bending the front knee. Feel a gentle stretch in the calf of the back leg and hold for 30 seconds.

hamstring-stretches.name: Hamstring Stretches
hamstring-stretches.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your unaffected leg flat and relaxed.
hamstring-stretches.endPoseDescription: Slowly pull the affected leg toward your chest by grasping behind the thigh with both hands, keeping the knee slightly bent. Hold the gentle stretch for 30 seconds.

seated-marching.name: Seated Marching
seated-marching.startPoseDescription: Sit in a firm chair with your back against the backrest and both feet flat on the floor. Keep your posture upright and relaxed.
seated-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift the affected knee up toward the chest in a marching motion while keeping the other foot on the floor. Lower back down and repeat in a controlled, rhythmic manner.

standing-balance.name: Standing Balance
standing-balance.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart next to a counter or wall for support, with fingertips lightly touching for safety. Distribute your weight evenly on both feet.
standing-balance.endPoseDescription: Shift more weight onto the affected leg while maintaining light contact with the counter or wall. Hold for 20-30 seconds, building confidence and stability.

glute-squeezes.name: Glute Squeezes
glute-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned about hip-width apart. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides.
glute-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the buttock muscles tightly, holding the contraction as if preventing something from passing. Hold for 5 seconds while maintaining normal breathing before releasing.

supine-quad-sets.name: Supine Quad Sets
supine-quad-sets.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Place a small towel roll under the knee of the affected leg.
supine-quad-sets.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on the front of the thigh, straightening the knee and lifting the heel slightly off the floor. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds.

supine-hamstring-curls.name: Supine Hamstring Curls
supine-hamstring-curls.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep the affected leg in a comfortable position.
supine-hamstring-curls.endPoseDescription: Slide the heel of the affected leg toward the buttock, bending the knee fully while keeping the foot on the floor. Return to starting position.

standing-hip-abduction-dumbbell.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Dumbbell
standing-hip-abduction-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine.
standing-hip-abduction-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Raise the leg on the opposite side of the dumbbell out to the side, keeping the knee slightly bent and torso upright. Lower back to starting position with control.

standing-calf-raises.name: Standing Calf Raises
standing-calf-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides for balance and support. Keep your weight distributed evenly between both feet.
standing-calf-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining an upright torso. Lower back down with control.

supine-hip-bridges.name: Supine Hip Bridges
supine-hip-bridges.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep the affected leg in a comfortable, supported position.
supine-hip-bridges.endPoseDescription: Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Hold briefly and lower back down.

standing-figure-four-stretch.name: Standing Figure-Four Stretch
standing-figure-four-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and place one hand on a wall or chair for balance. Cross the affected leg over the opposite thigh, creating a figure-four shape.
standing-figure-four-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lean forward, feeling a stretch in the outer hip and glute of the crossed leg. Maintain an upright chest and avoid rounding the spine.

supine-hamstring-stretch.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
supine-hamstring-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep the unaffected leg flat and relaxed.
supine-hamstring-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lift the affected leg and draw the knee toward the chest, feeling a stretch along the back of the thigh. Keep the lower back pressed to the floor.

dumbbell-step-ups.name: Dumbbell Step-Ups
dumbbell-step-ups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a low step or bench, holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
dumbbell-step-ups.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the bench with the unaffected leg first, then bring the affected leg up to meet it. Step back down with control, leading with the affected leg.

hamstring-curls.name: Hamstring Curls
hamstring-curls.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with your legs extended and your knees just off the edge of the bench. Keep your core engaged and head neutral.
hamstring-curls.endPoseDescription: Bend both knees and curl your heels toward your glutes, lifting your lower legs upward. Squeeze the hamstrings at the top of the movement.

calf-stretch.name: Calf Stretch
calf-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with your hands on the wall at shoulder height. Step one leg back, keeping the heel on the ground.
calf-stretch.endPoseDescription: Lean forward into the wall, keeping the back leg straight and heel down. Feel the stretch in the calf of the back leg.

resistance-band-lateral-walks.name: Resistance Band Lateral Walks
resistance-band-lateral-walks.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain a slight bend in your knees and a neutral spine.
resistance-band-lateral-walks.endPoseDescription: Step sideways, maintaining tension in the band and keeping your chest upright. Return to center and repeat in the opposite direction.

quadriceps-stretch-with-band.name: Quadriceps Stretch with Band
quadriceps-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and place a resistance band around one foot. Hold both ends of the band with your hands at chest height.
quadriceps-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band to bring your heel toward your glutes, feeling a stretch along the front of the thigh. Keep your knees parallel and avoid arching your lower back.

hamstring-stretch-with-band.name: Hamstring Stretch with Band
hamstring-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg bent and one leg extended. Loop a resistance band around the foot of the extended leg.
hamstring-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your torso to straighten the leg and deepen the hamstring stretch. Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.

clamshells-with-band.name: Clamshells with Band
clamshells-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent to 45 degrees and a resistance band looped around your thighs. Keep your feet together and your core engaged.
clamshells-with-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your top knee upward, opening your leg like a clamshell while keeping your feet together. Return to start position and repeat.

step-ups-with-band.name: Step-Ups with Band
step-ups-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a low step or bench with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain upright posture and engage your core.
step-ups-with-band.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the bench leading with one leg while maintaining band tension. Step down slowly and repeat, then switch legs.

hip-abduction-with-band.name: Hip Abduction with Band
hip-abduction-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with legs extended and a resistance band looped around both thighs. Keep your torso stable and your lower leg as a base.
hip-abduction-with-band.endPoseDescription: Lift your top leg upward against the band resistance, maintaining a straight alignment. Lower down without touching your legs together and repeat.

pendulum-circles.name: Pendulum Circles
pendulum-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and lean forward slightly, supporting your body with your uninvolved arm on a table or chair. Let your affected arm hang straight down toward the floor in a relaxed position.
pendulum-circles.endPoseDescription: Using gentle momentum from your torso, swing your hanging arm in small circles, gradually increasing the circle size. Continue the circular motion smoothly for 30-60 seconds in both directions.

supine-shoulder-flexion.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion
supine-shoulder-flexion.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a firm surface with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your core engaged and press your lower back gently into the surface.
supine-shoulder-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide both arms overhead along the surface, moving them toward the floor above your head as far as comfortable without pain. Return to the starting position and repeat.

sleeper-stretch.name: Sleeper Stretch
sleeper-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side on a firm surface with the affected shoulder on top. Bend your affected arm to 90 degrees with your elbow at shoulder level and your forearm pointing away from your body.
sleeper-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your other hand to gently press the back of your affected arm toward the floor, creating a stretch across the back of your shoulder. Hold this position for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

scapular-squeeze.name: Scapular Squeeze
scapular-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Stand with good posture, arms at your sides with elbows bent to 90 degrees and forearms pointing forward. Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.
scapular-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down, pulling your elbows back slightly while maintaining the 90-degree bend. Hold for 2-3 seconds, feeling the contraction in your mid-back, then relax.

prone-shoulder-iyt.name: Prone Shoulder I-Y-T
prone-shoulder-iyt.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a firm surface with a small pillow under your forehead to keep your neck neutral. Let both arms rest alongside your body with palms facing down.
prone-shoulder-iyt.endPoseDescription: Lift both arms off the surface in sequence forming an 'I' (arms overhead), then a 'Y' (arms at 45 degrees), then a 'T' (arms out to sides). Return to starting position and repeat, holding each position for 1-2 seconds.

doorway-chest-stretch.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
doorway-chest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your affected arm raised to 90 degrees, elbow bent, and your forearm against the door frame. Step one foot forward into a slight lunge position.
doorway-chest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lean your body forward through the doorway, feeling a stretch across your chest and front shoulder. Maintain the stretch for 20-30 seconds while keeping your core engaged.

isometric-shoulder-activation.name: Isometric Shoulder Activation
isometric-shoulder-activation.startPoseDescription: Stand with your arms at your sides and elbows bent to 90 degrees, forearms pointing forward. Place your other hand against the palm of your affected arm.
isometric-shoulder-activation.endPoseDescription: Press your affected arm forward against the resistance of your other hand without allowing any movement. Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds, then relax and repeat 10 times.

wall-slide.name: Wall Slide
wall-slide.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet 6 inches away, with your arms at shoulder height and elbows bent to 90 degrees against the wall. Keep your lower back pressed against the wall.
wall-slide.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your arms upward along the wall toward overhead, maintaining contact with the wall throughout the movement. Slide back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.

quadruped-shoulder-taps.name: Quadruped Shoulder Taps
quadruped-shoulder-taps.startPoseDescription: Get on your hands and knees with hands directly under shoulders and knees under hips. Engage your core and keep your spine neutral, looking down at the floor.
quadruped-shoulder-taps.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, maintaining balance and stability through your core. Return to starting position and alternate sides, performing 8-10 taps per side.

supine-shoulder-flexion-dumbbell.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Light Dumbbell
supine-shoulder-flexion-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell (2-3 lbs) in your affected hand with your arm at your side, elbow slightly bent.
supine-shoulder-flexion-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise the dumbbell overhead in a controlled arc, moving only at the shoulder joint. Stop at a comfortable range that does not cause pain, typically around 90 degrees of shoulder flexion.

supine-external-rotation-dumbbell.name: Supine External Rotation with Dumbbell
supine-external-rotation-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Hold a light dumbbell in your hand with your forearm perpendicular to your body.
supine-external-rotation-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm upward toward the floor above your head, moving only at the shoulder's external rotators. Keep your elbow fixed at 90 degrees and stop at a comfortable range without pain.
conditions_seen_in: post rotator cuff repair (6 weeks post-op)

prone-shoulder-abduction-dumbbell.name: Prone Shoulder Abduction (Dumbbell)
prone-shoulder-abduction-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or inclined surface with your affected arm hanging down toward the floor. Hold a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your arm in a neutral position.
prone-shoulder-abduction-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbell out to the side, lifting your arm to shoulder height in an abduction motion. Keep your elbow slightly bent and move slowly with control, avoiding momentum.
conditions_seen_in: post rotator cuff repair (6 weeks post-op)

seated-shoulder-shrugs-dumbbell.name: Seated Shoulder Shrugs with Dumbbell
seated-shoulder-shrugs-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and shoulders in a neutral, relaxed position.
seated-shoulder-shrugs-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Elevate both shoulders toward your ears by contracting your trapezius muscles. Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly back to the starting position with control.
conditions_seen_in: post rotator cuff repair (6 weeks post-op)

quadruped-shoulder-stability.name: Quadruped Shoulder Stability (Modified)
quadruped-shoulder-stability.startPoseDescription: Get on your hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral with your head aligned with your spine.
quadruped-shoulder-stability.endPoseDescription: Gently shift your weight forward and backward while maintaining stability in your shoulders. This controlled movement builds dynamic stability without excessive load on the healing rotator cuff.
conditions_seen_in: post rotator cuff repair (6 weeks post-op)

standing-posterior-shoulder-stretch.name: Standing Posterior Shoulder Stretch
standing-posterior-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Use your unaffected hand to gently grasp your affected arm just above the elbow.
standing-posterior-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Pull your affected arm across your body toward your opposite shoulder, feeling a gentle stretch in the posterior shoulder and rotator cuff. Hold this stretch without bouncing for 20-30 seconds.
conditions_seen_in: post rotator cuff repair (6 weeks post-op)

scapular-squeezes-dumbbell.name: Scapular Squeezes with Dumbbell
scapular-squeezes-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and hold a light dumbbell in each hand at chest height with elbows bent. Your shoulders should be relaxed and in a neutral position.
scapular-squeezes-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together by retracting your scapulae, bringing the dumbbells closer to your chest. Hold the contraction briefly, then release with control.
conditions_seen_in: post rotator cuff repair (6 weeks post-op)

side-lying-shoulder-internal-rotation.name: Side-Lying Shoulder Internal Rotation
side-lying-shoulder-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your unaffected side with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Hold a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your forearm pointing upward.
side-lying-shoulder-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm downward toward your torso, moving only at the shoulder's internal rotators. Keep your elbow fixed and shoulder stable throughout the movement.
conditions_seen_in: post rotator cuff repair (6 weeks post-op)

cross-body-shoulder-stretch.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
cross-body-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. Bring your affected arm across your body at shoulder height with the elbow slightly bent.
cross-body-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently pull your affected arm further across your body toward your chest. Hold this position while keeping your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.

towel-stretch.name: Towel Stretch
towel-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and hold a towel vertically with both hands, with your unaffected arm raised overhead holding the top of the towel. Your affected arm is below, holding the bottom of the towel with the elbow bent.
towel-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the towel downward using your unaffected arm, which causes your affected arm to move upward and backward into extension. Maintain a gentle stretch without forcing the movement.

supine-passive-rom.name: Supine Passive Range of Motion
supine-passive-rom.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Your affected arm is at your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees and palm facing up.
supine-passive-rom.endPoseDescription: Using your opposite hand or a light grip on your affected arm, gently guide your forearm across your body and toward the opposite side. The movement is controlled and pain-free, allowing gravity to assist the stretch.

wall-slides.name: Wall Slides
wall-slides.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 6 inches away from the wall and shoulder-width apart. Place both arms against the wall at shoulder height with elbows bent to 90 degrees.
wall-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide both arms upward along the wall toward an overhead position, keeping your elbows and back of your hands in contact with the wall throughout. Slide back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff prehab for overhead athletes

prone-shoulder-flexion.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion
prone-shoulder-flexion.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or table with your affected arm hanging off the edge, palm facing down. Keep your core engaged and your torso stable against the bench.
prone-shoulder-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise your affected arm forward and upward to shoulder height, leading with your thumb. Lower the arm back down in a controlled manner to the starting position.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff prehab for overhead athletes

resistance-band-external-rotation.name: Resistance Band External Rotation
resistance-band-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light resistance band in your affected hand. Your elbow is bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your ribcage with the band anchored to a fixed point at elbow height.
resistance-band-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward against the band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at your side. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner without allowing the band to snap back.

band-pull-apart.name: Band Pull-Apart
band-pull-apart.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height. Hold the resistance band with both hands, keeping your arms parallel to the ground with a slight bend in your elbows.
band-pull-apart.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and slightly backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your arms should form a wider arc while maintaining shoulder height.

band-external-rotation.name: Band External Rotation
band-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your right elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your side with your forearm pointing forward. Hold the resistance band in your right hand while anchoring the other end with your left hand or foot.
band-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your right forearm outward against the band resistance, moving your hand away from your body in an arc. Keep your elbow firmly against your ribs throughout the movement.

prone-i-y-t-raises-band.name: Prone I-Y-T Raises with Band
prone-i-y-t-raises-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or table with your chest off the edge and your arms hanging down. Hold the resistance band in both hands with your arms at your sides.
prone-i-y-t-raises-band.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms in different patterns (I position straight up, Y position at 45 degrees, T position out to sides) against band resistance, squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower controlled back to the starting position after each repetition.

band-internal-rotation.name: Band Shoulder Internal Rotation
band-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your left elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your side, forearm pointing outward. Hold the resistance band in your left hand while anchoring the opposite end with your right hand or by stepping on it.
band-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your left forearm inward across your body against the band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at your ribs. Complete all repetitions on one side before switching to the opposite shoulder.

standing-band-row.name: Standing Band Row
standing-band-row.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and the resistance band looped under your feet. Hold both ends of the band with your arms extended straight down in front of you at hip level.
standing-band-row.endPoseDescription: Pull the band up toward your ribcage by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your elbows should move past your torso with the band handles coming toward your lower chest.

posterior-shoulder-stretch.name: Posterior Shoulder Stretch
posterior-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your right arm crossed horizontally across your chest at shoulder height. Your right elbow should be slightly bent.
posterior-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your left hand to gently pull your right arm closer to your chest, stretching the back of your right shoulder. Keep your torso upright and avoid rotating your trunk during the stretch.

band-lat-pulldown.name: Band Lat Pulldown
band-lat-pulldown.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your core engaged and the resistance band anchored above your head (looped over a door or frame). Hold both ends of the band with your arms extended overhead.
band-lat-pulldown.endPoseDescription: Pull the band down toward your chest by bending your elbows and driving them past your ribs. Squeeze your shoulder blades and lats at the bottom before slowly returning to the starting position.

band-reverse-fly.name: Band Reverse Fly
band-reverse-fly.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a slight forward bend at the hips, keeping your back straight. Hold the resistance band looped under your feet with arms hanging straight down in front of you.
band-reverse-fly.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides and slightly backward in an arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your arms should finish at shoulder height with elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.

pendulum-shoulder-circles.name: Pendulum Shoulder Circles
pendulum-shoulder-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and bend forward at the hips so your torso is nearly parallel to the ground, supporting yourself with your unaffected arm on a table or chair. Let your affected arm hang freely downward in a relaxed position.
pendulum-shoulder-circles.endPoseDescription: Using only the momentum from your body sway, make small circular motions with your hanging arm, gradually increasing the circle size. The motion should be gentle and pain-free, driven by body movement rather than muscle effort.

supine-shoulder-blade-squeezes.name: Supine Shoulder Blade Squeezes
supine-shoulder-blade-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
supine-shoulder-blade-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down toward your hips, holding the contraction for 2 seconds without lifting your arms off the floor. Return to the starting position and repeat in a controlled manner.

supine-external-rotation-bent-elbow.name: Supine External Rotation with Bent Elbow
supine-external-rotation-bent-elbow.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, so your forearm points toward the ceiling. Keep your elbow in contact with the floor throughout the movement.
supine-external-rotation-bent-elbow.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your forearm toward the floor in an external rotation movement, moving only as far as comfort allows without forcing the range. Hold for 1-2 seconds at the end range, then return to the starting position.

seated-shoulder-shrugs.name: Seated Shoulder Shrugs
seated-shoulder-shrugs.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms resting at your sides with palms facing inward. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed in their neutral position.
seated-shoulder-shrugs.endPoseDescription: Raise both shoulders up toward your ears in a shrugging motion, holding the elevated position for 2 seconds. Lower your shoulders back down in a controlled manner to the starting position.

prone-shoulder-squeeze-on-pillow.name: Prone Shoulder Squeeze on Pillow
prone-shoulder-squeeze-on-pillow.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bed or mat with a pillow under your chest for comfort, arms at your sides with elbows bent. Your forehead rests on a small towel roll to keep your neck neutral.
prone-shoulder-squeeze-on-pillow.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together, lifting your arms slightly off the bed while maintaining the elbow bend. Hold the contraction for 2 seconds, focusing on activating the muscles between your shoulder blades.

seated-doorway-chest-stretch.name: Seated Doorway Chest Stretch
seated-doorway-chest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair next to a doorframe with your affected arm at 90-degree shoulder abduction, elbow bent, and forearm resting against the doorframe. Your upper arm is parallel to the ground.
seated-doorway-chest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your torso forward and away from the doorframe, creating a mild stretch across your chest and front shoulder. Hold this position for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily, keeping the stretch comfortable and pain-free.

supine-cross-body-shoulder-stretch.name: Supine Gentle Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
supine-cross-body-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, your affected arm at 90 degrees of abduction with elbow bent. Use your other hand to gently support your affected elbow.
supine-cross-body-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Using your unaffected hand, gently pull your affected arm across your body toward the opposite side, creating a mild stretch in the posterior shoulder. Hold this comfortable stretch for 20-30 seconds without forcing beyond a gentle sensation.

seated-upper-back-posture-reset.name: Seated Upper Back Posture Reset
seated-upper-back-posture-reset.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat, hands clasped behind your head with elbows out to the sides. Maintain a neutral spine position without arching your lower back.
seated-upper-back-posture-reset.endPoseDescription: Gently draw your elbows backward while opening your chest, creating a mild extension through your upper back without straining. Hold for 2 seconds while taking a deep breath, then relax back to neutral.

prone-i-y-t-raises.name: Prone I-Y-T Raises
prone-i-y-t-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or stability ball with your chest supported and arms hanging straight down toward the floor. Your legs are extended behind you with toes on the ground for stability.
prone-i-y-t-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms to form an 'I' position (overhead), then 'Y' position (45 degrees), then 'T' position (90 degrees out to sides), holding each briefly at shoulder height. Return to starting position between each letter formation.

half-kneeling-single-arm-dumbbell-press.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Dumbbell Press
half-kneeling-single-arm-dumbbell-press.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot forward in a staggered stance, keeping your torso upright. Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height on one side with your elbow at 90 degrees.
half-kneeling-single-arm-dumbbell-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbell straight up overhead while maintaining a neutral spine and preventing any rotation of your torso. Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height under control.

dumbbell-external-rotation-90-90.name: Dumbbell External Rotation at 90/90
dumbbell-external-rotation-90-90.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a bench with your shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and your elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell. Your upper arm is perpendicular to your body.
dumbbell-external-rotation-90-90.endPoseDescription: Rotate the dumbbell upward, bringing your forearm toward vertical while keeping your upper arm stationary at 90 degrees of abduction. Slowly return to the neutral position.

dumbbell-farmer-carry.name: Dumbbell Farmer Carry
dumbbell-farmer-carry.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one or both hands at your sides with your shoulders packed back and down. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
dumbbell-farmer-carry.endPoseDescription: Walk forward while maintaining shoulder stability and neutral spine, keeping the dumbbell(s) stable at your side. Maintain scapular control throughout the movement.

quadruped-shoulder-stability-hold.name: Quadruped Shoulder Stability Hold
quadruped-shoulder-stability-hold.startPoseDescription: Position yourself on hands and knees with shoulders directly over wrists and hips over knees. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-shoulder-stability-hold.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining stability through your supporting arm and torso. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then return and repeat on the opposite side.

prone-shoulder-stability-ball-y-raises.name: Prone Shoulder Stability Ball Y-Raises
prone-shoulder-stability-ball-y-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie face down over a stability ball with your chest supported and your feet anchored on the floor. Your arms hang straight down with a light dumbbell in each hand.
prone-shoulder-stability-ball-y-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides and slightly forward in a 'Y' position to shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower the dumbbells back down in a controlled manner.

half-kneeling-pallof-press.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
half-kneeling-pallof-press.startPoseDescription: Kneel in a staggered stance with one foot forward, holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands. Your torso should be upright with core engaged.
half-kneeling-pallof-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbell straight out in front of you while resisting rotation of your torso. Return the dumbbell to chest height and repeat.

standing-dumbbell-reverse-fly.name: Standing Dumbbell Reverse Fly
standing-dumbbell-reverse-fly.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in your elbows and knees. Hinge slightly at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine.
standing-dumbbell-reverse-fly.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower the dumbbells back down in a controlled motion.

supine-shoulder-flexion-pulley.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Pulley
supine-shoulder-flexion-pulley.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell or medicine ball in your affected arm with elbow slightly bent at your side.
supine-shoulder-flexion-pulley.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise your affected arm overhead in a controlled arc, keeping the elbow slightly bent throughout the movement. Lower back to the starting position with control.

prone-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Prone Shoulder External Rotation
prone-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a flat bench with your affected arm hanging off the side, elbow bent at 90 degrees with a light dumbbell in hand. Your upper arm should be parallel to the ground.
prone-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm upward by externally rotating your shoulder, bringing the dumbbell toward the ceiling. Hold briefly at the top, then lower back to the starting position.

seated-shoulder-abduction.name: Seated Shoulder Abduction
seated-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a bench with your back against support and feet flat on the floor. Hold light dumbbells at your sides with arms hanging down and elbows slightly bent.
seated-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc until your upper arms are parallel to the ground, forming a T-shape with your body. Lower back down slowly with control.

chest-doorway-stretch.name: Chest Doorway Stretch
chest-doorway-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your affected arm raised to 90 degrees at the shoulder, elbow bent at 90 degrees, and forearm resting on the doorframe. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
chest-doorway-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently step forward into the doorway, feeling a stretch across your chest and anterior shoulder. Hold the stretch while maintaining good posture and controlled breathing.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

side-lying-shoulder-abduction.name: Side-Lying Shoulder Abduction
side-lying-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your unaffected side with your bottom arm bent for support and your head resting comfortably. Your affected arm should rest on your side with a slight bend in the elbow.
side-lying-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift your affected arm up toward the ceiling in a controlled motion, keeping your torso stable and avoiding any rolling backward. Lower the arm back down with control.

prone-horizontal-abduction.name: Prone Horizontal Abduction
prone-horizontal-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with both arms hanging off the sides, elbows slightly bent with light dumbbells in hand. Your chest should be supported by the bench.
prone-horizontal-abduction.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides in a horizontal abduction, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. Lower the weights back down in a controlled manner.

standing-wall-push-off.name: Standing Wall Push-Off
standing-wall-push-off.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall at arm's length away with your hands placed on the wall at shoulder height, shoulder-width apart. Keep your body straight and core engaged.
standing-wall-push-off.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows to bring your chest closer to the wall, then push through your hands to return to the starting position. This modified push-up maintains shoulder stability while building strength.

scapular-retraction-band.name: Scapular Retraction with Band
scapular-retraction-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands in front of you. Your arms are extended forward with a slight bend in the elbows and the band is taut.
scapular-retraction-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping your elbows high and level with your shoulders. Your chest is open and your posture is upright at the end of the movement.

eccentric-biceps-curl-band.name: Eccentric Biceps Curl with Band
eccentric-biceps-curl-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored under your feet with both hands at shoulder height. Your elbows are bent at 90 degrees and tucked close to your torso.
eccentric-biceps-curl-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your hands toward your thighs in a controlled manner over 3-4 seconds, keeping your elbows stationary and close to your body. Your arms are nearly straight at the end of the eccentric phase.

prone-shoulder-extension-band.name: Prone Shoulder Extension with Band
prone-shoulder-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a table or bed with your arms hanging down toward the floor, holding a light resistance band in both hands. Your forehead rests on the table and your core is engaged.
prone-shoulder-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms out to your sides and slightly back, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. Your arms form a gentle arc and your chest stays on the table throughout.

supine-shoulder-flexion-band.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Band
supine-shoulder-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding a resistance band with both hands at your chest level. Your arms are bent at 90 degrees with the band taut.
supine-shoulder-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly extend your arms overhead in a controlled manner, keeping the band under tension throughout the movement. Your arms are extended above your chest at the end, moving only as far as comfort allows.

banded-external-rotation-90-90.name: Banded External Rotation at 90/90
banded-external-rotation-90-90.startPoseDescription: Stand with your right arm abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding one end of a resistance band. Your forearm points downward and the band is anchored at shoulder height to your side.
banded-external-rotation-90-90.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm upward against the band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at shoulder height. Your forearm finishes pointing upward, with the band providing controlled resistance throughout.

posterior-shoulder-stretch-band.name: Posterior Shoulder Stretch with Band
posterior-shoulder-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended in front of you. The band is held taut with hands shoulder-width apart.
posterior-shoulder-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands away from each other, opening your chest and squeezing your shoulder blades back. Your arms remain at chest height with the stretch felt across your chest and front shoulders.

band-resisted-shoulder-abduction.name: Band-Resisted Shoulder Abduction
band-resisted-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band under both feet, holding the ends in each hand at your sides. Your arms are straight with the band taut and your posture is upright.
band-resisted-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to your sides up to shoulder height against the band resistance, maintaining a slight elbow bend throughout. Your arms form a 90-degree angle with your torso at the peak of the movement.

scalene-stretch.name: Scalene Stretch
scalene-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and feet flat on the floor. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your head in a neutral position.
scalene-stretch.endPoseDescription: Tilt your head toward one shoulder while gently pulling the opposite shoulder down with your hand. Feel a stretch along the side of your neck and upper shoulder.

pectoralis-minor-stretch.name: Pectoralis Minor Stretch
pectoralis-minor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or doorway with one arm raised at shoulder height, elbow bent to 90 degrees. Place your forearm against the wall or doorframe.
pectoralis-minor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Step your body forward while keeping your forearm in place, feeling a stretch across your chest and front shoulder. Your chest opens up as you lean into the stretch.

shoulder-blade-squeezes.name: Shoulder Blade Squeezes
shoulder-blade-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your arms at your sides, elbows bent to 90 degrees. Keep your shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
shoulder-blade-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Pull your shoulder blades backward and down, squeezing the muscles between your shoulder blades together. Hold briefly while maintaining an upright posture.

cervical-retraction.name: Cervical Retraction
cervical-retraction.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your eyes looking straight ahead and your shoulders relaxed. Your neck is in a neutral position.
cervical-retraction.endPoseDescription: Gently draw your chin backward in a horizontal motion, creating a slight double chin appearance. Hold this position briefly without tilting your head up or down.

doorway-pec-stretch-rotation.name: Doorway Pec Stretch with Rotation
doorway-pec-stretch-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with one arm raised to 90 degrees, elbow bent, and forearm resting against the doorframe. Step one foot forward slightly.
doorway-pec-stretch-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso away from the raised arm, deepening the stretch across your chest and shoulder. Feel the stretch intensify through your pectoral muscles.

upper-trapezius-stretch.name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
upper-trapezius-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your right hand placed on your left temple. Your shoulders are relaxed and your posture is straight.
upper-trapezius-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your head toward your right shoulder, creating a stretch along the left side of your neck. Keep your shoulders level and avoid shrugging.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

chin-tucks.name: Chin Tucks
chin-tucks.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes focused straight ahead. Your neck is in a neutral position.
chin-tucks.endPoseDescription: Gently tuck your chin inward, engaging the deep neck flexors without looking down. Hold briefly and release, maintaining good posture throughout.

scapular-retractions-resistance.name: Scapular Retractions with Resistance
scapular-retractions-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your arms extended forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other. Your core is engaged and shoulders are relaxed.
scapular-retractions-resistance.endPoseDescription: Pull your arms backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together as if trying to hold a pencil between them. Return slowly to the starting position with control.

prone-ytw-raises.name: Prone YTW Raises
prone-ytw-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or stability ball with your chest supported and arms hanging toward the floor. Your legs are extended behind you with feet on the ground for stability.
prone-ytw-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms in a Y position (overhead), then T position (out to sides), then W position (elbows bent at 90 degrees), pausing briefly at each position before returning to start.

dumbbell-farmers-carry.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry
dumbbell-farmers-carry.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with dumbbells held at your sides with a neutral grip and your shoulders packed down and back. Your core is engaged and your posture is tall.
dumbbell-farmers-carry.endPoseDescription: Walk forward while maintaining perfect upright posture with shoulders retracted and scapulae stabilized. Your arms remain straight at your sides throughout the movement.

half-kneeling-single-arm-dumbbell-row.name: Half Kneeling Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
half-kneeling-single-arm-dumbbell-row.startPoseDescription: Position yourself in a half-kneeling stance with one knee down and one foot forward, holding a dumbbell in the hand opposite your forward leg. Your torso is upright and core is engaged.
half-kneeling-single-arm-dumbbell-row.endPoseDescription: Row the dumbbell up toward your hip by driving your elbow back and retracting your scapula, keeping your torso stable and square. Your shoulder blade pulls toward your spine at the top of the movement.

quadruped-scapular-pushup-plus.name: Quadruped Scapular Push-Up Plus
quadruped-scapular-pushup-plus.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with hands directly under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Your core is engaged and shoulders are packed down.
quadruped-scapular-pushup-plus.endPoseDescription: Protract your scapulae by pushing the floor away, allowing your mid-back to round slightly upward between your shoulder blades. Hold this protraction position briefly before returning to the starting position.

dumbbell-pullovers.name: Dumbbell Pullovers
dumbbell-pullovers.startPoseDescription: Lie perpendicular across a bench with your upper back supported and feet on the floor, holding a single dumbbell with both hands above your chest. Your shoulders are in a relaxed position.
dumbbell-pullovers.endPoseDescription: Lower the dumbbell in an arc motion behind and above your head, allowing a stretch across your chest and anterior shoulder. Your hips remain on or near the bench throughout the movement.

prone-iyt-holds.name: Prone I-Y-T Holds
prone-iyt-holds.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with your arms hanging toward the floor and your legs extended behind you. Your forehead rests on a small pad or folded towel.
prone-iyt-holds.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms into I position (straight overhead), Y position (45 degrees), and T position (90 degrees out to sides), holding each position for 2-3 seconds with scapulae fully retracted.

single-arm-dumbbell-overhead-press.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Press
single-arm-dumbbell-overhead-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell at shoulder height with your elbow slightly in front of your body. Your core is braced and your scapulae are packed.
single-arm-dumbbell-overhead-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbell overhead in a slight forward angle, allowing your scapula to upwardly rotate naturally at the end. Your arm is fully extended with controlled stability throughout the entire range of motion.

serratus-anterior-punch-prone.name: Serratus Anterior Punch (Prone)
serratus-anterior-punch-prone.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with your arms bent at 90 degrees, elbows at shoulder height, and hands holding light dumbbells near your shoulders. Your core is engaged to stabilize your trunk.
serratus-anterior-punch-prone.endPoseDescription: Punch the dumbbells forward while allowing your shoulder blades to protract and spread across your ribcage. This motion emphasizes serratus anterior activation without rotating your torso.

dead-bug-with-dumbbell.name: Dead Bug with Dumbbell
dead-bug-with-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your arms extended straight up toward the ceiling holding a light dumbbell with both hands, and your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees. Your lower back is neutral against the floor.
dead-bug-with-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your right arm overhead while straightening your left leg, hovering both limbs just above the floor. Your core remains engaged to prevent your lower back from arching throughout the movement.

dead-bug.name: Dead Bug
dead-bug.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent at 90 degrees and hips at 90 degrees, with shins parallel to the floor. Arms are extended straight up toward the ceiling.
dead-bug.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your right arm overhead while straightening your left leg, hovering both just above the floor. Return to start and repeat on the opposite side.
