bird-dog.name: Bird Dog
bird-dog.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral with a slight natural curve.
bird-dog.endPoseDescription: Extend your right arm forward and left leg backward until they are in line with your torso. Hold briefly while maintaining a neutral spine, then return to start.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

glute-bridge.name: Glute Bridges
glute-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned about hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down.
glute-bridge.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold briefly.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

quadruped-rock-back.name: Quadruped Rock Backs
quadruped-rock-back.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine and core engaged. Hands are directly under shoulders and knees under hips.
quadruped-rock-back.endPoseDescription: Gently shift your hips back toward your heels while maintaining neutral spine alignment. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.

prone-cobra.name: Prone Cobra
prone-cobra.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with forearms on the ground and elbows under your shoulders. Keep your legs straight with tops of feet on the floor.
prone-cobra.endPoseDescription: Press through your forearms to lift your chest off the ground while keeping your pelvis and lower abdomen in contact with the floor. Hold the position while maintaining a neutral neck.

cat-cow-stretch.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
cat-cow-stretch.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a neutral spine. Wrists are under shoulders and knees are under hips.
cat-cow-stretch.endPoseDescription: Alternate between arching your back and lifting your head (cow position) and rounding your spine while tucking your chin (cat position). Move fluidly between positions.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult
core strengthening for lower back prevention

supine-figure-four-stretch.name: Supine Figure Four Stretch
supine-figure-four-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross your right ankle over your left knee to form a figure-four shape.
supine-figure-four-stretch.endPoseDescription: Pull your left knee toward your chest, allowing the stretch to deepen in your right hip and glute. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.

standing-pelvic-tilt.name: Standing Pelvic Tilts
standing-pelvic-tilt.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Place hands on your lower abdomen or lower back for feedback.
standing-pelvic-tilt.endPoseDescription: Tilt your pelvis by tightening your core and rotating your pelvis upward, flattening the natural curve of your lower back. Return to neutral and repeat.

pallof-press.name: Pallof Press
pallof-press.startPoseDescription: Stand perpendicular to a cable machine with feet shoulder-width apart. Hold the handle at chest height with both hands, with the cable creating resistance to one side.
pallof-press.endPoseDescription: Press the handle away from your body, extending your arms straight while resisting rotation. Return the handle to your chest and repeat for the prescribed repetitions.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

cervical-isometric-neck-flexion.name: Cervical Isometric Neck Flexion
cervical-isometric-neck-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Place your hand on your forehead with elbow bent.
cervical-isometric-neck-flexion.endPoseDescription: Gently press your forehead into your hand while resisting movement with your neck muscles for 5-10 seconds. Maintain neutral spine throughout.

cervical-isometric-neck-extension.name: Cervical Isometric Neck Extension
cervical-isometric-neck-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and head in neutral position. Place your hand on the back of your head with elbow bent.
cervical-isometric-neck-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently press the back of your head into your hand while resisting movement with your neck extensor muscles for 5-10 seconds.

cervical-isometric-lateral-flexion.name: Cervical Isometric Lateral Flexion
cervical-isometric-lateral-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Place your right hand on the right side of your head.
cervical-isometric-lateral-flexion.endPoseDescription: Gently press your head to the right into your hand while resisting movement with lateral neck muscles for 5-10 seconds. Repeat on left side.

resistance-band-shoulder-external-rotati.name: Resistance Band Shoulder External Rotation
resistance-band-shoulder-external-rotati.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with elbow bent 90 degrees at your side. Band is looped around hands.
resistance-band-shoulder-external-rotati.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward against band resistance, keeping elbow stationary at your side. Hold briefly, then return to start position.

resistance-band-shoulder-internal-rotati.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Internal Rotation
resistance-band-shoulder-internal-rotati.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding resistance band with elbow bent 90 degrees and forearm rotated outward. Band is anchored at chest height.
resistance-band-shoulder-internal-rotati.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm inward against band resistance, keeping elbow stationary. Hold briefly, then return to start position.

neck-flexor-stretch.name: Neck Flexor Stretch
neck-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Head is in neutral position.
neck-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, feeling a gentle stretch at the back of your neck and upper shoulders. Hold 20-30 seconds without forcing.

scapular-squeeze-with-band.name: Scapular Squeeze with Band
scapular-squeeze-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a looped resistance band at chest height with arms extended at shoulder width. Maintain neutral spine.
scapular-squeeze-with-band.endPoseDescription: Pull band outward by squeezing shoulder blades together, keeping arms at shoulder height. Hold briefly, then return to start with controlled motion.

cervical-rotation-stretch.name: Cervical Rotation Stretch
cervical-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Head is facing forward in neutral position.
cervical-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your head to the right, turning your chin toward your shoulder while maintaining upright posture. Hold 20-30 seconds and repeat on opposite side.

prone-iyt-shoulder-series-with-band.name: Prone I-Y-T Shoulder Series with Band
prone-iyt-shoulder-series-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or sturdy surface with feet on ground, holding light resistance band in both hands at shoulder height. Forehead rests on a small towel.
prone-iyt-shoulder-series-with-band.endPoseDescription: Pull band outward and upward in an I position (arms overhead), then Y position (45 degrees), then T position (90 degrees), holding each briefly before returning. Perform 10-12 reps of each position.

pelvic-tilts.name: Pelvic Tilts
pelvic-tilts.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down for stability.
pelvic-tilts.endPoseDescription: Tilt your pelvis by tightening your abdominal muscles and pressing your lower back gently into the floor. Hold this neutral spine position briefly while maintaining steady breathing.

prone-press-up.name: Prone Press-Up
prone-press-up.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the floor with your hands positioned under your shoulders, similar to a push-up starting position. Keep your hips and legs relaxed on the ground.
prone-press-up.endPoseDescription: Press through your hands to lift your upper chest off the floor, extending your arms while keeping your pelvis in contact with the floor. This extension mobilizes the spine and may reduce stenotic symptoms.

quadruped-alternating-arm-raise.name: Quadruped Alternating Arm Raise
quadruped-alternating-arm-raise.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Keep your core engaged and look down to maintain neck alignment.
quadruped-alternating-arm-raise.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise one arm forward to shoulder height while keeping your body stable and level. Return to starting position and alternate sides in a controlled manner.

knee-to-chest-stretch.name: Knee to Chest Stretch
knee-to-chest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Keep your head resting comfortably on the floor or a small pillow.
knee-to-chest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull one knee toward your chest using your hands, feeling a stretch in your lower back and hip. Keep the other foot on the floor for stability and support.

standing-spinal-extension.name: Standing Spinal Extension
standing-spinal-extension.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and hands placed on your lower back for support. Engage your core and maintain good posture throughout the movement.
standing-spinal-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently arch backward by extending your spine, using your hands for light support and balance. Move only as far as comfortable without causing pain or dizziness.

standing-marching.name: Standing Marching
standing-marching.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides, and good posture throughout. Keep your core engaged and look straight ahead.
standing-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up in a marching motion while maintaining balance and posture. Alternate legs in a controlled pace, swinging arms naturally as if marching in place.

seated-spinal-rotation.name: Seated Spinal Rotation
seated-spinal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture, keeping your hips and pelvis stable. Cross your arms over your chest or place hands behind your head.
seated-spinal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your upper spine and torso to one side, feeling a controlled stretch through the mid-back. Keep your hips still and return to center before rotating to the other side.

supine-lower-trunk-rotation.name: Supine Lower Trunk Rotation
supine-lower-trunk-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides for balance and stability.
supine-lower-trunk-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently lower both knees to one side, allowing controlled rotation of your lower spine and pelvis. Keep your shoulders flat on the floor and return to center before rotating the other direction.

bird-dogs.name: Bird Dogs
bird-dogs.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Engage your core to prevent any sagging in the lower back.
bird-dogs.endPoseDescription: Simultaneously extend your right arm forward and left leg backward, creating one straight line from fingertips to heel. Return to starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

single-leg-deadlifts.name: Single-Leg Deadlifts with Dumbbells
single-leg-deadlifts.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, maintaining a slight bend in your standing knee. Keep your chest up and engage your core for stability.
single-leg-deadlifts.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hip while extending your free leg behind you for balance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Return to standing by driving through your heel and squeezing your glute.

sidelying-hip-abduction.name: Sidelying Hip Abduction
sidelying-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line, legs stacked, and your head resting on your lower arm. Keep your core engaged and your pelvis stable throughout the movement.
sidelying-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift your top leg toward the ceiling to about 45 degrees, keeping your torso still and avoiding rolling backward. Lower the leg with control without letting it touch the bottom leg.

quadruped-hip-circles.name: Quadruped Hip Circles
quadruped-hip-circles.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a neutral spine, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Engage your core to maintain stability throughout the movement.
quadruped-hip-circles.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee slightly off the ground and make slow, controlled circles, moving through the hip joint's full range of motion. Complete the desired number of circles in both directions before switching legs.

lying-figure-four-stretch.name: Lying Figure Four Stretch
lying-figure-four-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to form a figure-four shape.
lying-figure-four-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the uncrossed thigh toward your chest, feeling a stretch in the hip and glute of the crossed leg. Hold the stretch while maintaining a neutral spine and relaxed breathing.

dumbbell-goblet-squats.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squats
dumbbell-goblet-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
dumbbell-goblet-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower into a squat by bending your hips and knees, keeping the dumbbell at chest level and weight in your heels. Drive through your heels to return to standing, maintaining an upright posture throughout.

prone-hip-bridges.name: Prone Hip Bridges
prone-hip-bridges.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders, and legs extended with toes tucked under. Engage your core and glutes to stabilize your lower back.
prone-hip-bridges.endPoseDescription: Drive your hips upward toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from head to knees while squeezing your glutes. Hold briefly at the top, then lower with control without fully relaxing your glutes.

quadruped-opposite-arm-leg-raise.name: Quadruped Opposite Arm and Leg Raise
quadruped-opposite-arm-leg-raise.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a neutral spine, ensuring shoulders are over wrists and hips are over knees. Brace your core to stabilize your lumbar spine.
quadruped-opposite-arm-leg-raise.endPoseDescription: Simultaneously raise your right arm and left leg to shoulder and hip height respectively while maintaining a level spine. Hold for 2 seconds and return to start.

cat-camel-stretch.name: Cat-Camel Stretch
cat-camel-stretch.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine, hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your head in neutral alignment with your spine.
cat-camel-stretch.endPoseDescription: Arch your back gently by lowering your belly and lifting your head and tailbone toward the ceiling in the camel position. Then reverse by rounding your spine and tucking your chin.

transverse-abdominis-activation.name: Transverse Abdominis Activation
transverse-abdominis-activation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. Relax your breathing and prepare to engage your deep core muscles.
transverse-abdominis-activation.endPoseDescription: Exhale and draw your belly button inward toward your spine, engaging your transverse abdominis without holding your breath. Maintain the contraction for 5-10 seconds.

quadriceps-sets.name: Quadriceps Sets
quadriceps-sets.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg extended and the other knee bent with a rolled towel underneath. Keep your lower back neutral against the floor.
quadriceps-sets.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on the extended leg by straightening the knee completely and pulling the kneecap upward. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds.

modified-superman-hold.name: Modified Superman Hold
modified-superman-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the floor with your forehead resting on a rolled towel and arms at your sides. Keep your legs straight and relaxed on the ground.
modified-superman-hold.endPoseDescription: Lift your chest off the floor slightly by engaging your back extensors, keeping your gaze downward to maintain neutral cervical spine. Hold for 2-3 seconds without lifting your legs.

prone-lumbar-extension-band.name: Prone Lumbar Extension with Band
prone-lumbar-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the floor with your forearms on the ground, elbows under your shoulders. A resistance band is looped around your mid-back and anchored securely beneath you.
prone-lumbar-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Push through your forearms and gently lift your chest off the ground while the band provides resistance. Hold this extended position while maintaining a neutral spine and avoiding excessive arching.

supine-pelvic-tilt.name: Supine Pelvic Tilt
supine-pelvic-tilt.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Your arms rest at your sides with palms down.
supine-pelvic-tilt.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your pelvis to flatten your lower back against the floor by engaging your abdominal muscles. Hold this neutral spine position for a few seconds before releasing.

quadruped-bird-dog-band.name: Quadruped Bird-Dog with Band
quadruped-bird-dog-band.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. A resistance band is wrapped around one foot and held in your opposite hand.
quadruped-bird-dog-band.endPoseDescription: Extend your opposite arm forward and leg backward in line with your body while the band provides resistance. Maintain a level hips and neutral spine throughout the movement.

standing-band-pallof-press.name: Standing Band Pallof Press
standing-band-pallof-press.startPoseDescription: Stand perpendicular to an anchor point with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent. Hold a looped band at chest height with both hands, band anchored at chest level beside you.
standing-band-pallof-press.endPoseDescription: Press the band straight out in front of your chest, fully extending your arms while resisting the rotational force. Return to chest height with control, engaging your core throughout.

seated-spinal-stretch-band.name: Seated Spinal Stretch with Band
seated-spinal-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor with legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around both feet and hold the ends loosely in your hands.
seated-spinal-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently fold forward at the hips while keeping your back straight, using the band to deepen the stretch along your hamstrings and lower back. Hold this position and breathe deeply.

side-lying-clamshell-band.name: Side-Lying Clamshell with Band
side-lying-clamshell-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and your bottom arm supporting your head.
side-lying-clamshell-band.endPoseDescription: Open your top knee against the band resistance while keeping your feet together and hips stable. Pause at the top before slowly returning to the starting position.

supine-marching-band.name: Supine Marching with Band
supine-marching-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. A resistance band is looped around both feet, and your hands are behind your head for light neck support.
supine-marching-band.endPoseDescription: Lift one foot slightly off the ground while keeping your lower back pressed to the floor, then alternate legs in a marching motion against band resistance. Maintain a neutral spine throughout.

standing-band-pull-apart.name: Standing Band Pull-Apart
standing-band-pull-apart.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hold a resistance band at eye level with both hands, arms extended straight out in front of you.
standing-band-pull-apart.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward in an arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return to the starting position with control, focusing on posterior chain engagement.

kneeling-hip-flexor-stretch-band.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch with Band
kneeling-hip-flexor-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the other foot planted in front, creating a 90-degree angle at both hips. A resistance band is looped around the back knee for gentle assistance.
kneeling-hip-flexor-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently press your hips forward while using the band to support and deepen the hip flexor stretch on the kneeling side. Maintain an upright torso and avoid arching your lower back excessively.

thoracic-rotation-seated.name: Thoracic Spine Rotation - Seated
thoracic-rotation-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms crossed over chest with hands behind head. Keep your hips and lower back still against the chair.
thoracic-rotation-seated.endPoseDescription: Rotate your upper torso to one side, feeling a stretch across the mid-back and ribcage. Hold the rotation while maintaining an upright posture.

supine-thoracic-rotation.name: Supine Thoracic Rotation
supine-thoracic-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Clasp both hands behind your head with elbows out to the sides.
supine-thoracic-rotation.endPoseDescription: Drop both knees to one side while keeping your shoulders flat on the floor and upper back engaged. Feel the stretch along your thoracic spine.

standing-thoracic-extension.name: Standing Thoracic Extension
standing-thoracic-extension.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place hands clasped behind your head with elbows pointing outward. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine.
standing-thoracic-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently arch backward from the thoracic spine while keeping your lower back stable and core engaged. Look slightly upward without overextending your neck.

quadruped-thoracic-rotation.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
quadruped-thoracic-rotation.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a neutral spine and one hand behind your head with elbow pointing outward. Keep your hips stable and level.
quadruped-thoracic-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your upper body to bring your elbow toward the opposite knee, then rotate in the opposite direction bringing your elbow toward the ceiling. This creates a twisting motion through the thoracic spine.

childs-pose-rotation.name: Child's Pose with Rotation
childs-pose-rotation.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees, then sink your hips back to your heels with arms extended forward on the floor. Rest your forehead toward the ground.
childs-pose-rotation.endPoseDescription: Walk your hands toward one side, creating a gentle stretch along the opposite side of your thoracic spine and ribcage. Switch sides after holding.

seated-upper-back-squeeze.name: Seated Upper Back Squeeze
seated-upper-back-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep shoulders relaxed and chest lifted.
seated-upper-back-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together as if trying to hold a pencil between them, engaging the muscles of the upper back. Release and repeat without rounding your shoulders forward.

prone-thoracic-extension.name: Prone Thoracic Extension Hold
prone-thoracic-extension.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your forehead resting on a folded towel and arms at your sides with palms facing up. Keep your legs extended and relaxed.
prone-thoracic-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently lift your chest off the floor using your thoracic muscles while keeping your pelvis and legs on the ground. Hold briefly and return to starting position with controlled movement.

dumbbell-rows.name: Dumbbell Rows
dumbbell-rows.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a slight forward hinge at the hips. Keep your core engaged and your back neutral.
dumbbell-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull both dumbbells up toward your ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. Your elbows should stay close to your body throughout the movement.

quadruped-spinal-rotation.name: Quadruped Spinal Rotation
quadruped-spinal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Begin on your hands and knees with shoulders over wrists and hips over knees. Place your right hand behind your head with elbow pointing out.
quadruped-spinal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to bring your right elbow toward your left knee, creating a gentle twist through your thoracic spine. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

farmers-carry.name: Farmer's Carry
farmers-carry.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your shoulders packed back and core engaged. Maintain a neutral spine throughout.
farmers-carry.endPoseDescription: Walk forward for a set distance or time while maintaining excellent posture and keeping the dumbbells at your sides. Focus on stable, controlled steps with no spinal deviation.

cervical-retraction-isometric.name: Cervical Retraction with Isometric Hold
cervical-retraction-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Look straight ahead with your chin in a neutral position.
cervical-retraction-isometric.endPoseDescription: Gently draw your chin straight back (creating a double chin appearance) while keeping your gaze forward. Hold this retracted position while maintaining neutral spine.

scapular-retraction-squeeze.name: Scapular Retraction Squeeze
scapular-retraction-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with arms at your sides, shoulders relaxed. Keep your chest open and spine neutral.
scapular-retraction-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and slightly down, retracting them toward your spine. Hold the contraction while keeping arms relaxed at sides.

quadruped-shoulder-blade-squeeze.name: Quadruped Shoulder Blade Squeeze
quadruped-shoulder-blade-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with shoulders directly over wrists and hips over knees. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-shoulder-blade-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Retract your shoulder blades by squeezing them together and slightly depressing them. Maintain this contraction while keeping your arms stable and spine neutral.

thoracic-rotation-stretch.name: Thoracic Rotation Stretch
thoracic-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with neutral spine and shoulders over wrists. Place one hand behind your head with elbow pointing out.
thoracic-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Rotate your thoracic spine, bringing your elbow toward the opposite knee while following with your gaze. Feel the stretch across your upper back and shoulders.

wall-angels.name: Wall Angels
wall-angels.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 6 inches away, and arms at shoulder height in a goalpost position. Keep your head, shoulders, and lower back in contact with the wall.
wall-angels.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your arms upward toward the ceiling while maintaining wall contact throughout. Return to starting position with controlled movement, maintaining neutral cervical spine.

resisted-back-extension-band.name: Resisted Back Extension with Band
resisted-back-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around a fixed point at chest height in front of you. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at chest level, maintaining neutral spine.
resisted-back-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your torso by squeezing your shoulder blades together and extending your thoracic spine slightly backward. Hold this retracted position while keeping your core engaged and lower back neutral.

banded-pull-apart-shoulders.name: Banded Pull-Apart for Shoulder Stability
banded-pull-apart-shoulders.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at chest height with arms extended straight out in front of you. Your shoulders should be relaxed and core engaged.
banded-pull-apart-shoulders.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward in an arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together and bringing your hands to shoulder width. Your arms should maintain a slight bend throughout the movement.

standing-rotation-band.name: Standing Rotation with Band
standing-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band secured at chest height in front of you, holding both ends with arms extended. Keep your hips still and facing forward throughout the exercise.
standing-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso and arms to one side against the band resistance, keeping your core engaged and lower back stable. Return to center with control and repeat on the opposite side.

banded-reverse-fly.name: Banded Reverse Fly
banded-reverse-fly.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band held at chest height with both hands, arms bent and positioned in front of your body. Your shoulders should be relaxed and core engaged.
banded-reverse-fly.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart and outward by opening your arms to the sides, squeezing your rear shoulder muscles and upper back. Your arms should end in a T position with elbows slightly bent.

quadruped-band-row.name: Quadruped Band Row
quadruped-band-row.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your hands, maintaining a neutral spine and engaged core. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart with the band slack.
quadruped-band-row.endPoseDescription: Row one hand back by pulling the band, retracting your shoulder blade while keeping your torso stable and level. Your elbow should track close to your ribcage as you pull.

band-assisted-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Band-Assisted Hip Flexor Stretch
band-assisted-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended forward, and loop a resistance band around the extended leg's foot. Maintain an upright torso with core engaged.
band-assisted-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press your hips forward while using the band to assist the stretch on the hip flexor of the kneeling leg. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning backward to maintain proper spinal alignment.

supine-hip-abduction.name: Supine Hip Abduction
supine-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides for stability.
supine-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide one foot outward along the floor, abducting the hip while keeping the knee bent. Return to the starting position and repeat on both sides.

supine-hip-flexion-knee-extension.name: Supine Hip Flexion with Knee Extension
supine-hip-flexion-knee-extension.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Keep your lower back neutral and relaxed.
supine-hip-flexion-knee-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly bring one knee toward your chest, then gently straighten that leg upward while keeping the other foot on the floor. Lower and repeat on the opposite side.

supine-piriformis-stretch.name: Supine Piriformis Stretch
supine-piriformis-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure-4 position.
supine-piriformis-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the uncrossed knee toward your chest, feeling a stretch in the hip and buttock area of the crossed leg. Hold the stretch without bouncing.

seated-hip-internal-rotation.name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation
seated-hip-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and knees bent to 90 degrees. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
seated-hip-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate one knee inward across the body, internally rotating at the hip joint while keeping your foot off the floor. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

standing-hip-abduction.name: Standing Hip Abduction
standing-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, using a sturdy surface for balance if needed. Keep your trunk still and core engaged.
standing-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg out to the side, keeping the knee straight or slightly bent, without leaning your torso. Lower the leg back to the starting position with control.

quadruped-hip-extension.name: Quadruped Hip Extension
quadruped-hip-extension.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-hip-extension.endPoseDescription: Extend one leg backward and upward, lifting your knee away from the floor while keeping the hip level. Squeeze your glutes at the top before lowering back down.

supine-hip-external-rotation.name: Supine Hip External Rotation
supine-hip-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot placed flat on the floor. Keep the other leg extended straight on the floor.
supine-hip-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate the bent knee outward toward the floor, externally rotating at the hip joint. Gently press the knee further down using your other leg for light assistance if tolerated.

side-lying-hip-abduction.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
side-lying-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with legs straight and aligned with your body, resting on your forearm. Keep your torso stable and core engaged.
side-lying-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift your top leg 18-24 inches toward the ceiling, keeping it straight and in line with your body. Lower back to starting position with control.

monster-walk.name: Monster Walk
monster-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above your knees, feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight knee bend and neutral spine throughout the movement.
monster-walk.endPoseDescription: Step forward with one leg while maintaining tension on the band and slight forward lean. Alternate legs in a controlled walking pattern for the prescribed distance.

side-plank-hip-drop.name: Side Plank with Hip Drop
side-plank-hip-drop.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side propped up on your forearm, with legs stacked and your body forming a straight line from head to feet. Engage your core and keep your hips lifted off the ground.
side-plank-hip-drop.endPoseDescription: Lower your hip toward the ground in a controlled manner, then raise it back to the starting position. Maintain a stable torso and avoid rotating forward or backward.

dumbbell-single-leg-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Deadlift
dumbbell-single-leg-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand, with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
dumbbell-single-leg-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hip while extending your free leg behind you for counterbalance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Return to standing by driving through your heel and squeezing your glute.

figure-4-stretch.name: Figure-4 Stretch
figure-4-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure-4 shape.
figure-4-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your thigh toward your chest while keeping your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor. Maintain the stretch for the prescribed duration without bouncing.

standing-hip-internal-rotation.name: Standing Hip Internal Rotation
standing-hip-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on one leg with knee bent to 90 degrees, holding onto a support for balance. Keep your standing leg slightly bent and core engaged.
standing-hip-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your lifted leg outward at the hip, moving your foot away from your body in a semicircular motion. Return to center in a controlled manner and repeat.

lateral-band-walk.name: Lateral Band Walk
lateral-band-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped just below your knees, maintaining a quarter-squat position with knees bent. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
lateral-band-walk.endPoseDescription: Step sideways while maintaining tension on the band and the quarter-squat position. Alternate directions and maintain control throughout the movement without letting knees cave inward.

pigeon-pose.name: Pigeon Pose
pigeon-pose.startPoseDescription: Begin in a quadruped position and bring one knee forward toward the same-side wrist, positioning that leg at roughly a 90-degree angle. Keep your hands on the ground for support.
pigeon-pose.endPoseDescription: Fold your torso forward over your bent leg, resting on your forearms or hands as tolerated. Keep your hips level and breathe deeply into the stretch without forcing deeper flexion.

prone-hip-internal-rotation.name: Prone Hip Internal Rotation
prone-hip-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your right leg bent at the knee with your foot positioned to the right side of your body. Your left leg remains extended, and your forehead rests on your hands.
prone-hip-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently press your right knee toward the floor, rotating your hip internally to increase the stretch. Hold this position while maintaining a neutral spine and relaxed shoulders.

single-leg-glute-bridge.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
single-leg-glute-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Lift your right foot slightly off the ground while keeping your left foot planted.
single-leg-glute-bridge.endPoseDescription: Push through your left heel to lift your hips up, supporting your weight primarily on your left leg. Maintain a straight line from knee through hips to shoulders, squeezing the left glute.

fire-hydrants.name: Fire Hydrants
fire-hydrants.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Keep your back flat and core engaged.
fire-hydrants.endPoseDescription: Keeping your right knee bent, lift your right leg out to the side to about hip height. Pause at the top and return to the starting position in a controlled manner.

monster-walks.name: Monster Walks
monster-walks.startPoseDescription: Stand with a resistance band looped around your legs just above your knees, feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight forward lean with your chest over your hips and hands behind your head.
monster-walks.endPoseDescription: Take a step forward and slightly outward with one leg while maintaining knee and hip tension on the band. Continue walking in a controlled diagonal pattern, keeping your core engaged.

supine-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Supine Hip Flexor Stretch
supine-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a mat with both legs extended. Pull one knee toward your chest while keeping the opposite leg straight on the floor.
supine-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Hold the pulled knee at chest level while the extended leg remains flat against the mat. You should feel a gentle stretch along the front of the extended leg's hip.

quadruped-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Quadruped Hip Flexor Stretch
quadruped-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with shoulders over wrists and hips over knees. Maintain a neutral spine position.
quadruped-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slide one leg backward while dropping the hip toward the floor, creating a lunge-like position. Keep your core engaged and feel the stretch along the front of the back hip.

resistance-band-hip-flexion.name: Resistance Band Hip Flexion
resistance-band-hip-flexion.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around one foot and holding the other end in both hands at waist height. Keep your standing leg straight with a slight knee bend.
resistance-band-hip-flexion.endPoseDescription: Pull your foot upward against the band resistance, lifting your knee toward your chest in a controlled motion. Maintain an upright posture and return slowly to the starting position.

clamshells-resistance-band.name: Clamshells with Resistance Band
clamshells-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and aligned.
clamshells-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Lift your top knee upward while keeping feet together, creating an open clamshell motion against the band resistance. Control the movement back to the starting position.

standing-hip-abduction-band.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
standing-hip-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees, feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight bend in both knees with good posture.
standing-hip-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Step one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping your torso upright and core engaged. Return to the starting position with control.

prone-hip-extension.name: Prone Hip Extension
prone-hip-extension.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a mat with your forehead resting on folded hands, legs extended, and feet hip-width apart. Keep your core engaged throughout.
prone-hip-extension.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg upward while keeping the knee straight, squeezing your glute muscle at the top. Lower the leg back down with control without touching the floor.

90-90-hip-stretch.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
90-90-hip-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one leg bent in front of you at 90 degrees and the other leg bent to the side at 90 degrees. Keep your spine tall and both feet flat.
90-90-hip-stretch.endPoseDescription: Fold your torso forward over the front leg, feeling a deep stretch in the outer hip of the front leg. Hold the stretch while maintaining a neutral spine.

seated-figure-four-stretch.name: Seated Figure-Four Stretch
seated-figure-four-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and your back against the chair. Keep your posture tall and shoulders relaxed.
seated-figure-four-stretch.endPoseDescription: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to form a figure-four shape, then gently lean forward from your hips. You should feel a deep stretch in the outer hip and glute of the crossed leg.

supine-hip-rotation.name: Supine Hip Internal/External Rotation
supine-hip-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor, keeping the other leg straight and relaxed. Rest your arms at your sides.
supine-hip-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate the bent knee inward and outward through a comfortable range of motion, allowing the hip to rotate naturally. Move slowly and stop before any pain or significant resistance.

standing-hip-flexion.name: Standing Hip Flexion
standing-hip-flexion.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, lightly holding onto a counter or wall for balance if needed. Engage your core and maintain tall posture.
standing-hip-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee forward and upward to about hip height or as high as comfortable without leaning backward. Lower with control and repeat on the same leg.

standing-hip-extension.name: Standing Hip Extension
standing-hip-extension.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or stable surface, with hands on the surface for balance. Keep your surgical leg straight with a slight knee bend.
standing-hip-extension.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your glute and extend your surgical leg backward, keeping your knee slightly bent and maintaining neutral spine. Return to start position with control.

prone-hip-abduction.name: Prone Hip Abduction
prone-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a bed or mat with a pillow under your hips for comfort and support. Keep your arms relaxed and your surgical leg extended straight.
prone-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift your surgical leg out to the side, abducting at the hip while keeping your leg straight. Hold briefly at the top, then lower with control.

supine-glute-bridge.name: Supine Glute Bridge
supine-glute-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and close to your buttocks. Place arms at your sides with palms down.
supine-glute-bridge.endPoseDescription: Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.

standing-hip-adduction-dumbbell.name: Standing Hip Adduction with Dumbbell
standing-hip-adduction-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, with feet hip-width apart. Hold onto a stable surface with your other hand for balance.
standing-hip-adduction-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly bring the weighted leg across your body, adducting at the hip toward the midline. Control the weight as you return to the starting position.

banded-hip-internal-rotation.name: Banded Hip Internal Rotation
banded-hip-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a bench with both knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on the floor, with a resistance band looped around both feet. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged.
banded-hip-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Keeping your right knee stationary, rotate your right foot inward against the band resistance, then return to center. Switch sides and repeat with controlled movements.

supine-adductor-stretch.name: Supine Adductor Stretch
supine-adductor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Position your feet hip-width apart with arms at your sides.
supine-adductor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Drop one knee outward to the side while keeping the other foot planted, feeling a gentle stretch along the inner thigh. Hold this position with controlled breathing.

banded-side-lying-hip-adduction.name: Banded Side-Lying Hip Adduction
banded-side-lying-hip-adduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both legs above the knees. Keep your bottom leg straight and your top leg bent with foot planted in front for stability.
banded-side-lying-hip-adduction.endPoseDescription: Lift your bottom leg upward against the band resistance, squeezing the inner thigh muscles. Hold briefly at the top before returning to the starting position.

seated-adductor-squeeze-with-band.name: Seated Adductor Squeeze with Band
seated-adductor-squeeze-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around a sturdy object at knee height in front of you. Place the band around the inside of both knees.
seated-adductor-squeeze-with-band.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your knees together against the band resistance, engaging the inner thigh muscles. Maintain the squeeze for 2 seconds before releasing.

standing-hip-abduction-with-band.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
standing-hip-abduction-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and hands on your hips for balance.
standing-hip-abduction-with-band.endPoseDescription: Step to the side against the band resistance while maintaining an upright posture. Return to center and repeat on the same side.

clam-shell-exercise-with-band.name: Clam Shell Exercise with Band
clam-shell-exercise-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees and a resistance band above both knees. Keep your feet together and lower leg stable.
clam-shell-exercise-with-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your upper knee upward, opening it like a clamshell while keeping feet together. Pause at the top before closing back down.

standing-adductor-stretch-against-wall.name: Standing Adductor Stretch Against Wall
standing-adductor-stretch-against-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or sturdy support with one hand on it for balance. Step your legs wide apart in a staggered stance.
standing-adductor-stretch-against-wall.endPoseDescription: Shift your weight toward one leg, bending that knee while keeping the other leg straight. Feel the stretch along the inner thigh of the straight leg.

banded-copenhagen-adductor-exercise.name: Banded Copenhagen Adductor Exercise
banded-copenhagen-adductor-exercise.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with hips stacked and a resistance band looped around both legs near the knees. Place your top leg's foot on the floor in front of your bottom leg.
banded-copenhagen-adductor-exercise.endPoseDescription: Lift your bottom leg up toward your top knee against the band resistance, focusing on inner thigh contraction. Lower with control and repeat.

prone-hip-adduction-lifts.name: Prone Hip Adduction Lifts
prone-hip-adduction-lifts.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with a resistance band looped around both legs above the knees. Rest your forehead on your hands and keep legs together initially.
prone-hip-adduction-lifts.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your inner thighs together against the band while lifting both legs slightly off the ground. Hold the contraction before releasing.

dynamic-adductor-stretch-with-hip-rotati.name: Dynamic Adductor Stretch with Hip Rotation
dynamic-adductor-stretch-with-hip-rotati.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet wide apart in a staggered stance with hands on your hips. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
dynamic-adductor-stretch-with-hip-rotati.endPoseDescription: Lunge toward one side while rotating your hips, feeling a dynamic stretch along the inner thigh. Return to center and alternate sides.

seated-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
seated-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and good posture. Keep your core gently engaged and shoulders relaxed.
seated-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and gently press the raised knee downward while leaning slightly forward. Feel the stretch in the outer hip and glute of the raised leg.

piriformis-stretch.name: Piriformis Stretch
piriformis-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to form a figure-4 shape.
piriformis-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the bottom knee toward your chest, which deepens the stretch in the piriformis muscle of the crossed leg. Hold this stretch to address deep hip tension.

standing-hip-flexor-march.name: Standing Hip Flexor March
standing-hip-flexor-march.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, maintaining good posture and a slight bend in your knees. You may hold onto a chair or wall for balance if needed.
standing-hip-flexor-march.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up toward your chest in a controlled manner, then lower it back down. Alternate legs in a slow, deliberate marching motion to improve hip mobility.

dumbbell-hip-thrusts.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrusts
dumbbell-hip-thrusts.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a dumbbell resting across your hips. Your arms are at your sides for support.
dumbbell-hip-thrusts.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels and lift your hips high, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders while holding the dumbbell secure. Squeeze your glutes firmly at the top before lowering.

seated-hip-rotation-stretch.name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
seated-hip-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent, foot placed on the outside of the extended knee. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
seated-hip-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently twist your torso toward the bent knee, using your opposite arm to increase the stretch. Hold the position while maintaining an upright posture.

ankle-alphabet.name: Ankle Alphabet
ankle-alphabet.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your injured leg extended straight out in front of you or resting on another chair. Keep your thigh still and relaxed.
ankle-alphabet.endPoseDescription: Using only your ankle and foot, trace letters of the alphabet in the air as if your toes are holding a pen. Move through the full range of motion available without pain.

seated-ankle-dorsiflexion-band.name: Seated Ankle Dorsiflexion with Band
seated-ankle-dorsiflexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your leg extended, a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot. Keep your knee straight and stable.
seated-ankle-dorsiflexion-band.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes toward your shin against the resistance of the band, creating tension in the front of the ankle. Hold briefly at the top of the range of motion.

prone-gastrocnemius-stretch.name: Prone Gastrocnemius Stretch
prone-gastrocnemius-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a mat or carpet with your forearms on the ground supporting your upper body. Your legs are extended behind you with toes pointing away.
prone-gastrocnemius-stretch.endPoseDescription: Press the tops of your feet into the ground to stretch your calves, keeping your hips on the mat. Maintain the stretch position while breathing steadily.

inversion-eversion-band.name: Inversion/Eversion with Band
inversion-eversion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended, a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot. Your knee remains straight and stable throughout.
inversion-eversion-band.endPoseDescription: Turn your foot inward (inversion) and outward (eversion) against the band resistance, moving through a comfortable range. Control the movement in both directions.

double-leg-glute-bridge.name: Double-Leg Glute Bridge
double-leg-glute-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Your arms are at your sides with palms facing down.
double-leg-glute-bridge.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top before lowering back down.

seated-hip-external-rotation.name: Seated Hip External Rotation
seated-hip-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg crossed over your opposite knee, forming a figure-4 position. Keep your back straight and posture neutral.
seated-hip-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently lean forward from the hips to deepen the stretch on the outer hip and glute of the crossed leg. Maintain steady breathing and hold the position without bouncing.

plantar-fascia-stretch-band.name: Plantar Fascia Stretch with Band
plantar-fascia-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended in front of you or crossed over the opposite knee. Wrap a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding both ends of the band in your hands.
plantar-fascia-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your body, flexing your toes back toward your shin while keeping your leg relatively straight. Hold the stretch feeling gentle tension along the bottom of your foot and arch.

calf-stretch-band-wall.name: Calf Stretch with Band Against Wall
calf-stretch-band-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with one leg forward in a lunge position and the back leg straight. Loop a resistance band around the ball of the back foot, holding the ends for assistance.
calf-stretch-band-wall.endPoseDescription: Lean gently forward, using the band to help keep your back heel grounded as you feel a stretch in the calf muscle of the back leg. Maintain an upright torso and steady breathing.

towel-curls-foot-intrinsics.name: Towel Curls for Foot Intrinsics
towel-curls-foot-intrinsics.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your bare foot flat on the floor on top of a small towel or cloth. Your foot should be relaxed with toes extended naturally.
towel-curls-foot-intrinsics.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes to scrunch the towel toward you, engaging the small muscles along the bottom of your foot and arch. Release and repeat, gradually pulling the towel incrementally closer.

ankle-dorsiflexion-band.name: Resistance Band Ankle Dorsiflexion
ankle-dorsiflexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with one leg extended or knee bent at 90 degrees. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the band in both hands.
ankle-dorsiflexion-band.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes upward toward your shin against the band resistance, creating tension along the front of your lower leg and the top of your foot. Slowly return to the starting position.

single-leg-balance-band.name: Single-Leg Balance with Band Support
single-leg-balance-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands, securing it to a sturdy object or wall mount at shoulder level. Your feet are hip-width apart.
single-leg-balance-band.endPoseDescription: Lift one foot slightly off the ground, balancing on the opposite leg while maintaining light tension on the band for stability. Keep your torso upright and gaze forward, engaging the muscles of your standing foot and arch.

short-foot-exercise.name: Short Foot Exercise
short-foot-exercise.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your bare foot flat on the floor in a neutral position. Your toes are relaxed and extended naturally.
short-foot-exercise.endPoseDescription: Shorten your foot by engaging the arch and drawing the ball of your foot toward your heel without curling your toes. Hold this contraction briefly, feeling the arch muscles engage and lift slightly.

calf-raises-band.name: Resistance Band Calf Raises
calf-raises-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped under the balls of both feet and holding the ends in your hands for tension. Your feet are hip-width apart and posture is tall.
calf-raises-band.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels while pressing down through the band resistance. Pause at the top, feeling the engagement in your calves and the soles of your feet.

hip-external-rotation-band.name: Seated Hip External Rotation with Band
hip-external-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee, forming a figure-4 position. Place a resistance band around the knee of the raised leg.
hip-external-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Gently press the raised knee outward against the band resistance, rotating at the hip to open up the hip flexor and external rotators. Maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.

seated-calf-raises.name: Seated Calf Raises
seated-calf-raises.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back against the chair and engage your core.
seated-calf-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise your heels off the ground while keeping the balls of your feet on the floor, lifting your calves up. Hold the peak position briefly before lowering back down.

standing-heel-raises.name: Standing Heel Raises
standing-heel-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands resting on a wall or chair for balance. Keep your shoulders relaxed and core engaged.
standing-heel-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as comfortable. Lower back down with control to the starting position.

supine-achilles-stretch.name: Supine Achilles Stretch
supine-achilles-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Use a towel or resistance band looped around the ball of one foot.
supine-achilles-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the towel or band toward your body, flexing your foot to stretch the calf and Achilles tendon. Keep your leg straight and hold the stretch without bouncing.

seated-calf-stretch.name: Seated Calf Stretch
seated-calf-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended in front of you and the other bent with foot on the floor. Keep your back upright against the chair.
seated-calf-stretch.endPoseDescription: Lean forward slightly and pull your extended foot's toes toward your shin, feeling a stretch along the back of your calf and Achilles tendon. Maintain the stretch for 20-30 seconds.

towel-scrunches.name: Towel Scrunches
towel-scrunches.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, placing a small towel on the ground in front of you. Keep your heel on the ground while your toes rest on the towel.
towel-scrunches.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes to scrunch the towel toward you, engaging the intrinsic foot muscles and supporting structures. Relax and repeat, gradually pulling more towel toward your heel.

standing-single-leg-balance.name: Standing Single-Leg Balance
standing-single-leg-balance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands resting on a wall or sturdy chair. Keep your core engaged and eyes focused on a fixed point.
standing-single-leg-balance.endPoseDescription: Lift one foot off the ground, balancing on the other leg while maintaining an upright posture. Hold the position for 10-30 seconds, using the chair for light support as needed.

seated-foot-inversion-resistance.name: Seated Foot Inversion with Resistance Band
seated-foot-inversion-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot with the other end anchored to a stable object at ankle height on the inside of your foot.
seated-foot-inversion-resistance.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn the sole of your foot inward (inversion), creating tension against the resistance band. Hold for 1-2 seconds at the end range of motion while maintaining control.

standing-single-leg-calf-raises.name: Standing Single-Leg Calf Raises
standing-single-leg-calf-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on one leg with your hands lightly touching a wall or rail for balance. Keep your core engaged and your standing leg slightly bent.
standing-single-leg-calf-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the ball of your foot, lifting your heel off the ground as high as possible. Lower back down with control and repeat on the same leg before switching sides.

dumbbell-deadlifts-posterior-chain.name: Dumbbell Deadlifts with Posterior Chain Focus
dumbbell-deadlifts-posterior-chain.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms straight. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
dumbbell-deadlifts-posterior-chain.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips while keeping your shins relatively vertical, lowering the dumbbells down the front of your legs. Feel a stretch in your hamstrings and calves as you descend, then drive through your heels to return to standing.

gastrocnemius-soleus-stretch.name: Gastrocnemius and Soleus Stretch
gastrocnemius-soleus-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with one leg extended behind you, heel planted firmly on the ground and toes pointing forward. Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height for support.
gastrocnemius-soleus-stretch.endPoseDescription: Keep your back leg straight and lean forward into the wall, feeling a stretch in the calf of the extended leg. Hold this position and feel the tension in the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles.

seated-anterior-tibialis-strengthening.name: Seated Anterior Tibialis Strengthening
seated-anterior-tibialis-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Place a light dumbbell on the top of one foot near the toes, or use a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot.
seated-anterior-tibialis-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes upward toward your shin against the resistance, engaging the muscles along the front of your lower leg. Hold briefly and lower back down with control.

single-leg-balance-unstable-surface.name: Single-Leg Balance on Unstable Surface
single-leg-balance-unstable-surface.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with your hands on your hips or extended for light balance assistance. Keep your core tight and your standing leg slightly bent at the knee.
single-leg-balance-unstable-surface.endPoseDescription: Maintain balance on one leg while keeping your gaze fixed on a point ahead to help with stability. Progress by closing your eyes or performing small upper body movements while maintaining single-leg balance.

arch-doming-foot-intrinsics.name: Arch Doming and Foot Intrinsic Strengthening
arch-doming-foot-intrinsics.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor, toes pointed forward. Relax your foot completely and focus on the arch region of the sole of your foot.
arch-doming-foot-intrinsics.endPoseDescription: Without curling your toes, contract the intrinsic muscles of your foot to create an arch dome from heel to ball of foot. This should feel like a gentle lift and shortening of the arch; hold for 2 seconds and release.

dumbbell-step-ups-stance-stability.name: Dumbbell Step-Ups with Emphasis on Stance Leg Stability
dumbbell-step-ups-stance-stability.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a sturdy step or bench with dumbbells held at your sides. Place one foot on the step with your weight distributed evenly across the entire foot.
dumbbell-step-ups-stance-stability.endPoseDescription: Drive through your front heel to step up onto the bench, bringing your rear foot to meet it. Slowly step back down with control, emphasizing stability through the foot and ankle of your stance leg.

seated-tibialis-posterior-activation-tow.name: Seated Tibialis Posterior Activation with Towel
seated-tibialis-posterior-activation-tow.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a small towel laid out flat on the floor in front of you. Place the ball of your foot on one end of the towel.
seated-tibialis-posterior-activation-tow.endPoseDescription: Using only your foot and toes, curl the towel toward you by scrunching your toes and engaging the tibialis posterior and intrinsic foot muscles. Relax and repeat, gradually pulling the entire towel under your foot.

calf-stretch-wall.name: Calf Stretches Against Wall
calf-stretch-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with your hands on the wall at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart. Place one leg forward with a slight knee bend and the other leg extended straight behind you.
calf-stretch-wall.endPoseDescription: Keep your back heel on the ground and lean forward into the wall to feel a stretch in the calf of the extended back leg. Maintain an upright torso.

ankle-inversion-eversion.name: Seated Ankle Inversion and Eversion
ankle-inversion-eversion.startPoseDescription: Sit with your back against a chair, one knee extended and the other bent slightly with foot flat. Keep your extended leg relaxed on a stool or ottoman.
ankle-inversion-eversion.endPoseDescription: Rotate your extended foot inward (inversion) and outward (eversion) in controlled, deliberate motions. Move through a comfortable range without pain.

toe-taps-elevated.name: Toe Taps with Foot Elevated
toe-taps-elevated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one leg extended on a bench or ottoman with your heel supported. Keep your toes pointing downward in a relaxed position.
toe-taps-elevated.endPoseDescription: Tap your toes upward repeatedly in a controlled manner, focusing on engaging the anterior tibialis muscle. Maintain your heel position without moving your leg.

quad-activation-towel.name: Quadriceps Activation with Towel Roll
quad-activation-towel.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with a rolled towel under one knee and the other leg extended flat on the floor. Keep your arms at your sides.
quad-activation-towel.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps of the leg with the towel roll by pressing the back of your knee downward into the towel. Hold the contraction while keeping your leg straight.

standing-march.name: Standing Marching in Place
standing-march.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with good posture, feet hip-width apart, and arms at your sides or ready to swing. Look straight ahead.
standing-march.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up to hip height while swinging the opposite arm forward in a marching motion. Alternate legs in a controlled, rhythmic pattern.

seated-ankle-inversion-with-band.name: Seated Ankle Inversion with Band
seated-ankle-inversion-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your legs extended in front of you on the floor or a bench. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding both ends with your hands.
seated-ankle-inversion-with-band.endPoseDescription: Pull your foot inward (inversion) against the band resistance, creating tension through the peroneal tendons. Hold briefly at the end range of motion.

standing-ankle-eversion-with-band.name: Standing Ankle Eversion with Band
standing-ankle-eversion-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both forefeet, with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Keep your core engaged for stability.
standing-ankle-eversion-with-band.endPoseDescription: Turn your feet outward (eversion) against the band resistance, actively engaging the peroneal muscles. Return to neutral position with control.

calf-stretch-with-band.name: Calf Stretch with Band
calf-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with one leg extended and loop a resistance band around the ball of that foot, holding the ends in both hands. Keep your knee straight.
calf-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your body to flex your foot upward (dorsiflexion), feeling a stretch in the calf and achilles tendon area. Hold for 30 seconds.

single-leg-balance-stable-surface.name: Single-Leg Balance on Stable Surface
single-leg-balance-stable-surface.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent, arms at your sides or extended for balance. Keep your gaze focused on a fixed point ahead.
single-leg-balance-stable-surface.endPoseDescription: Maintain a stable single-leg stance, engaging your peroneal muscles and ankle stabilizers. Keep your hips level and core tight throughout.

resisted-foot-eversion-side-lying.name: Resisted Foot Eversion in Side-Lying
resisted-foot-eversion-side-lying.startPoseDescription: Lie on your unaffected side with your bottom leg bent for stability and your top leg extended. Loop the band around both feet just above the toes.
resisted-foot-eversion-side-lying.endPoseDescription: Lift your top foot upward and outward against the band resistance, isolating the peroneal muscles. Lower with control and repeat.

seated-gastrocnemius-stretch.name: Seated Gastrocnemius Stretch
seated-gastrocnemius-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with both legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around one forefoot while keeping that knee straight.
seated-gastrocnemius-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band to bring your toes toward your shin, stretching the calf muscle. Hold for 30-45 seconds without bouncing.

peroneal-tendon-glide-with-band.name: Peroneal Tendon Glide with Band
peroneal-tendon-glide-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with one leg extended and wrap a band around your foot at the base of the toes. Support your calf with your other hand for stability.
peroneal-tendon-glide-with-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly plantarflex your foot (point toes away) while maintaining light band tension, promoting tendon mobility and reducing stiffness. Return to neutral and repeat.

supine-hip-marching.name: Supine Hip Marching
supine-hip-marching.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down for stability.
supine-hip-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one foot off the floor by raising your knee toward your chest in a marching motion. Alternate legs in a controlled manner, maintaining a steady rhythm.

standing-wall-marching.name: Standing Wall Marching
standing-wall-marching.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall at arm's length distance with your hands resting lightly on the wall for balance. Keep your feet hip-width apart and your posture upright.
standing-wall-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up toward your chest in a controlled marching motion, then lower it back down. Alternate legs in a steady, controlled manner while maintaining contact with the wall for support.

seated-ankle-inversion-eversion.name: Seated Ankle Inversion and Eversion
seated-ankle-inversion-eversion.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your injured leg extended out in front of you or resting on another chair. Keep your knee relaxed and your foot in a neutral position.
seated-ankle-inversion-eversion.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your foot inward (inversion) so the sole of your foot faces toward your other leg, then rotate outward (eversion) so the sole faces away. Move through the full comfortable range of motion without forcing.

standing-wall-push-ups.name: Standing Wall Push-Ups
standing-wall-push-ups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall at arm's length distance with your feet hip-width apart and hands placed on the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
standing-wall-push-ups.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and lean your body toward the wall in a controlled manner, then push back to the starting position. This modified push-up builds upper body and core strength with reduced ankle stress.

seated-glute-squeezes.name: Seated Glute Squeezes
seated-glute-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a firm chair with your back supported and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your hands resting on your thighs.
seated-glute-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your glute muscles as tightly as possible, holding the contraction for 2-3 seconds. Release and relax, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

standing-quad-sets-against-wall.name: Standing Quad Sets Against Wall
standing-quad-sets-against-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet hip-width apart, positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Keep your hands resting on your thighs.
standing-quad-sets-against-wall.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on top of your thigh by straightening your knee fully and pushing it back slightly into the wall. Hold the muscle contraction for 2-3 seconds, then relax.

calf-raises-dumbbells.name: Calf Raises with Dumbbells
calf-raises-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your weight is evenly distributed across the balls and heels of your feet.
calf-raises-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining an upright posture. Hold briefly at the top before lowering back down with control.

plantar-fascia-stretch.name: Plantar Fascia Stretch
plantar-fascia-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one leg crossed over the opposite knee. Your foot is elevated and accessible for hand manipulation.
plantar-fascia-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your toes back toward your shin with your hand, feeling a stretch along the bottom of your foot. Maintain a gentle, sustained stretch without bouncing.

toe-curls-resistance.name: Toe Curls with Resistance Band
toe-curls-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the ground and a light resistance band looped around all five toes. Your foot is relaxed with toes extended.
toe-curls-resistance.endPoseDescription: Curl all your toes downward against the resistance of the band, engaging the intrinsic foot muscles. Hold briefly before returning to the extended position.

single-leg-balance-hold.name: Single-Leg Balance Hold
single-leg-balance-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides or extended for balance. Weight is evenly distributed between both feet.
single-leg-balance-hold.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to approximately 90 degrees while maintaining upright posture. Engage your core and focus on stability through the standing foot.
