dumbbell-romanian-deadlifts.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlifts
dumbbell-romanian-deadlifts.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a slight bend in your knees. Your weight is distributed through the entire foot.
dumbbell-romanian-deadlifts.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine, lowering the dumbbells toward the ground and feeling a stretch in your hamstrings. Return to standing by driving through your feet.

seated-foot-alphabet.name: Seated Foot Alphabet
seated-foot-alphabet.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended or slightly raised, keeping the foot relaxed. Your knee is straight and the foot is positioned in front of you as if writing on an imaginary surface.
seated-foot-alphabet.endPoseDescription: Use your entire foot to trace the letters of the alphabet in the air, engaging all foot muscles through various ranges of motion. Continue through the entire alphabet to improve foot mobility and control.

seated-calf-stretches.name: Seated Calf Stretches
seated-calf-stretches.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the ground. One leg is positioned with the foot flat while the other is ready to be stretched.
seated-calf-stretches.endPoseDescription: Extend one leg straight out in front of you and gently pull your toes back toward your shin using a towel or your hand. Hold the stretch feeling it through your calf and foot.

intrinsic-foot-strengthening.name: Intrinsic Foot Muscle Strengthening
intrinsic-foot-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with bare feet flat on the floor, toes relaxed and spread naturally. Keep your heel in place throughout the exercise.
intrinsic-foot-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes downward to create an arch in your foot, shortening the distance from your heel to the base of your toes. Maintain the heel position without curling it.

towel-curl-foot.name: Towel Curl - Foot
towel-curl-foot.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with bare feet on a flat surface with a towel placed lengthwise in front of you. Rest your foot on one end of the towel with toes relaxed.
towel-curl-foot.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes to scrunch and pull the towel toward you, using only your foot and ankle muscles. Repeat the scrunching motion to draw the entire towel toward your body.

seated-dorsiflexion-band.name: Seated Dorsiflexion with Resistance Band
seated-dorsiflexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one leg extended and a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot, holding the band ends in both hands. Keep your knee slightly bent.
seated-dorsiflexion-band.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, creating tension in your shin muscles. Hold the contraction briefly before returning to the start position.

heel-walks.name: Heel Walks
heel-walks.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with arms at your sides or hands on a railing for light balance support. Lift your toes off the ground so your weight is on your heels.
heel-walks.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly with your toes pointing upward and heels on the ground, maintaining activation in your shin muscles. Continue walking at a controlled pace for the prescribed distance.

resistance-band-ankle-eversion.name: Resistance Band Ankle Eversion
resistance-band-ankle-eversion.startPoseDescription: Sit with both legs extended or one leg crossed over the other. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your affected foot with the other end anchored or held by your opposite hand.
resistance-band-ankle-eversion.endPoseDescription: Pull your foot outward (away from your body's midline) against the band resistance, keeping your heel stable. Hold briefly, then return to neutral with controlled movement.

resistance-band-ankle-inversion.name: Resistance Band Ankle Inversion
resistance-band-ankle-inversion.startPoseDescription: Sit with both legs extended and a resistance band looped around the ball of your affected foot, anchored on the outside. Your foot starts in a neutral or slightly everted position.
resistance-band-ankle-inversion.endPoseDescription: Turn your sole inward toward your body's midline against the band resistance, keeping your leg still. Hold briefly at the end position, then slowly return to neutral.

single-leg-balance-soft-surface.name: Single-Leg Balance on Soft Surface
single-leg-balance-soft-surface.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg on a soft, unstable surface such as a cushion, folded towel, or foam pad. Keep your arms out to the sides for balance and focus your eyes on a fixed point ahead.
single-leg-balance-soft-surface.endPoseDescription: Maintain balance on your affected leg while keeping your core engaged and torso upright. Your supporting ankle actively stabilizes through micro-adjustments to maintain equilibrium on the unstable surface.

resistance-band-dorsiflexion.name: Resistance Band Dorsiflexion
resistance-band-dorsiflexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected leg extended or slightly bent. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and hold both ends, with tension already in the band.
resistance-band-dorsiflexion.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, flexing at the ankle while keeping your leg stable. Hold briefly, then slowly lower back to the starting position.

tandem-stance-heel-to-toe.name: Tandem Stance (Heel-to-Toe)
tandem-stance-heel-to-toe.startPoseDescription: Stand with one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, with arms at your sides or extended for balance. Shift your weight evenly between both feet.
tandem-stance-heel-to-toe.endPoseDescription: Hold this narrow tandem stance while focusing on a point ahead, engaging your ankle stabilizers and core. Your ankle makes constant micro-adjustments to maintain balance in this challenging position.

resistance-band-plantarflexion.name: Resistance Band Plantarflexion
resistance-band-plantarflexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected leg extended or slightly bent in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and hold both ends with tension in the band.
resistance-band-plantarflexion.endPoseDescription: Press your foot downward and away from your body against the band resistance, pointing your toes. Hold briefly, then return slowly to the starting position with control.

wrist-flexor-stretch.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
wrist-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with your affected arm extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. Keep your elbow straight and your shoulders relaxed.
wrist-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently press the back of your hand downward, bending your wrist to point your fingers toward the floor. Hold this position feeling a stretch along the inside of your forearm.

wrist-extensor-stretch.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
wrist-extensor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with your affected arm extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up. Keep your elbow locked and your posture upright.
wrist-extensor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently pull your fingers back toward your body, extending your wrist backward. Feel the stretch along the top and outer side of your forearm.

gentle-wrist-flexion-strengthening.name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Strengthening
gentle-wrist-flexion-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or armrest, palm facing up with your hand hanging slightly off the edge. Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and supported.
gentle-wrist-flexion-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your fingers and hand upward toward your body, lifting only through the wrist joint. Pause briefly at the top, then lower back down to the starting position.

gentle-wrist-extension-strengthening.name: Gentle Wrist Extension Strengthening
gentle-wrist-extension-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or armrest, palm facing down with your hand hanging slightly off the edge. Keep your elbow supported and bent at 90 degrees.
gentle-wrist-extension-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your hand and fingers upward, extending through the wrist joint. Pause at the top, then lower back down in a controlled manner.

pronation-supination-strengthening.name: Pronation and Supination Strengthening
pronation-supination-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your body with your palm facing down. Imagine holding a hammer with your hand at a neutral position.
pronation-supination-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward, then rotate back to turn your palm downward in a slow, controlled twisting motion. Move only at the forearm and wrist, keeping your elbow fixed.

grip-strengthening-soft-ball.name: Grip Strengthening with Soft Ball
grip-strengthening-soft-ball.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected arm resting on your lap or table, holding a soft foam ball or stress ball in your hand. Your fingers should be relaxed around the ball.
grip-strengthening-soft-ball.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze the ball with your fingers and palm, creating moderate pressure without pain. Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds, then slowly release and repeat.

elbow-pendulum-swing.name: Elbow Range of Motion Pendulum
elbow-pendulum-swing.startPoseDescription: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and bend forward slightly at the waist, letting your affected arm hang down naturally from your shoulder. Keep your arm relaxed and loose.
elbow-pendulum-swing.endPoseDescription: Using a small pendulum motion from your shoulder, gently swing your arm forward and backward in a small arc. Allow gravity to assist the motion while keeping your elbow and wrist relaxed.

forearm-pronation-wall-walk.name: Forearm Pronation Wall Walk
forearm-pronation-wall-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall, about 12 inches away with your feet hip-width apart. Place your affected palm flat against the wall at waist height with your arm extended.
forearm-pronation-wall-walk.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm so your palm slowly rolls away from the wall, rotating outward as far as comfortable. Hold the end position, then rotate your palm back to face the wall.

pronation-supination-dumbbell.name: Pronation/Supination with Light Dumbbell
pronation-supination-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your torso, holding a light dumbbell with a neutral grip (handshake position). Your forearm is parallel to the ground.
pronation-supination-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn the palm upward (supination) or downward (pronation), moving only at the wrist and forearm. Return to neutral and repeat in the opposite direction.

wrist-extension-dumbbell.name: Wrist Extension with Dumbbell
wrist-extension-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or your thigh, palm facing downward, holding a light dumbbell. Your wrist hangs slightly beyond the edge of the support surface.
wrist-extension-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your hand upward by extending your wrist, raising the dumbbell toward the ceiling. Hold briefly at the top before lowering in a controlled manner.

reverse-wrist-curl-dumbbell.name: Reverse Wrist Curl with Dumbbell
reverse-wrist-curl-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing upward, holding a light dumbbell. Your wrist hangs slightly beyond the edge with the dumbbell at the starting position.
reverse-wrist-curl-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Curl your wrist upward, lifting the dumbbell toward your body using only wrist motion. Pause briefly at the top before lowering the weight back to the starting position.

elbow-flexion-dumbbell.name: Elbow Flexion with Dumbbell
elbow-flexion-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your arms at your sides, holding a light dumbbell in your affected arm with palm facing forward. Your elbow is fully extended but not locked.
elbow-flexion-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbow to bring the dumbbell up toward your shoulder in a slow, controlled bicep curl motion. Lower the weight back down with control.

forearm-supination-isometric.name: Forearm Supination Isometric Hold
forearm-supination-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your torso, palm facing upward, holding a light dumbbell. Your opposite hand is positioned to provide gentle resistance.
forearm-supination-isometric.endPoseDescription: Hold the supinated position (palm up) while your opposite hand applies gentle resistance, creating an isometric contraction. Maintain steady pressure without movement for the prescribed duration.

wrist-radial-ulnar-deviation.name: Wrist Radial and Ulnar Deviation
wrist-radial-ulnar-deviation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in a neutral position, holding a light dumbbell vertically like a hammer. Your wrist is in a neutral starting position.
wrist-radial-ulnar-deviation.endPoseDescription: Move your hand sideways toward your thumb (radial deviation) or toward your pinky finger (ulnar deviation) in controlled motions. Work through a comfortable range without forcing the movement.

grip-strengthening-dumbbell.name: Gentle Grip Strengthening with Dumbbell
grip-strengthening-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your arm resting on your lap, holding a light dumbbell with a neutral grip. Your hand is relaxed at the starting position.
grip-strengthening-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze your fingers around the dumbbell, creating moderate tension without pain. Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds before releasing to the starting position.

median-nerve-gliding.name: Median Nerve Gliding
median-nerve-gliding.startPoseDescription: Sit with your right arm at your side, elbow bent 90 degrees, palm facing inward. Keep your shoulder relaxed and your neck neutral.
median-nerve-gliding.endPoseDescription: Sequentially straighten your elbow, rotate your palm outward, extend your wrist, and gently lean your head away. This mobilizes the median nerve through its entire pathway.

grip-strengthening-therapy-ball.name: Grip Strengthening with Therapy Ball
grip-strengthening-therapy-ball.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a soft therapy ball in your right hand, arm resting on your lap. Your hand should be in a relaxed, neutral position.
grip-strengthening-therapy-ball.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the therapy ball firmly with all fingers and your palm, holding maximum grip for 3-5 seconds. Gradually release and repeat for controlled strengthening.

pronation-supination-light-weight.name: Pronation and Supination with Light Weight
pronation-supination-light-weight.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent 90 degrees and supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell (2-3 lbs) with a neutral grip. Your forearm is horizontal.
pronation-supination-light-weight.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces down (pronation), then reverse to palm facing up (supination). Control the movement throughout the full range of motion.

wrist-isometric-strengthening.name: Wrist Isometric Strengthening
wrist-isometric-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand hanging off the edge in a neutral position. Use your opposite hand to provide gentle resistance.
wrist-isometric-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Apply gentle pressure to resist wrist extension, flexion, radial deviation, and ulnar deviation for 6 seconds each without allowing movement. This builds stabilizer strength safely.

tendon-gliding-exercises.name: Tendon Gliding Exercises
tendon-gliding-exercises.startPoseDescription: Sit with your right hand relaxed and fingers extended on a table surface. Keep your wrist in a neutral position throughout the exercise.
tendon-gliding-exercises.endPoseDescription: Progress through hook fist, straight fist, and full fist positions, holding each for 1-2 seconds. This exercise helps flexor tendons move freely and prevents adhesions.

forearm-plank-knees.name: Forearm Plank on Knees
forearm-plank-knees.startPoseDescription: Start on your knees with forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders, and hands flat or in fists. Keep your core engaged and body in a straight line from knees to head.
forearm-plank-knees.endPoseDescription: Hold a static plank position, maintaining neutral wrist position and steady breathing. This builds core stability while gently conditioning the wrist in a supported position.

radial-ulnar-deviation-lightweight.name: Radial and Ulnar Deviation with Lightweight
radial-ulnar-deviation-lightweight.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell in neutral grip with hand hanging off the edge. Keep your elbow stationary throughout.
radial-ulnar-deviation-lightweight.endPoseDescription: Gently move your wrist toward your thumb (radial deviation) and then toward your pinky (ulnar deviation). Control the movement with light weight to strengthen side-to-side stabilizers.

thumb-abduction-band.name: Thumb Abduction with Band Resistance
thumb-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down with fingers relaxed. A resistance band is looped around your thumb and index finger.
thumb-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Pull your thumb away from your index finger against the band resistance, creating a 45-degree angle. Hold this position briefly before returning to start.

wrist-extension-band.name: Wrist Extension with Band
wrist-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing downward with your hand hanging slightly off the edge. A resistance band is wrapped around your hand.
wrist-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Extend your wrist upward against the band resistance, lifting your hand toward the ceiling. Pause at the top before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

thumb-flexor-stretch.name: Thumb Flexor Stretch
thumb-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with one arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up. Use your opposite hand to gently hold your thumb.
thumb-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your thumb backward and downward toward the inside of your wrist, creating a comfortable stretch along the thumb's base. Hold steady without forcing the movement.

forearm-rotation-band.name: Forearm Pronation/Supination with Band
forearm-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, upper arm against your body, palm facing down with a resistance band in your hand. Your forearm is parallel to the ground.
forearm-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces upward against light band resistance, then rotate back to palms down. Move slowly through the full range of motion.

grip-strengthening-band.name: Grip Strengthening with Band
grip-strengthening-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your arm resting at your side, holding a resistance band looped in your hand with fingers relaxed around it. Your palm faces inward.
grip-strengthening-band.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your fingers together to compress the band, engaging your grip muscles without pain. Release slowly and repeat for controlled repetitions.

wrist-deviation-band.name: Radial/Ulnar Deviation with Band
wrist-deviation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down with your hand extended beyond the edge. A resistance band is wrapped around your hand.
wrist-deviation-band.endPoseDescription: Move your hand sideways toward your thumb (radial deviation) against light band resistance, then return. Repeat the movement in the opposite direction slowly and controlled.

isometric-thumb-hold.name: Isometric Thumb Abduction Hold
isometric-thumb-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your hand relaxed on a table, thumb abducted away from your fingers at a 45-degree angle. A resistance band provides light pressure against your thumb.
isometric-thumb-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain your thumb position by resisting the band's pull back toward your fingers without moving. Hold this static contraction for the prescribed duration.

finger-flexion-exercises.name: Finger Flexion Exercises
finger-flexion-exercises.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Keep your fingers extended and relaxed.
finger-flexion-exercises.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl all fingers into a gentle fist, bending at each joint. Hold briefly without forcing any pain in the affected finger.

isolated-finger-extension.name: Isolated Finger Extension
isolated-finger-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand relaxed in a loose fist. Keep the affected finger gently curled.
isolated-finger-extension.endPoseDescription: Straighten only the affected trigger finger while keeping other fingers relaxed. Extend it fully without locking the joint.

gentle-finger-stretching.name: Gentle Finger Stretching
gentle-finger-stretching.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with one hand resting on your lap. Use your other hand to gently hold the affected finger at the base.
gentle-finger-stretching.endPoseDescription: Carefully extend the affected finger backward using gentle pressure from your other hand. Feel a mild stretch along the finger without pain.

finger-abduction-adduction.name: Finger Abduction and Adduction
finger-abduction-adduction.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand flat on a table, fingers spread slightly apart. Keep your palm and forearm relaxed against the table.
finger-abduction-adduction.endPoseDescription: Slowly spread all fingers apart, moving them away from the middle finger. Return to starting position and repeat without forcing movement.

warm-compress-rest.name: Warm Compress and Rest
warm-compress-rest.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably in a chair with your hand resting in your lap or on a table. Prepare to apply warm, moist heat to the affected hand.
warm-compress-rest.endPoseDescription: Hold a warm (not hot) compress or soak your hand in warm water for 5-10 minutes. Keep the hand relaxed and allow gentle circulation to the affected area.

passive-finger-range-motion.name: Passive Finger Range of Motion
passive-finger-range-motion.startPoseDescription: Sit with your affected hand supported on a table, palm facing down. Use your other hand to support under the affected finger.
passive-finger-range-motion.endPoseDescription: Gently bend the affected finger at each joint using your other hand for assistance. Move slowly through a comfortable range without forcing.

thumb-opposition-exercises.name: Thumb Opposition Exercises
thumb-opposition-exercises.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting on a table, all fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your thumb in a neutral position.
thumb-opposition-exercises.endPoseDescription: Touch your thumb to the tip of each finger one at a time, forming an O-shape. Perform this sequence slowly and smoothly through your entire hand.

wrist-circles-mobility.name: Wrist Circles and Mobility
wrist-circles-mobility.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your forearm supported on a table and your hand hanging relaxed off the edge. Keep your elbow stable.
wrist-circles-mobility.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your wrist in circular motions, moving through all directions. Complete circles in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions.

elbow-flexion-stretch.name: Elbow Flexion Stretch
elbow-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your affected arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. Your opposite hand is ready to assist.
elbow-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently press the back of your extended arm downward, creating a stretch along the anterior forearm and elbow. Hold this position with mild tension, avoiding sharp pain.

wrist-pronation-supination-dumbbell.name: Wrist Pronation/Supination with Dumbbell
wrist-pronation-supination-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or your leg, holding a light dumbbell vertically with your affected arm. Your elbow remains bent at 90 degrees and stationary throughout.
wrist-pronation-supination-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your forearm to turn the dumbbell from palm-down to palm-up position (or vice versa), using only wrist and forearm rotation. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.

gentle-wrist-flexion-stretch.name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Stretch
gentle-wrist-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected arm extended in front of you, palm facing upward. Your opposite hand is positioned to gently assist the stretch.
gentle-wrist-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly press the back of your extended hand downward with your opposite hand, creating a gentle stretch through the forearm. Keep your elbow straight but not locked, maintaining a comfortable stretch sensation.

supine-elbow-extension-dumbbell.name: Supine Elbow Extension with Light Dumbbell
supine-elbow-extension-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your affected elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell. Your upper arm is perpendicular to your body, and your forearm points toward the ceiling.
supine-elbow-extension-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly extend your elbow to straighten your arm while holding the dumbbell, maintaining control throughout the movement. Lower the weight back to the starting position in a controlled manner without locking the elbow.

ulnar-nerve-gliding.name: Nerve Gliding Exercises
ulnar-nerve-gliding.startPoseDescription: Sit with your affected arm at your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees, fist clenched. Your hand is relaxed and close to your body.
ulnar-nerve-gliding.endPoseDescription: Sequentially straighten your fingers, rotate your hand palm-up, straighten your elbow, and rotate your shoulder outward. Return to the starting position slowly, allowing the ulnar nerve to move freely through the elbow tunnel.

forearm-pronation-isometric.name: Forearm Pronation Isometric Hold
forearm-pronation-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm in neutral position (palm facing inward). Hold a light dumbbell with your hand.
forearm-pronation-isometric.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to a pronated position (palm facing downward) and hold this position isometrically against resistance. Maintain the position for 5-10 seconds without moving, then return to neutral.

posterior-elbow-stretch.name: Posterior Elbow Stretch
posterior-elbow-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and place your affected arm behind your back with elbow bent. Your opposite hand gently holds your affected elbow or forearm.
posterior-elbow-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your affected elbow toward the center of your back and slightly downward, creating a stretch in the posterior elbow region. Maintain this gentle stretch while keeping your posture upright.

bicep-curls-light-dumbbell.name: Bicep Curls with Light Dumbbell
bicep-curls-light-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your arm extended at your side. Your palm faces forward and your elbow stays close to your body.
bicep-curls-light-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl the dumbbell upward by bending your elbow, bringing your hand toward your shoulder. Lower the weight back down in a controlled manner, maintaining tension throughout the movement.

ulnar-nerve-mobilization.name: Ulnar Nerve Mobilization Stretch
ulnar-nerve-mobilization.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and position your affected arm at 90 degrees to your body with elbow extended. Your palm faces upward and your head is in neutral position.
ulnar-nerve-mobilization.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your head away from your affected side while maintaining the arm position, creating mild tension through the ulnar nerve pathway. Return to neutral and repeat, avoiding excessive stretch sensation.

wrist-flexion-stretch.name: Wrist Flexion Stretch
wrist-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table.
wrist-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press the back of your hand downward with your opposite hand, feeling a stretch along the inside of your forearm. Hold this position without bouncing.

wrist-extension-stretch.name: Wrist Extension Stretch
wrist-extension-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table.
wrist-extension-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press the palm of your hand downward with your opposite hand, feeling a stretch along the top of your forearm. Hold without forcing the stretch.

wrist-isometric-hold.name: Wrist Isometric Hold
wrist-isometric-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, wrist in neutral position with palm facing sideways. Your opposite hand is positioned to provide resistance.
wrist-isometric-hold.endPoseDescription: Press your wrist against the resistance of your opposite hand without allowing any movement to occur. Maintain this static contraction for the prescribed duration.

grip-strengthening-tennis-ball.name: Grip Strengthening with Tennis Ball
grip-strengthening-tennis-ball.startPoseDescription: Sit upright holding a soft tennis ball in your affected hand with your arm resting on your lap. Your fingers are relaxed around the ball.
grip-strengthening-tennis-ball.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the tennis ball firmly for 2-3 seconds using your entire hand and fingers. Release and return to the starting position.

radial-ulnar-deviation.name: Radial and Ulnar Deviation
radial-ulnar-deviation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table and your hand hanging off the edge in neutral position. Your thumb points upward.
radial-ulnar-deviation.endPoseDescription: Move your wrist side to side, bringing your thumb toward your body, then moving your pinky side toward your body in a controlled motion. Keep your forearm stable throughout.

wrist-pronation-supination.name: Wrist Pronation and Supination
wrist-pronation-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a light weight or hammer in your hand with your palm facing down. Your upper arm stays against your body.
wrist-pronation-supination.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm facing upward, then rotate back to palm down. Move slowly and controlled through the full range of motion.

finger-extension-resistance-band.name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band
finger-extension-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table and a resistance band looped around all your fingers. Your fingers are in a slightly flexed position.
finger-extension-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Straighten and spread all your fingers against the resistance of the band. Hold the extended position briefly before returning to the starting position.

wrist-circles-light-weight.name: Wrist Circles with Light Weight
wrist-circles-light-weight.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your arm extended out to the side at shoulder height, holding a light weight in your hand. Your wrist is in neutral position.
wrist-circles-light-weight.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your wrist in a circular motion, creating small circles in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions. Control the movement throughout the entire circle.

wrist-flexion-band.name: Wrist Flexion with Resistance Band
wrist-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Loop a resistance band around your hand just below the fingers.
wrist-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Curl your hand upward, bending at the wrist against the band resistance. Hold briefly at the top of the movement.

wrist-radial-deviation-band.name: Wrist Radial Deviation with Band
wrist-radial-deviation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand in neutral position holding one end of a resistance band. The band is anchored on the ulnar side.
wrist-radial-deviation-band.endPoseDescription: Move your hand toward the thumb side (radially) against the band resistance. Hold briefly at end range.

pronation-supination-band.name: Pronation/Supination with Band
pronation-supination-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a resistance band attached to a fixed point. Your palm starts facing down.
pronation-supination-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward, rotating against the band resistance. Return to starting position.

finger-flexion-extension.name: Finger Flexion and Extension
finger-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your hand relaxed in front of you, fingers extended straight. Your wrist is in neutral position.
finger-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Bend all fingers at the knuckles to make a gentle fist, then slowly extend them back straight. Move smoothly without forcing.

wrist-circles.name: Wrist Circles
wrist-circles.startPoseDescription: Sit with your arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, hand relaxed and open. Your fingers are slightly spread.
wrist-circles.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your hand in a complete circle, moving through full wrist range of motion. Complete circles in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions.

forearm-pronation-stretch.name: Forearm Pronation Stretch
forearm-pronation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit with your arm extended at shoulder height, palm facing down. Use your opposite hand to gently hold the back of your hand.
forearm-pronation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press your hand downward and hold, feeling a stretch through your forearm. Maintain a comfortable stretch without pain.

grip-strengthening-soft-object.name: Grip Strengthening with Soft Object
grip-strengthening-soft-object.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your forearm resting on a table or your lap, holding a soft sponge, stress ball, or towel in your hand. Your hand is in a relaxed open position.
grip-strengthening-soft-object.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze the soft object with moderate pressure without causing pain, holding for 2-3 seconds. Slowly release and return to the starting position.

isometric-wrist-hold.name: Isometric Wrist Hold
isometric-wrist-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand hanging slightly off the edge, palm facing down in a neutral position. Your opposite hand is ready to provide gentle resistance.
isometric-wrist-hold.endPoseDescription: Gently press your wrist upward against the resistance of your opposite hand without allowing any movement to occur. Hold this static contraction for 5-10 seconds without pain.

finger-extension-stretch.name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band Alternative
finger-extension-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand in a relaxed fist position. Your opposite hand is positioned to gently assist.
finger-extension-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your hand and extend your fingers straight out, then gently press your fingers back slightly with your opposite hand. Hold briefly and release.

forearm-self-massage.name: Forearm Self-Massage
forearm-self-massage.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected forearm resting on your lap or a table with the palm facing upward. Use your opposite hand to begin massage.
forearm-self-massage.endPoseDescription: Using your thumb and fingers, gently massage along the length of your forearm from your wrist to your elbow with slow, deliberate strokes. Focus on any tender areas with light to moderate pressure.

elbow-flexion-extension.name: Elbow Flexion and Extension
elbow-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your arm at your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees with palm facing forward. Keep your upper arm stationary against your body throughout the movement.
elbow-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly straighten your elbow fully, extending your forearm forward until your arm is nearly straight. Then bend the elbow back to the starting 90-degree position in a controlled manner.

pronation-supination.name: Pronation and Supination
pronation-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your side, palm facing down (pronated position). Keep your upper arm stable and only rotate at the forearm.
pronation-supination.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supinated position), then rotate back to palm-down. Move through the full range of motion available without forcing.

light-dumbbell-bicep-curl.name: Light Dumbbell Bicep Curl
light-dumbbell-bicep-curl.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing forward. Keep your elbows close to your body and core engaged.
light-dumbbell-bicep-curl.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl the dumbbells up by bending at the elbows until your hands reach shoulder height. Pause briefly at the top, then lower the weights back down in a controlled motion.

tricep-extension-dumbbell.name: Tricep Extension with Dumbbell
tricep-extension-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright holding a light dumbbell with both hands, raising it overhead with elbows bent at approximately 90 degrees. Your elbows should stay close to your head and relatively stationary.
tricep-extension-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Extend both elbows upward to straighten your arms overhead while holding the dumbbell. Lower the weight back down behind your head in a controlled manner, bending at the elbows.

passive-elbow-flexion-stretch.name: Passive Elbow Flexion Stretch
passive-elbow-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your right arm extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. Use your left hand to gently grasp your right wrist or forearm.
passive-elbow-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your right arm across your body and toward your chest, feeling a stretch along the back of your elbow and arm. Hold the stretch steady without bouncing or forcing the movement.

wrist-flexion-dumbbell.name: Wrist Flexion with Dumbbell
wrist-flexion-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, palm facing up, holding a light dumbbell in your hand with your wrist in a neutral position. Keep your forearm stable and in contact with your leg.
wrist-flexion-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your wrist upward to bend it back, lifting the dumbbell weight. Lower your wrist back down to the neutral position in a controlled motion, feeling the work in your forearm.

elbow-extension-stretch.name: Elbow Flexion Stretch with Towel
elbow-extension-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with your right arm raised overhead and bent at the elbow, so your hand drops behind your back. Relax your shoulders and maintain an upright posture.
elbow-extension-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently reach your left hand behind your head and pull your right elbow down and back, feeling a stretch along the front of your right arm and elbow. Hold the stretch without forcing deeper than comfortable.

dumbbell-hammer-curl.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
dumbbell-hammer-curl.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing your thighs (neutral grip). Keep your elbows stationary close to your body.
dumbbell-hammer-curl.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells upward by bending at the elbows while maintaining the neutral grip with palms facing each other. Bring the weights to shoulder height, then lower back down in a controlled motion.

standing-balance-one-leg.name: Standing Balance on One Leg
standing-balance-one-leg.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your hand on a wall or rail for light support if needed. Both feet are on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
standing-balance-one-leg.endPoseDescription: Lift your non-surgical leg off the ground, balancing on your surgical leg with the knee slightly bent. Maintain an upright posture and look straight ahead.

prone-knee-flexion-with-band.name: Prone Knee Flexion with Band
prone-knee-flexion-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the floor with a resistance band looped around your foot. Your arms are folded under your forehead for support.
prone-knee-flexion-with-band.endPoseDescription: Bend your knee and bring your foot toward your buttock, using the band for resistance. Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower back to starting position.

supine-hip-abduction-with-band.name: Supine Hip Abduction with Band
supine-hip-abduction-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. A resistance band is looped around both knees.
supine-hip-abduction-with-band.endPoseDescription: Push your knees outward against the band resistance, keeping your feet stationary. Squeeze your hip muscles at the end range, then slowly return to center.

seated-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Seated Hip Flexor Stretch
seated-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor. Your surgical leg is positioned on the chair.
seated-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lean your torso forward toward your thigh, keeping your back straight. Feel a stretch along the front of the hip and hold for 20-30 seconds.

standing-balance-on-one-leg.name: Standing Balance on One Leg
standing-balance-on-one-leg.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your hand on a wall or counter for light support. Your weight is evenly distributed on both feet.
standing-balance-on-one-leg.endPoseDescription: Slowly shift your weight onto your non-surgical leg and lift your surgical leg slightly off the ground. Hold this single-leg stance for 10-30 seconds while maintaining light contact with the wall.

supine-isometric-shoulder-hold.name: Supine Isometric Shoulder Hold
supine-isometric-shoulder-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with the repaired arm positioned at 45 degrees away from your body, elbow slightly bent. Your forearm points upward toward the ceiling.
supine-isometric-shoulder-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain the arm position without moving, gently activating the shoulder muscles. Hold this static position for the prescribed duration, focusing on controlled muscle engagement without pain.

supine-shoulder-abduction-slide.name: Supine Shoulder Abduction Slide
supine-shoulder-abduction-slide.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, palms facing down on the surface. Your shoulders are relaxed and in neutral alignment.
supine-shoulder-abduction-slide.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide the repaired arm out to the side, moving along the surface of the bed or floor to approximately 90 degrees of abduction. Slide back to the starting position in a controlled manner.

seated-shoulder-flexion-support.name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Support
seated-shoulder-flexion-support.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a firm chair with both arms resting on your thighs. Your spine is straight and your core is gently engaged.
seated-shoulder-flexion-support.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise the repaired arm forward and upward, moving only within your available pain-free range. Return the arm to your lap in a controlled motion, repeating for prescribed repetitions.

standing-postural-alignment.name: Standing Postural Alignment
standing-postural-alignment.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms hanging naturally at your sides. Notice your current shoulder position and posture.
standing-postural-alignment.endPoseDescription: Roll your shoulders backward and down, lengthening your neck and opening your chest. Hold this aligned position, focusing on maintaining neutral shoulder position throughout daily activities.

supine-chest-stretch.name: Supine Chest Stretch
supine-chest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your repaired arm positioned out to the side at 90 degrees, elbow slightly bent. Your uninvolved arm rests across your body.
supine-chest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently allow the weight of your arm to create a mild stretch across your chest and anterior shoulder. Maintain a comfortable stretch sensation without pain for the prescribed duration.

seated-elbow-flexion-assist.name: Seated Elbow Flexion Active Assist
seated-elbow-flexion-assist.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your repaired arm resting on your lap, elbow extended. Your uninvolved arm is positioned nearby to provide assistance.
seated-elbow-flexion-assist.endPoseDescription: Slowly bend your elbow, bringing your hand toward your shoulder while your uninvolved arm provides gentle support. Lower back down in a controlled manner.

supine-prone-walk.name: Supine Prone Walk
supine-prone-walk.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, legs extended. Your core is gently engaged and your spine maintains neutral alignment.
supine-prone-walk.endPoseDescription: Gently alternate tapping your feet in a marching motion, gradually increasing pace. Keep your repaired shoulder relaxed and avoid any compensatory tension in the arm.

dumbbell-deadlifts-light.name: Dumbbell Deadlifts (Light)
dumbbell-deadlifts-light.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms straight. Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
dumbbell-deadlifts-light.endPoseDescription: Hinge at your hips while maintaining a neutral spine, lowering the weights down your legs. Drive through your heels to return to standing position.

supine-knee-flexion.name: Supine Knee Flexion
supine-knee-flexion.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor or a bed. Keep your pelvis neutral and relaxed.
supine-knee-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slide your surgical heel toward your buttocks, bending the knee as far as comfortable without pain. Hold the position for 30 seconds then slowly return.

supine-hip-abduction-band.name: Supine Hip Abduction with Band
supine-hip-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees.
supine-hip-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Push your knees outward against the band resistance, keeping feet planted and core engaged. Hold briefly at the end of the movement, feeling tension in the hip abductors.

standing-hip-flexion-band.name: Standing Hip Flexion with Band
standing-hip-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a stable surface for light support, with a resistance band looped around one foot. Keep your standing leg straight with a slight knee bend for stability.
standing-hip-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Lift the banded leg forward by flexing at the hip, bringing the knee up to a comfortable height while maintaining an upright posture. Lower back to start position with control.
