supine-hip-rotation-band.name: Supine Hip Internal/External Rotation
supine-hip-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one hip and knee bent to 90 degrees, with a light resistance band around the thigh. Keep your lower back neutral and engaged.
supine-hip-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate the hip inward and outward within a comfortable range using the band for gentle guidance. Move slowly through your available range to restore rotational mobility without pain.

supine-hip-adduction-band.name: Supine Hip Adduction with Band
supine-hip-adduction-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both thighs above the knees.
supine-hip-adduction-band.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your knees inward against the band resistance while keeping feet flat on the ground. Hold the contracted position briefly, then release with control to engage the inner thigh stabilizers.

sidelying-hip-abduction-band.name: Sidelying Hip Abduction with Band
sidelying-hip-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with legs extended and stacked, with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your core engaged and head resting on your arm.
sidelying-hip-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Lift your top leg upward against band resistance while keeping the bottom leg planted and hips stacked. Feel the hip abductors and outer glute working throughout the lift.

standing-hip-extension-band.name: Standing Hip Extension with Band
standing-hip-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a stable surface with a resistance band looped around one foot, keeping your posture upright. Engage your core and hold the support surface lightly.
standing-hip-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Extend the banded leg backward against resistance while maintaining an upright torso and neutral spine. Squeeze the glute at the back of the movement before returning to the start position.

figure-four-stretch-band.name: Figure-4 Stretch with Band Assist
figure-four-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one knee bent and crossed over the opposite thigh in a figure-4 position. Place a band around the thigh of the bottom leg for gentle assistance.
figure-four-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the bottom leg's thigh toward your chest using the band, feeling a deep stretch in the outer hip and gluteal region of the crossed leg. Hold in a comfortable stretch position without forcing deeper movement.

scapular-squeezes.name: Scapular Squeezes
scapular-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and arms relaxed at your sides. Your shoulders are in a neutral position without tension.
scapular-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down, holding the contraction for 2-3 seconds. Your chest should open slightly and your posture should improve at the peak of the squeeze.

supine-shoulder-shrugs.name: Supine Shoulder Shrugs
supine-shoulder-shrugs.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms at your sides with palms facing down. Your shoulders are relaxed and in neutral position.
supine-shoulder-shrugs.endPoseDescription: Lift both shoulders up toward your ears, creating a shrug motion, and hold for 2 seconds. Slowly lower shoulders back down to the starting position.

supine-elbow-flexion.name: Supine Elbow Flexion with Arm Support
supine-elbow-flexion.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and the affected arm resting at your side with elbow extended. Place a small pillow under the affected arm for support.
supine-elbow-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly bend your elbow, bringing your hand toward your shoulder while keeping the upper arm in contact with the support. Pause at the top and slowly straighten the elbow.

standing-wall-slides.name: Standing Wall Slides
standing-wall-slides.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet 6 inches away from the wall, and arms at shoulder height with elbows bent 90 degrees. Your forearms are parallel to the ground.
standing-wall-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your forearms upward along the wall toward an overhead position, moving only within pain-free range. Pause briefly and slide back down to the starting position.

seated-torso-rotations.name: Seated Torso Rotations
seated-torso-rotations.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands crossed loosely over your chest. Your hips remain stable and facing forward.
seated-torso-rotations.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your torso to one side, allowing your shoulders and chest to turn while keeping hips stationary. Hold for 2 seconds and return to center, then repeat on the other side.

lying-side-rotation.name: Lying Affected Side Rotation with Pillow
lying-side-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your unaffected side with hips and knees slightly bent for stability, and place a pillow between your knees. Your affected arm is bent at the elbow and rests on your torso.
lying-side-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your affected shoulder backward, allowing your forearm to rotate upward toward the ceiling while keeping your elbow in contact with your torso. Stop at comfortable range and return.

seated-chin-tucks.name: Seated Chin Tucks
seated-chin-tucks.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture, eyes looking straight ahead, and shoulders relaxed. Your spine is neutral and supported against the chair back.
seated-chin-tucks.endPoseDescription: Gently tuck your chin inward, creating a slight double chin appearance, and hold for 2 seconds. Return to neutral without tilting your head up or down.

cervical-isometric-holds.name: Cervical Isometric Holds
cervical-isometric-holds.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place your hand gently against the side of your head at temple level.
cervical-isometric-holds.endPoseDescription: Apply gentle resistance with your hand while the neck muscles contract without moving the head. Hold the isometric contraction without allowing any neck motion.

scapular-squeeze-dumbbells.name: Scapular Squeeze with Dumbbells
scapular-squeeze-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Keep your neck in a neutral position with minimal movement.
scapular-squeeze-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Retract your shoulder blades together and slightly downward while maintaining arm position. Hold the contraction at the peak of scapular engagement.

supine-dumbbell-chest-press.name: Supine Dumbbell Chest Press
supine-dumbbell-chest-press.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and dumbbells held at chest level with elbows at 90 degrees. Ensure your head and neck remain supported and neutral.
supine-dumbbell-chest-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until arms are nearly extended. Maintain a neutral cervical spine throughout the pressing motion.

supine-bridge.name: Supine Bridge
supine-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep your neck relaxed and head supported by the floor.
supine-bridge.endPoseDescription: Lift your hips upward by driving through your heels until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. Hold at the top while maintaining neutral cervical alignment.

shoulder-shrugs.name: Shoulder Shrugs
shoulder-shrugs.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms relaxed and shoulders in a neutral position. Keep your neck and spine straight throughout the movement.
shoulder-shrugs.endPoseDescription: Elevate both shoulders toward your ears in a controlled shrugging motion, then lower them back down. Move through a full range of motion without neck flexion or extension.

gentle-finger-flexion.name: Gentle Finger Flexion Exercises
gentle-finger-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Keep your wrist in a neutral position with fingers fully extended.
gentle-finger-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your fingers inward to make a gentle fist, bending only at the knuckles without forcing. Hold briefly and return to the extended position.

forearm-rotation-pronation-supination.name: Supination and Pronation
forearm-rotation-pronation-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your side, holding a light weight or object in your hand. Start with your palm facing down.
forearm-rotation-pronation-supination.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces upward, then reverse the motion to face downward. Perform controlled rotations without forcing through discomfort.

scar-tissue-mobilization.name: Scar Tissue Mobilization
scar-tissue-mobilization.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, gently exposing the surgical incision site on your wrist or palm. Use your opposite hand to apply light pressure.
scar-tissue-mobilization.endPoseDescription: Gently massage the scar tissue in circular motions and along the incision line using moderate pressure. Move slowly to improve tissue mobility and reduce adhesions.

wrist-radial-deviation.name: Active Wrist Radial Deviation
wrist-radial-deviation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in a neutral position, palm facing downward. Keep your hand relaxed with fingers extended.
wrist-radial-deviation.endPoseDescription: Slowly move your wrist sideways, bending your thumb toward your forearm in a radial direction. Hold briefly at the end of the comfortable range.

towel-grip-release.name: Towel Grip and Release
towel-grip-release.startPoseDescription: Sit with a rolled towel on a table in front of you. Place your open hand flat on top of the towel with fingers extended and relaxed.
towel-grip-release.endPoseDescription: Curl your fingers to grip the towel, holding for 2-3 seconds without excessive force. Slowly release your grip and rest before repeating.

thumb-opposition.name: Thumb Opposition Exercise
thumb-opposition.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm facing upward with all fingers extended. Keep your wrist in a neutral position.
thumb-opposition.endPoseDescription: Slowly bring your thumb across to touch the tip of each finger sequentially, starting with the index finger and moving toward the pinky. Return to the open position between touches.

seated-ankle-plantarflexion-band.name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion with Band
seated-ankle-plantarflexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot with your heel resting on the ground.
seated-ankle-plantarflexion-band.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward against the band resistance, moving through a comfortable range of motion. Hold briefly at the end of the movement before returning to start position.

supine-ankle-dorsiflexion-band.name: Supine Ankle Dorsiflexion with Band
supine-ankle-dorsiflexion-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with legs extended and a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot. Keep your heel on the surface with your foot in a neutral position.
supine-ankle-dorsiflexion-band.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, achieving a comfortable dorsiflexed position. Control the return to neutral without allowing your foot to plantarflex.

supine-gluteal-bridge.name: Supine Gluteal Bridge
supine-gluteal-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Position feet approximately 12 inches from your buttocks.
supine-gluteal-bridge.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top and control the descent.

standing-quad-sets-band.name: Standing Quad Sets with Band
standing-quad-sets-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your knee and the other end anchored low behind you. Keep your knee slightly bent and core engaged.
standing-quad-sets-band.endPoseDescription: Straighten your knee against the band resistance, fully extending your leg while maintaining an upright posture. Hold at full extension before slowly returning to the starting position.

standing-supported-marching.name: Standing Supported Marching
standing-supported-marching.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or sturdy surface with both hands lightly supporting yourself. Distribute your weight evenly on both feet with good posture.
standing-supported-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up toward hip height while maintaining balance on the standing leg. Alternate sides in a controlled marching motion, avoiding excessive pressure on the healing ankle.

prone-hip-extension-band.name: Prone Hip Extension with Band
prone-hip-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a comfortable surface with a resistance band looped around both feet. Rest your forehead on your arms to maintain neutral spine alignment.
prone-hip-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg upward against the band resistance, extending at the hip while keeping your pelvis stable. Hold briefly at the top before lowering in a controlled manner and alternating sides.

seated-hamstring-stretch-band.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch with Band
seated-hamstring-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one leg extended in front of you and the other knee bent with foot on the floor. Place a resistance band around the ball of your extended foot, holding both ends.
seated-hamstring-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band to bring your extended leg closer to your torso, feeling a comfortable stretch along the back of your thigh. Maintain an upright spine and avoid forcing the stretch.

prone-hamstring-isometric.name: Prone Hamstring Isometric Hold
prone-hamstring-isometric.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a firm surface with legs extended straight behind you. Place your forehead on your hands for comfort and support.
prone-hamstring-isometric.endPoseDescription: Gently contract your hamstring by pressing the back of your thigh into the floor without moving your leg. Hold this isometric contraction for the prescribed duration.

supine-bridge-hold.name: Supine Bridge Hold
supine-bridge-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down.
supine-bridge-hold.endPoseDescription: Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Contract your hamstrings and glutes at the top of the movement.

seated-forward-fold.name: Seated Forward Fold
seated-forward-fold.startPoseDescription: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Keep your spine tall and shoulders relaxed.
seated-forward-fold.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips and gently fold forward, allowing your hands to reach toward your shins or feet. Maintain a slight knee bend to avoid overstretching the healing tissue.

standing-hip-hinge.name: Standing Hip Hinge
standing-hip-hinge.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine.
standing-hip-hinge.endPoseDescription: Bend forward at the hips while keeping your back straight, lowering your torso until you feel a gentle stretch in the hamstrings. Return to standing by driving through your heels.

supine-glute-activation.name: Supine Glute Activation
supine-glute-activation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned directly under your knees. Arms are at your sides.
supine-glute-activation.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your glute muscles tightly for 2-3 seconds, then release. This activation supports hamstring function and prevents compensation patterns during recovery.

quadruped-leg-lift.name: Quadruped Leg Lift
quadruped-leg-lift.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-leg-lift.endPoseDescription: Lift the unaffected leg behind you, keeping it straight and level with your hip. Squeeze the glute and hamstring gently, then lower without touching the floor.

tibialis-anterior-strengthening.name: Tibialis Anterior Strengthening
tibialis-anterior-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Your back is against the chair and core is engaged.
tibialis-anterior-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes upward toward your shins, lifting the ball of your foot off the ground while keeping your heel planted. Feel the contraction along the front of your lower leg.

lateral-band-walks-with-dumbbells.name: Lateral Band Walks with Dumbbells
lateral-band-walks-with-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, knees slightly bent in a quarter-squat position. Your chest is up and core is engaged.
lateral-band-walks-with-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Step sideways while maintaining the quarter-squat position, moving one foot laterally followed by the other. Continue moving laterally while keeping tension in your glutes and outer hips.

seated-leg-lifts.name: Seated Leg Lifts
seated-leg-lifts.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your back against the backrest, feet flat on the floor, and knees bent at 90 degrees. Your posture is tall and core engaged.
seated-leg-lifts.endPoseDescription: Straighten one leg fully, lifting it up to hip height or slightly higher while keeping your thigh on the chair. Feel the contraction in your quadriceps throughout the movement.

hip-flexor-stretches.name: Hip Flexor Stretches
hip-flexor-stretches.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the other leg stepped forward, foot flat on the ground. Keep your torso upright.
hip-flexor-stretches.endPoseDescription: Shift your weight forward, feeling a stretch in the front of your back hip. Maintain an upright posture throughout.

resistance-band-internal-rotation.name: Resistance Band Internal Rotation
resistance-band-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, holding a resistance band with both hands. Keep your upper arm stationary against your ribcage throughout the movement.
resistance-band-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm inward across your body against the band resistance while maintaining the 90-degree elbow bend. Hold briefly at the end of the range of motion.

resistance-band-horizontal-abduction.name: Resistance Band Horizontal Abduction
resistance-band-horizontal-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you at shoulder height, holding a resistance band stretched between your hands. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
resistance-band-horizontal-abduction.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your arms outward to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching upward.

resistance-band-row.name: Resistance Band Row
resistance-band-row.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart on a resistance band, holding the ends with both hands and arms extended downward in front of you. Maintain a neutral spine and slight knee bend throughout the movement.
resistance-band-row.endPoseDescription: Pull the band upward by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Bring your hands to chest height with elbows tucked close to your body.

doorway-shoulder-stretch.name: Doorway Shoulder Stretch
doorway-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your right arm raised to 90 degrees and forearm resting against the doorframe. Position your body so you face the doorframe.
doorway-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently step forward through the doorway, allowing your chest to stretch as your arm stays anchored on the frame. Feel the stretch across your anterior shoulder and chest.

resistance-band-shoulder-flexion.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Flexion
resistance-band-shoulder-flexion.startPoseDescription: Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends at your sides with arms extended downward. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed.
resistance-band-shoulder-flexion.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms forward and upward to shoulder height against the band resistance, leading with your thumbs. Control the movement and avoid arching your lower back.

resistance-band-lateral-raise.name: Resistance Band Lateral Raise
resistance-band-lateral-raise.startPoseDescription: Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends at your sides with arms extended downward and a slight elbow bend. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
resistance-band-lateral-raise.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height against the band resistance, maintaining the slight elbow bend. Lower with control and avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

supine-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Supine Shoulder External Rotation
supine-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, palm facing your head. Keep your upper arm perpendicular to your body.
supine-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your forearm toward the floor behind your head, rotating at the shoulder to create external rotation. Stop at the point of gentle stretch without forcing the movement.

prone-shoulder-i-y-t-raises.name: Prone Shoulder I-Y-T Raises
prone-shoulder-i-y-t-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down with your forehead resting on a rolled towel and arms at your sides with palms facing down. Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
prone-shoulder-i-y-t-raises.endPoseDescription: Perform three arm positions: (I) raise arms overhead, (Y) raise arms at 45-degree angles, (T) raise arms out to sides. Hold each position briefly, lifting only a few inches off the ground using shoulder muscles.

scapular-wall-slides.name: Scapular Wall Slides
scapular-wall-slides.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall with feet about 12 inches away, knees slightly bent. Place your arms against the wall at shoulder height with elbows bent to 90 degrees.
scapular-wall-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your arms upward along the wall, straightening your elbows as you move toward an overhead position. Slide back down to the starting position, maintaining contact with the wall throughout.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

prone-shoulder-blade-squeezes.name: Prone Shoulder Blade Squeezes
prone-shoulder-blade-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down with your forehead on a rolled towel and arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your legs straight and relaxed on the ground.
prone-shoulder-blade-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together by pulling them down and back toward your spine, lifting your chest slightly off the ground. Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds, focusing on the muscles between your shoulder blades.

supine-shoulder-blade-retractions.name: Supine Shoulder Blade Retractions
supine-shoulder-blade-retractions.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms at 90 degrees to your body with elbows slightly bent and palms facing up.
supine-shoulder-blade-retractions.endPoseDescription: Press the backs of your arms and shoulders into the floor, retracting your shoulder blades toward your spine. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then relax and repeat.

posterior-shoulder-doorway-stretch.name: Posterior Shoulder Doorway Stretch
posterior-shoulder-doorway-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your affected arm raised and forearm against the doorframe at 90 degrees. Position your elbow at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
posterior-shoulder-doorway-stretch.endPoseDescription: Step forward through the doorway, allowing your shoulder and chest to stretch as you gently lean into the stretch. Feel the stretch across the front and back of your shoulder without pain.

glute-bridge-dumbbell.name: Glute Bridge with Dumbbell
glute-bridge-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a dumbbell resting across your hips. Your arms should be at your sides with palms down for stability.
glute-bridge-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top while keeping your lower back neutral.

single-leg-deadlift-dumbbell.name: Single-Leg Deadlift with Dumbbell
single-leg-deadlift-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on your left leg holding a dumbbell in your right hand at your side with a slight knee bend. Keep your core engaged and shoulders back.
single-leg-deadlift-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips while extending your right leg behind you for counterbalance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Your torso and back leg should form a straight line parallel to the floor.

dumbbell-row.name: Dumbbell Row
dumbbell-row.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine with a slight forward hinge at the hips.
dumbbell-row.endPoseDescription: Pull both dumbbells up toward your ribcage by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your elbows close to your body and maintain the hip hinge position.

pallof-press-dumbbell.name: Pallof Press with Dumbbell
pallof-press-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, perpendicular to your torso. Keep your core tight and shoulders squared forward.
pallof-press-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbell directly away from your chest, fully extending your arms while resisting rotation of your torso. Return to chest and repeat on the opposite side.

quadruped-hip-circle.name: Quadruped Hip Circle
quadruped-hip-circle.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with a neutral spine, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Lift one knee slightly off the ground.
quadruped-hip-circle.endPoseDescription: Draw slow, controlled circles with your lifted knee in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions, maintaining core stability. Keep your pelvis level and torso still throughout the movement.

suitcase-carry-dumbbell.name: Suitcase Carry with Dumbbell
suitcase-carry-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side with your arm extended, shoulders level and squared. Engage your core to prevent side bending.
suitcase-carry-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Walk forward while maintaining an upright posture and resisting the urge to lean away from the weight. Keep your shoulders packed and core braced throughout the movement.

ankle-plantarflexion-band.name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion with Resistance Band
ankle-plantarflexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the ends in your hands.
ankle-plantarflexion-band.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward and away from your body against the resistance of the band. Hold briefly and return to the starting position with control.

ankle-inversion-band.name: Lateral Ankle Inversion with Resistance Band
ankle-inversion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended or bent at the knee. Loop a resistance band around the forefoot and hold the ends with your hands.
ankle-inversion-band.endPoseDescription: Turn the sole of your foot inward toward the midline of your body against the band resistance. Hold briefly and return to neutral with control, repeating for prescribed reps.

ankle-eversion-band.name: Lateral Ankle Eversion with Resistance Band
ankle-eversion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended or bent at the knee. Loop a resistance band around the forefoot and hold the ends with your hands.
ankle-eversion-band.endPoseDescription: Turn the sole of your foot outward away from the midline of your body against the band resistance. Hold briefly and return to neutral with control, repeating for prescribed reps.

single-leg-balance-foam.name: Single-Leg Balance on Foam Pad
single-leg-balance-foam.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on a foam balance pad or unstable surface with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides. Distribute your weight evenly on both feet.
single-leg-balance-foam.endPoseDescription: Lift your uninjured leg slightly off the ground and balance on your injured ankle on the foam pad for 20-30 seconds. Maintain stability by engaging your core and focusing on a fixed point.

resistance-band-adduction.name: Resistance Band Adduction
resistance-band-adduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your unaffected side with both legs extended and a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your torso stable and core engaged.
resistance-band-adduction.endPoseDescription: Press the top leg down against the resistance of the band, squeezing your inner thigh muscles. Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

prone-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.name: Prone Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
prone-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on the floor with your forearms supporting your upper body. Bend one knee and bring that foot toward the opposite side of your body.
prone-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Keep the bent knee flexed and allow it to rest on or near the floor on the opposite side, feeling a deep stretch in the groin and outer hip of the bent leg.

seated-figure-4-stretch.name: Seated Figure-4 Stretch
seated-figure-4-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Bend one knee and place that ankle across the opposite leg's thigh, forming a figure-4 shape.
seated-figure-4-stretch.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining an upright spine, bringing your torso toward the bent leg. Feel the stretch deepen in the hip and groin of the bent leg.

glute-bridge-hold.name: Glute Bridge Hold
glute-bridge-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and parallel. Arms rest at your sides with palms down.
glute-bridge-hold.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top position. Hold momentarily, ensuring a straight line from knees through hips to shoulders.

finger-isolation-lifts.name: Finger Isolation Lifts
finger-isolation-lifts.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down with fingers extended. Keep all fingers relaxed and in contact with the table.
finger-isolation-lifts.endPoseDescription: Lift one finger at a time off the table while keeping others flat. Raise each finger about half an inch and hold for 2 seconds.

forearm-pronation-supination.name: Forearm Pronation and Supination
forearm-pronation-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your body, palm facing up (supinated position). Keep your forearm steady.
forearm-pronation-supination.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your forearm to turn your palm face down (pronated position). Then rotate back to palm up, moving only at the wrist and forearm.

upper-extremity-pendulum-swings.name: Upper Extremity Pendulum Swings
upper-extremity-pendulum-swings.startPoseDescription: Stand with your affected arm hanging relaxed at your side. Bend slightly at the waist to allow your arm to swing freely.
upper-extremity-pendulum-swings.endPoseDescription: Allow your arm to swing gently forward and backward like a pendulum. Keep the movement small and pain-free, driven by slight body movements.

neck-shoulder-relaxation.name: Neck and Shoulder Relaxation
neck-shoulder-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with good posture. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arms resting in your lap.
neck-shoulder-relaxation.endPoseDescription: Slowly drop your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a gentle stretch on the left side of your neck. Hold for 15-20 seconds, then switch sides.

step-ups-with-dumbbells.name: Step-Ups with Dumbbells
step-ups-with-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a step or low platform (12-18 inches) holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Plant your foot firmly on the step with your whole foot making contact.
step-ups-with-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Drive through your front heel to step up, bringing your back leg up so that it nearly straightens as you reach full height. Your knee tracks over your toes and your core remains engaged at the top position.

single-leg-deadlifts-with-dumbbells.name: Single-Leg Deadlifts with Dumbbells
single-leg-deadlifts-with-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg while holding dumbbells at your sides, with a slight bend in your standing knee. Your non-working leg is relaxed and your gaze is fixed forward to maintain balance.
single-leg-deadlifts-with-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips while extending your free leg behind you for counterbalance, lowering the dumbbells toward the ground. Your torso and extended leg form a nearly straight line as you reach the bottom position.

dumbbell-curtsy-lunges.name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunges
dumbbell-curtsy-lunges.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart and your weight evenly distributed. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.
dumbbell-curtsy-lunges.endPoseDescription: Step diagonally backward and across your body, lowering into a lunge while keeping your front knee tracking over your toes. Return to start by driving through your front heel, engaging your glutes and quads.

prone-iyt-raises.name: Prone I-Y-T Raises
prone-iyt-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or floor with arms at your sides and forehead resting on a towel. Your legs are extended with toes on the ground for stability.
prone-iyt-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms in an I-position (overhead), then Y-position (45 degrees), then T-position (90 degrees), squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of each movement.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

neck-isometric-holds.name: Neck Isometric Holds
neck-isometric-holds.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and your hands placed against the side of your head. Your neck is in a neutral position looking straight ahead.
neck-isometric-holds.endPoseDescription: Gently press your head against your hand while resisting the movement, creating an isometric contraction. Hold for 5-10 seconds, then repeat in forward, backward, and opposite side directions.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

reverse-pec-deck-flyes.name: Reverse Pec Deck Flyes
reverse-pec-deck-flyes.startPoseDescription: Sit on a reverse pec deck machine with your chest against the pad and hands gripping the handles at shoulder height. Your shoulders are relaxed and arms are bent slightly.
reverse-pec-deck-flyes.endPoseDescription: Pull the handles backward in a controlled arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement. Slowly return to the starting position.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

band-pull-aparts.name: Band Pull-Aparts
band-pull-aparts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands. Your arms are extended straight out in front of you with a slight bend in the elbows.
band-pull-aparts.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and slightly backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

resistance-band-rows.name: Resistance Band Rows
resistance-band-rows.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor and loop a resistance band around a fixed point at chest height. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at shoulder width.
resistance-band-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping your elbows close to your ribs. Your chest should be lifted and your shoulders drawn back.

resistance-band-pull-aparts.name: Resistance Band Pull-Aparts
resistance-band-pull-aparts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended in front of you. The band should be taut but not stretched at the starting position.
resistance-band-pull-aparts.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward while keeping your arms at shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your arms should open into a wide V-shape with the band at chest level.

upper-back-strengthening-band.name: Upper Back Strengthening with Band
upper-back-strengthening-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a looped resistance band at waist level with both hands. Your arms should be straight down with a slight bend at the elbows and the band at rest.
upper-back-strengthening-band.endPoseDescription: Lift the band upward and outward in a controlled motion, bringing it up to shoulder height while squeezing your upper back muscles. Your elbows should remain slightly bent throughout the movement.

scapular-retractions.name: Scapular Retractions
scapular-retractions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your back against a chair or wall, arms at your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Hold a resistance band with both hands, maintaining slight tension in the band.
scapular-retractions.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and pull the band apart slightly by moving your hands apart. Focus on the retraction of your scapulae rather than arm strength.

posterior-neck-stretch-band.name: Posterior Neck Stretch with Band
posterior-neck-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around the back of your head at about ear level, holding both ends of the band in your hands. Keep your neck in a neutral position.
posterior-neck-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band forward, allowing your chin to tuck slightly as you feel a stretch in the back of your neck and upper cervical spine. Maintain gentle, steady pressure without forcing the stretch.

thoracic-extension-band.name: Thoracic Extension with Band
thoracic-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around your upper back at shoulder blade height, holding both ends across your chest. Your shoulders should be relaxed and your spine neutral.
thoracic-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Gently arch your upper back while keeping the band secured, allowing your chest to open and your shoulders to roll back slightly. Your head should follow the natural extension of your spine without tilting back.

resistance-band-reverse-fly.name: Resistance Band Reverse Fly
resistance-band-reverse-fly.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bent knees, holding a resistance band with both hands at waist level in front of your body. Your arms should be extended straight with a slight bend at the elbows.
resistance-band-reverse-fly.endPoseDescription: Lift the band up and out to the sides in a sweeping motion until your arms are at shoulder height, squeezing your rear shoulders and upper back. Your chest should be open and your posture tall throughout the movement.

scapular-squeeze-prone.name: Scapular Squeeze (Prone)
scapular-squeeze-prone.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a firm surface with arms at your sides, palms facing down. Your forehead rests on a rolled towel to keep your neck neutral.
scapular-squeeze-prone.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together by lifting your chest slightly off the ground. Hold this position while keeping your neck relaxed and aligned.

seated-upper-back-stretch.name: Seated Upper Back Stretch
seated-upper-back-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
seated-upper-back-stretch.endPoseDescription: Round your upper back and drop your chin toward your chest while gently pulling your clasped hands forward. You should feel a stretch across your upper back and between your shoulder blades.

supine-shoulder-blade-retraction.name: Supine Shoulder Blade Retraction
supine-shoulder-blade-retraction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Arms are extended straight up toward the ceiling with palms facing each other.
supine-shoulder-blade-retraction.endPoseDescription: Press your upper back and shoulders down into the floor while reaching your arms slightly higher. You should feel your shoulder blades drawing down and together.

thoracic-spine-rotation.name: Thoracic Spine Rotation
thoracic-spine-rotation.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
thoracic-spine-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee in a controlled twisting motion. Return to center and repeat on the other side, improving upper back mobility.

cervical-retraction-resistance.name: Cervical Retraction with Resistance
cervical-retraction-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and place your hand against your chin. Your neck is in a neutral position.
cervical-retraction-resistance.endPoseDescription: Pull your chin straight back against the resistance of your hand while your hand provides gentle opposing pressure. Hold for 3 seconds without allowing your head to tilt.

levator-scapulae-stretch.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
levator-scapulae-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and place your right hand behind your head at the base of your skull. Your shoulders are relaxed and back.
levator-scapulae-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your head down and rotate your chin toward your right armpit to stretch the left side of your neck. Maintain a relaxed posture throughout the hold.

thoracic-extension-stretch.name: Thoracic Spine Extension Stretch
thoracic-extension-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and clasp your hands behind your head with your elbows wide. Your feet are flat on the floor.
thoracic-extension-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently arch your upper back and press your chest forward while extending through your thoracic spine. Keep your lower back neutral and avoid overextending your lumbar region.

dumbbell-shrugs.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
dumbbell-shrugs.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Your shoulders are relaxed and your chest is up.
dumbbell-shrugs.endPoseDescription: Raise your shoulders up toward your ears in a shrugging motion while keeping your arms straight. Hold the peak position briefly, then lower your shoulders back down with control.

postural-wall-hold.name: Postural Wall Hold
postural-wall-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall with heels, glutes, and shoulders all touching the wall. Your neck should be in neutral alignment with your head also touching the wall.
postural-wall-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain contact with the wall at all five points while taking slow, deep breaths. Hold this corrected posture for the prescribed duration to build postural awareness and strength.

neck-isometric-hold.name: Neck Isometric Hold
neck-isometric-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with perfect posture and place your hand against one side of your head. Your neck is in a neutral position.
neck-isometric-hold.endPoseDescription: Push your head firmly against your hand without allowing any movement to occur, creating an isometric contraction. Hold for 10-15 seconds, then repeat on the opposite side.

prone-hip-extensions.name: Prone Hip Extensions
prone-hip-extensions.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the floor with your forehead resting on your hands and legs extended straight behind you. Keep your core engaged to prevent lower back arching.
prone-hip-extensions.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg up toward the ceiling while keeping your pelvis stable and core tight, raising the leg 12-18 inches off the ground. Hold briefly at the top then lower with control.

quadriceps-stretching.name: Quadriceps Stretching
quadriceps-stretching.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and use one hand on a wall or object for balance. Bend one knee and bring your foot toward your glutes.
quadriceps-stretching.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your bent knee closer to your body, keeping your knees aligned and avoiding any inward or outward rotation. Feel a stretch along the front of the thigh.

hamstring-stretching.name: Hamstring Stretching
hamstring-stretching.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg extended on the floor and the other knee bent with foot flat. Use a strap, towel, or your hands around the bent knee's thigh.
hamstring-stretching.endPoseDescription: Gently straighten the bent leg toward the ceiling while keeping the opposite leg relaxed on the floor. Feel a stretch along the back of the raised leg's thigh.

abdominal-bracing.name: Abdominal Bracing
abdominal-bracing.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Maintain a neutral spine with your lower back slightly touching the floor.
abdominal-bracing.endPoseDescription: Draw your navel toward your spine, tightening your core muscles as if preparing to be punched, while maintaining normal breathing. Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds without holding your breath.

prone-shoulder-squeeze.name: Prone Shoulder Squeeze
prone-shoulder-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a mat with your forehead resting on a towel and arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your legs extended with toes pointing down.
prone-shoulder-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your chest slightly off the ground while keeping your neck neutral. Hold this position while engaging your upper back muscles.

band-rows.name: Band Rows
band-rows.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band at arm's length in front of you with both hands. Keep your core engaged and maintain a neutral spine.
band-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your torso by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your elbows should stay close to your ribs as you complete the rowing motion.

seated-thoracic-rotation.name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
seated-thoracic-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair or bench with feet flat on the floor. Cross your arms across your chest, with your right hand touching your left shoulder and left hand touching your right shoulder.
seated-thoracic-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to the right as far as comfortably possible, keeping your hips stable and facing forward. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

doorway-pectoral-stretch.name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
doorway-pectoral-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your right arm raised to 90 degrees, placing your forearm against the door frame. Your body faces straight ahead with good posture.
doorway-pectoral-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently step forward through the doorway, allowing your body to rotate slightly to the left while maintaining contact with the door frame. You will feel a stretch across your chest and front shoulder.

prone-scapular-retraction.name: Prone Scapular Retraction
prone-scapular-retraction.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down with arms extended overhead on the floor, palms down. Your legs are extended with your forehead resting on the floor.
prone-scapular-retraction.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together as you lift your arms slightly off the ground and pull your elbows toward your hips. Hold briefly at the peak contraction.

overhead-shoulder-press.name: Overhead Shoulder Press
overhead-shoulder-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Your core is engaged and your spine is neutral.
overhead-shoulder-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells directly overhead until your arms are fully extended without locking elbows. Your shoulders are packed down and away from your ears.

chest-opener-stretch.name: Chest Opener Stretch
chest-opener-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and interlace your fingers behind your back at hip level. Your shoulders are relaxed and your posture is upright.
chest-opener-stretch.endPoseDescription: Straighten your arms and gently lift your clasped hands away from your body, opening your chest. Feel a stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders.

neck-flexor-release.name: Neck Flexor Release
neck-flexor-release.startPoseDescription: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and shoulders relaxed. Place one hand gently on top of your head near the opposite ear.
neck-flexor-release.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your head toward the hand, allowing gravity to deepen the stretch along the side of your neck. Hold and breathe deeply before switching sides.

single-leg-dumbbell-deadlift.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Deadlift
single-leg-dumbbell-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand at your side. Your standing leg is stable and your core is engaged.
single-leg-dumbbell-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hip while extending your free leg behind you for balance, allowing the dumbbell to travel down your standing leg. Return to standing and repeat.

wall-angel-stretch.name: Wall Angel Stretch
wall-angel-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 6 inches away from the base. Your arms are at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees against the wall.
wall-angel-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your arms up the wall as high as comfortable while keeping your back and arms in contact with the wall. Lower and repeat for mobility and shoulder opening.

thoracic-rotation.name: Thoracic Rotation
thoracic-rotation.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Place one hand behind your head with elbow pointing out to the side.
thoracic-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso, bringing your elbow toward the opposite side of your body while keeping your hips stable. Return to center and repeat on the other side.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

butterfly-stretch.name: Butterfly Stretch
butterfly-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out to the sides, forming a diamond shape with your legs. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
butterfly-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently hinge forward from the hips while keeping your back straight, pressing your knees toward the floor. Feel a deep stretch in the inner thighs and hips.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

shoulder-crossover-stretch.name: Shoulder Crossover Stretch
shoulder-crossover-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides in a neutral position. Maintain an upright posture with shoulders relaxed.
shoulder-crossover-stretch.endPoseDescription: Bring one arm across your body at shoulder height and use your opposite hand to gently pull your elbow closer to your chest. Keep your shoulders level and feel the stretch in the back of your shoulder.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

childs-pose.name: Child's Pose
childs-pose.startPoseDescription: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels with knees wider than hip-width apart. Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
childs-pose.endPoseDescription: Fold forward, extending your arms ahead and lowering your forehead to the floor or a cushion. Relax into the stretch, feeling length through your entire back and shoulders.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

spinal-twist.name: Spinal Twist
spinal-twist.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms spread out to the sides in a T position. Keep your back flat against the floor.
spinal-twist.endPoseDescription: Drop both knees to one side while keeping your shoulders flat on the floor and head in a neutral position. Feel a gentle twist through your spine and torso.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

banded-hip-abduction.name: Banded Hip Abduction
banded-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your core engaged and hands on your hips for balance.
banded-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Press your right knee outward against the band resistance while keeping your torso upright and left leg straight. Hold briefly at the end range of motion before returning to start.
