banded-clamshells.name: Banded Clamshells
banded-clamshells.startPoseDescription: Lie on your right side with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees and your knees bent at 45 degrees. Stack your hips and keep your core engaged.
banded-clamshells.endPoseDescription: Open your left knee toward the ceiling while keeping your feet together and hips stable. Pause briefly at the top to feel the glute activation before closing your knee.
conditions_seen_in: hip fracture prevention exercises for elderly

banded-hip-bridge.name: Banded Hip Bridge
banded-hip-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Place arms at your sides with palms down.
banded-hip-bridge.endPoseDescription: Press through your feet to lift your hips toward the ceiling while pushing your knees outward against the band resistance. Hold at the top for 1-2 seconds, squeezing your glutes before lowering.
conditions_seen_in: hip fracture prevention exercises for elderly

90-90-hip-flexor-stretch.name: 90-90 Hip Flexor Stretch
90-90-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot planted in front of you, both legs bent at 90 degrees. Keep your torso upright and core engaged.
90-90-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently shift your weight forward, increasing the stretch in your right hip flexor and quad. Maintain an upright posture and feel the stretch deepen as you hold this position for 20-30 seconds.

banded-lateral-walk.name: Banded Lateral Walk
banded-lateral-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Slightly bend your knees and keep your torso upright with hands on your hips.
banded-lateral-walk.endPoseDescription: Step your right foot out to the side while maintaining tension on the band and keeping your knees bent. Step your left foot back to hip-width apart, then repeat in the opposite direction.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

thoracic-rotation-quadruped.name: Thoracic Rotation in Quadruped
thoracic-rotation-quadruped.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Place your left hand behind your head with elbow pointing out to the side.
thoracic-rotation-quadruped.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to bring your left elbow toward your right knee, then rotate to open your chest and look up toward the ceiling. Move through the rotation in a controlled manner.

seated-spinal-twist.name: Seated Spinal Twist
seated-spinal-twist.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor with legs extended in front of you. Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
seated-spinal-twist.endPoseDescription: Twist your torso to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently pressing to deepen the twist. Keep your spine tall as you rotate.
conditions_seen_in: osteoporosis safe exercise program for 70 year old

standing-doorway-chest-stretch.name: Standing Doorway Chest Stretch
standing-doorway-chest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a doorway or wall with your right arm raised to 90 degrees with elbow bent, forearm vertical. Step your right foot forward into the doorway.
standing-doorway-chest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your torso to the left, feeling a stretch across your chest and front shoulder. Keep your arm position steady and maintain upright posture.

thread-the-needle-stretch.name: Thread the Needle Stretch
thread-the-needle-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure-4 position.
thread-the-needle-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your left thigh toward your chest, feeling a stretch in your right upper back and shoulder. Keep your head relaxed on the floor throughout.

standing-trunk-rotation.name: Standing Trunk Rotation
standing-trunk-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Cross your arms over your chest with each hand on the opposite shoulder.
standing-trunk-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your torso to the right, keeping your hips facing forward and arms crossed. Return to center, then rotate to the left in a controlled manner.

tall-kneeling-quad-stretch.name: Tall Kneeling Quadriceps Stretch
tall-kneeling-quad-stretch.startPoseDescription: Kneel on the floor with your knees hip-width apart and torso upright. Hands can be placed on your thighs or behind you for balance.
tall-kneeling-quad-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press your hips forward while maintaining tall posture. This stretch opens the hip flexors and improves ankle dorsiflexion mobility.

dumbbell-goblet-squat.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
dumbbell-goblet-squat.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
dumbbell-goblet-squat.endPoseDescription: Lower your body into a squat by bending at the knees and hips, keeping the dumbbell at chest level and weight in your heels. Descend as deep as ankle mobility allows while maintaining upright posture.

ankle-circles-balance.name: Ankle Circles with Single Leg Balance
ankle-circles-balance.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, arms out to sides for balance. Keep your standing leg stable and engaged.
ankle-circles-balance.endPoseDescription: Lift the opposite foot slightly off the ground and draw circles in both directions with your toes. This improves ankle stability and mobility simultaneously.

half-kneeling-ankle-mobility.name: Half-Kneeling Ankle Mobility Stretch
half-kneeling-ankle-mobility.startPoseDescription: Assume a half-kneeling position with one foot forward and hands on the ground. The forward foot should be flat on the ground with knee bent at 90 degrees.
half-kneeling-ankle-mobility.endPoseDescription: Drive your front knee forward over your toes while keeping your heel grounded, creating dorsiflexion at the ankle. Hold this position to improve ankle mobility for squatting.

dumbbell-lateral-lunge.name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunges
dumbbell-lateral-lunge.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet together holding dumbbells at your sides, chest up and core engaged. Maintain an upright posture with weight distributed evenly.
dumbbell-lateral-lunge.endPoseDescription: Step out to one side and bend that knee into a lunge position while keeping the other leg straight. The laterally bent leg should push your ankle through its full range of motion.

seated-toe-touches.name: Seated Toe Touches with Flexion/Extension
seated-toe-touches.startPoseDescription: Sit on the floor with legs extended in front of you, back straight and core engaged. Keep your hands beside you or reaching forward slightly.
seated-toe-touches.endPoseDescription: Point your toes away from you (plantarflex) then pull them toward you (dorsiflex) in a controlled manner. Perform multiple repetitions to systematically improve ankle mobility in both directions.

prone-t-y-i-holds.name: Prone T-Y-I Holds
prone-t-y-i-holds.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with your chest at the edge and feet on the ground for stability. Your arms hang toward the floor with a slight bend in the elbows.
prone-t-y-i-holds.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms to form a 'T' shape (90 degrees from body), then lift to a 'Y' shape (135 degrees), and finally to an 'I' shape (180 degrees overhead). Squeeze your shoulder blades at each position.

half-kneeling-landmine-press.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
half-kneeling-landmine-press.startPoseDescription: Kneel with your right knee down and left foot forward in a half-kneeling position, facing the landmine. Hold the landmine bar at shoulder height with both hands.
half-kneeling-landmine-press.endPoseDescription: Press the bar diagonally upward and forward, extending your arms while maintaining a neutral spine. Control the descent back to shoulder height.

shoulder-dislocate-with-band.name: Shoulder Dislocate with Band
shoulder-dislocate-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a resistance band with hands shoulder-width apart at hip height. Your arms are extended straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
shoulder-dislocate-with-band.endPoseDescription: In one continuous motion, raise the band up and overhead, then back behind your body in a wide arc. Keep your arms straight and move through a full range of motion.

worlds-greatest-stretch.name: World's Greatest Stretch
worlds-greatest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Step your right foot forward into a lunge position.
worlds-greatest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Drop your left elbow toward the ground inside your right foot, then rotate your torso to open your chest toward the ceiling while reaching your right arm overhead.

glute-bridge-with-band.name: Glute Bridge with Band
glute-bridge-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms are at your sides.
glute-bridge-with-band.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling while maintaining tension on the band. Your body should form a straight line from knees to shoulders at the top.

banded-shoulder-dislocations.name: Banded Shoulder Dislocations
banded-shoulder-dislocations.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with a wide grip in front of your thighs. Keep your arms straight.
banded-shoulder-dislocations.endPoseDescription: Raise the band overhead in a wide arc, allowing it to pass behind your head and shoulders until it reaches your back. Reverse the motion back to the starting position.

banded-pallof-press.name: Banded Pallof Press
banded-pallof-press.startPoseDescription: Stand perpendicular to an anchor point with the band looped around a sturdy object at chest height. Hold the band with both hands at your chest with knees slightly bent.
banded-pallof-press.endPoseDescription: Press the band straight out in front of you, resisting rotation through your core. Your torso should remain squared forward as your arms extend fully.

banded-woodchop.name: Banded Woodchop
banded-woodchop.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at your left shoulder height. Your arms are slightly bent.
banded-woodchop.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso diagonally across your body, bringing the band down and across toward your right hip in a controlled chopping motion. Return to start and repeat on the opposite side.

inchworms.name: Inchworms
inchworms.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Bend forward at the waist with a slight knee bend.
inchworms.endPoseDescription: Walk your hands out to a plank position while keeping your legs relatively straight. Walk your feet back toward your hands and return to standing.

arm-circles.name: Arm Circles
arm-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your core engaged and maintain an upright posture.
arm-circles.endPoseDescription: Complete a full circular motion, rotating both arms forward in controlled circles. The movement should be smooth and gradually increase in size.

leg-swings-forward-back.name: Leg Swings Forward and Back
leg-swings-forward-back.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Keep your torso upright and engage your core.
leg-swings-forward-back.endPoseDescription: Swing the free leg forward and backward in a controlled pendulum motion, allowing momentum to carry the movement. Keep the swinging leg relatively straight with a slight knee bend.

hip-circles.name: Hip Circles
hip-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place hands on your hips or extended for balance. Maintain an upright posture with a slight knee bend.
hip-circles.endPoseDescription: Move hips in a large circular motion, creating full circles in both directions. Keep the movement slow and controlled to mobilize the hip joint.

bodyweight-squats.name: Bodyweight Squats
bodyweight-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended forward for balance, and chest upright. Keep your weight distributed evenly across both feet.
bodyweight-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your chest up and weight in your heels. Return to standing position with controlled movement.

walking-lunges.name: Walking Lunges
walking-lunges.startPoseDescription: Stand tall with feet together and hands on hips or extended for balance. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
walking-lunges.endPoseDescription: Step forward and lower your body until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees, then step forward with the opposite leg. Keep your torso upright throughout the movement.

standing-marching-in-place.name: Standing Marching in Place
standing-marching-in-place.startPoseDescription: Stand tall with feet together, arms at your sides, and good posture maintained. Engage your core for stability.
standing-marching-in-place.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward your chest while swinging the opposite arm forward, then alternate in a controlled marching motion. Gradually increase pace while maintaining balance and upright posture.

standing-torso-rotations.name: Standing Torso Rotations
standing-torso-rotations.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent, with hands crossed over your chest or behind your head. Maintain an upright posture with engaged core.
standing-torso-rotations.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso side to side, allowing your arms to swing naturally with the movement. Keep your hips stationary while rotating only at the spine.

standing-quad-stretch.name: Standing Quad Stretch
standing-quad-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and good posture. Engage your core for stability.
standing-quad-stretch.endPoseDescription: Pull one foot toward your glutes while keeping knees aligned and hips level. Feel a gentle stretch along the front of the thigh.

hamstring-stretch-forward-fold.name: Hamstring Stretch Forward Fold
hamstring-stretch-forward-fold.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms at your sides. Maintain a neutral spine.
hamstring-stretch-forward-fold.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips and fold forward, letting your upper body hang toward the ground. Keep knees slightly bent and relax into the stretch.

hip-flexor-stretch-low-lunge.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Low Lunge
hip-flexor-stretch-low-lunge.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the other foot stepped forward, hands resting on the front thigh. Keep your torso upright.
hip-flexor-stretch-low-lunge.endPoseDescription: Gently press your hips forward while keeping your core tight and back straight. Feel a deep stretch along the front of the back leg's hip.

shoulder-cross-body-stretch.name: Shoulder Cross Body Stretch
shoulder-cross-body-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and bring one arm across your body at shoulder height. Keep your posture upright.
shoulder-cross-body-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently pull the arm closer to your chest. Relax into the stretch across the back of the shoulder and upper back.

plank.name: Plank
plank.startPoseDescription: Position yourself face-down with forearms on the ground, elbows directly under shoulders, and legs extended with toes on the floor. Your body should form a straight line from head to heels.
plank.endPoseDescription: Hold your body in a rigid plank position with your core fully engaged, glutes squeezed, and neutral spine throughout. Maintain even weight distribution across forearms and toes.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

side-plank.name: Side Plank
side-plank.startPoseDescription: Lie on your right side with your right forearm on the ground, elbow directly under your shoulder, and legs extended stacked on top of each other. Your body is in a straight diagonal line.
side-plank.endPoseDescription: Lift your hips up off the ground, creating a straight line from head to feet while engaging your core and obliques. Hold this position with your upper body perpendicular to the ground.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

superman-hold.name: Superman Hold
superman-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on the floor with your arms extended overhead and legs straight, forehead neutral on the ground. Your entire body is in contact with the floor.
superman-hold.endPoseDescription: Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the ground, engaging your lower back and glutes. Hold briefly while maintaining a neutral head position and avoiding excessive arching.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

tandem-stance-hold.name: Tandem Stance Hold
tandem-stance-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet together, arms at sides or extended forward for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.
tandem-stance-hold.endPoseDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, maintaining upright posture. Hold steady for the prescribed duration.

sit-to-stand-with-band.name: Sit-to-Stand with Band Assistance
sit-to-stand-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a firm chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your hands at chest height. Lean slightly forward with a neutral spine.
sit-to-stand-with-band.endPoseDescription: Push through your feet to stand up while gently pulling on the band for additional support. Stand fully upright with good posture before lowering back down.

resistance-band-bicep-curls.name: Resistance Band Bicep Curls
resistance-band-bicep-curls.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and step on the center of a resistance band. Hold the band ends at your sides with palms facing forward and arms straight.
resistance-band-bicep-curls.endPoseDescription: Curl your hands toward your shoulders by bending at the elbows while keeping upper arms stationary. Squeeze your biceps at the top before lowering with control.

heel-to-toe-walking.name: Heel-to-Toe Walking
heel-to-toe-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with arms extended to the sides for balance or lightly touching a wall. Look ahead and maintain good posture.
heel-to-toe-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly, placing your heel down first followed by rolling through to your toes. Keep steps deliberate and controlled while maintaining balance.

resistance-band-chest-press.name: Resistance Band Chest Press
resistance-band-chest-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and wrap a resistance band around your upper back, holding the ends at chest height with elbows bent. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
resistance-band-chest-press.endPoseDescription: Push the band forward by extending your arms straight ahead while maintaining neutral spine. Return to chest height with controlled resistance.

modified-wall-push-ups.name: Modified Wall Push-ups
modified-wall-push-ups.startPoseDescription: Stand arm's length away from a wall with feet hip-width apart. Place both palms flat against the wall at shoulder height.
modified-wall-push-ups.endPoseDescription: Bend elbows and lean your body toward the wall in a controlled manner. Keep your core engaged and maintain a straight line from head to heels.

pelvic-floor-activation.name: Pelvic Floor Activation
pelvic-floor-activation.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably in a chair with feet flat on the ground and spine in neutral position. Relax all muscles and take a deep breath.
pelvic-floor-activation.endPoseDescription: Gently contract the pelvic floor muscles as if stopping the flow of urination. Hold for 2-3 seconds while continuing to breathe normally.

gentle-neck-stretches.name: Gentle Neck Stretches
gentle-neck-stretches.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and facing forward. Keep your eyes level and jaw unclenched.
gentle-neck-stretches.endPoseDescription: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a gentle stretch on the left side of your neck. Hold briefly and repeat on the other side.

ankle-circles.name: Ankle Circles
ankle-circles.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably in a chair with one leg extended or crossed over the other knee. Keep your upper body relaxed.
ankle-circles.endPoseDescription: Rotate your foot slowly in circular motions, making complete circles in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions. Move through the full range of motion.

dumbbell-chest-press.name: Dumbbell Chest Press
dumbbell-chest-press.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
dumbbell-chest-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until your arms are nearly extended. Lower the weights back to chest height in a controlled manner.

dumbbell-lateral-raises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
dumbbell-lateral-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing inward. Maintain good posture with a slight bend in your knees.
dumbbell-lateral-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows until they reach shoulder height. Lower the weights back to your sides in a controlled manner.

barbell-back-squats.name: Barbell Back Squats
barbell-back-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell resting across your upper back and shoulders. Your chest is upright and core is engaged.
barbell-back-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the ground. Your weight remains centered in your heels with knees tracking over your toes.

weighted-lunges.name: Weighted Lunges
weighted-lunges.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your core is braced and shoulders are back.
weighted-lunges.endPoseDescription: Step forward and lower your body until your front knee is bent to 90 degrees and your back knee nearly touches the ground. Push through your front heel to return to start.

deadlifts.name: Deadlifts
deadlifts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on the ground close to your shins. Your back is straight, chest up, and shoulders slightly in front of the bar.
deadlifts.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to stand upright, lifting the barbell to thigh height. Your shoulders are back and spine remains neutral throughout.

weighted-step-ups.name: Weighted Step-ups
weighted-step-ups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a sturdy bench or step holding dumbbells at your sides. Your posture is upright with core engaged.
weighted-step-ups.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the bench with one leg, driving through that heel to lift your body fully onto the platform. The opposite leg follows to complete the movement.

jump-squats.name: Jump Squats
jump-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in an athletic stance. Your arms are at your sides and core is engaged.
jump-squats.endPoseDescription: Explosively jump upward while driving your arms overhead, then land softly back into a squat position. Absorb the impact through your legs and repeat dynamically.

weighted-calf-raises.name: Weighted Calf Raises
weighted-calf-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your core is engaged and posture is tall.
weighted-calf-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels several inches off the ground. Pause at the top before lowering back down with control.

walking-lunges-with-twist.name: Walking Lunges with Twist
walking-lunges-with-twist.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a weight plate or dumbbell at chest height with both hands. Your feet are hip-width apart and core is braced.
walking-lunges-with-twist.endPoseDescription: Step forward into a lunge while rotating your torso over the front leg, then return to standing and repeat on the opposite side. The rotation engages your core while lunging strengthens your legs.

box-jumps.name: Box Jumps
box-jumps.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform with feet hip-width apart. Your arms are ready to swing and core is engaged.
box-jumps.endPoseDescription: Explosively jump upward, landing softly on the box with both feet. Stand fully upright at the top, then step back down to the starting position.

banded-squats.name: Banded Squats
banded-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band looped under both feet and held at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
banded-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending at the knees and hips as if sitting back into a chair, keeping the band taut. Return to standing position by driving through your heels.

banded-chest-press.name: Banded Chest Press
banded-chest-press.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with the resistance band wrapped around your mid-back, holding both ends at chest level with elbows bent. Keep your shoulders relaxed and back straight.
banded-chest-press.endPoseDescription: Press both arms forward, extending the band until arms are nearly straight. Slowly return to the starting position with controlled movement.

banded-rows.name: Banded Rows
banded-rows.startPoseDescription: Sit with legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet or mid-shin, holding both ends with arms extended. Keep your back straight and shoulders back.
banded-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your torso by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Extend your arms back to the starting position.

banded-bicep-curls.name: Banded Bicep Curls
banded-bicep-curls.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, standing on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Hold both ends of the band at your sides with palms facing forward.
banded-bicep-curls.endPoseDescription: Curl both hands upward toward your shoulders while keeping elbows stationary and close to your body. Lower the band with control back to the starting position.

banded-lateral-raises.name: Banded Lateral Raises
banded-lateral-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, stepping on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Hold both ends at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward.
banded-lateral-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, maintaining a slight bend in the elbows. Lower back down with control to the starting position.

banded-glute-bridges.name: Banded Glute Bridges
banded-glute-bridges.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped just above your knees. Place your arms at your sides with palms down.
banded-glute-bridges.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while pressing outward against the band. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower back down.

standing-hamstring-curls.name: Standing Hamstring Curls
standing-hamstring-curls.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around one foot, holding the other end of the band or a stable surface for balance. Keep your standing leg straight and core tight.
standing-hamstring-curls.endPoseDescription: Bend the knee of the banded leg, bringing your heel up toward your glutes against the band resistance. Lower back down with control and repeat before switching legs.

banded-standing-kickbacks.name: Banded Standing Kickbacks
banded-standing-kickbacks.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or holding onto a stable surface with a resistance band looped around one leg just above the knee. Keep your torso still and core engaged.
banded-standing-kickbacks.endPoseDescription: Kick the banded leg backward against the resistance without arching your lower back. Return to starting position with control and repeat before switching legs.

banded-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Banded Shoulder External Rotation
banded-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, holding one end of a resistance band that is anchored at elbow height. Keep your elbow firmly against your rib cage.
banded-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward against the band resistance, moving only at the shoulder joint. Return to the starting position with control and repeat before switching sides.

banded-standing-marches.name: Banded Standing Marches
banded-standing-marches.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs above the knees, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
banded-standing-marches.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward your chest against the band resistance while maintaining balance on the standing leg. Lower back down and alternate legs in a marching motion.

supine-shoulder-rotation.name: Supine Shoulder Rotation
supine-shoulder-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your shoulder abducted 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing toward the ceiling. Keep your shoulder blade flat against the surface.
supine-shoulder-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your forearm toward the floor in an internal rotation, only going as far as is comfortable without pain. Return to start and repeat.

standing-scapular-squeeze.name: Standing Scapular Squeeze
standing-scapular-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides with palms facing forward. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed and chest open.
standing-scapular-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down toward your back pockets, creating tension in the upper back. Hold briefly, then relax and repeat.

side-lying-external-rotation.name: Side-Lying External Rotation
side-lying-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with your shoulder abducted 45 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Your forearm rests across your body with a neutral wrist.
side-lying-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm upward away from your body, creating external rotation at the shoulder. Return slowly to the starting position and repeat.

prone-shoulder-horizontal-abduction.name: Prone Shoulder Horizontal Abduction
prone-shoulder-horizontal-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bed with your arm hanging off the edge at about 90 degrees of abduction. Your head rests on the surface with neck in neutral.
prone-shoulder-horizontal-abduction.endPoseDescription: Raise your arm outward and slightly backward to shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blade. Lower back down with control and repeat.

standing-chest-doorway-stretch.name: Standing Chest Doorway Stretch
standing-chest-doorway-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with one arm raised and forearm against the door frame, elbow at 90 degrees. Step forward slightly with the opposite leg.
standing-chest-doorway-stretch.endPoseDescription: Lean your body forward through the doorway, feeling a stretch across your chest and front shoulder. Hold the stretch while maintaining upright posture.

single-leg-deadlift.name: Single Leg Deadlift
single-leg-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand. Keep your core engaged and your standing leg straight but not locked.
single-leg-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hip, extending your free leg behind you for balance while lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Your torso should be nearly parallel to the ground with your standing leg remaining stable.

goblet-squat.name: Goblet Squat
goblet-squat.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest level with both hands. Your spine is neutral and shoulders are back.
goblet-squat.endPoseDescription: Lower your hips down and back by bending your knees, keeping the dumbbell at chest height and your torso upright. Your knees track over your toes as you descend to a comfortable depth.

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
bulgarian-split-squat.startPoseDescription: Position yourself facing away from a bench with one foot elevated behind you and the other foot forward, holding dumbbells at your sides. Your front knee should be slightly bent.
bulgarian-split-squat.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending your front knee until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Keep your torso upright and front knee tracking over your toes.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
single-leg-romanian-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand with a slight knee bend. Your standing leg is engaged and your core is tight.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hip while keeping your back leg extended behind you for balance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Your torso remains in line with your extended leg.

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase Carry
suitcase-carry.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side with a neutral spine. Your shoulders are level and your core is engaged.
suitcase-carry.endPoseDescription: Walk forward maintaining an upright posture and level shoulders while resisting the lateral pull of the dumbbell. Your core remains tight throughout the movement to prevent spinal rotation.

step-up-dumbbell.name: Step-Up with Dumbbell
step-up-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a bench or elevated platform holding dumbbells at your sides with your core engaged. Your posture is upright and your feet are hip-width apart.
step-up-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the platform with one leg, driving through that heel to stand tall at the top. Your trailing leg extends behind you or steps up to meet the platform.

dumbbell-floor-press.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
dumbbell-floor-press.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the ground, holding dumbbells at chest height with elbows at 90 degrees. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
dumbbell-floor-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells upward and slightly together until your arms are extended above your chest. Your lower back remains in contact with the floor throughout the movement.

progressive-muscle-relaxation.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
progressive-muscle-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides, palms facing up. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
progressive-muscle-relaxation.endPoseDescription: Systematically tense each muscle group for 5 seconds, then release and relax for 10 seconds, moving from toes to head. Feel the tension melting away as you progress through your entire body.

supine-spinal-twist.name: Supine Spinal Twist
supine-spinal-twist.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with arms extended out to the sides in a T position. Bend your right knee and bring it toward your chest.
supine-spinal-twist.endPoseDescription: Drop your right knee across your body toward the left side while keeping your shoulders flat on the ground. Hold this gentle twist and feel the stretch along your back and spine.

deep-breathing-body-scan.name: Deep Breathing with Body Scan
deep-breathing-body-scan.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back on a comfortable surface with legs extended and arms slightly away from your body, palms facing up. Close your eyes and allow your shoulders to relax down and away from your ears.
deep-breathing-body-scan.endPoseDescription: Take slow, deep breaths in through your nose for a count of 4, hold for 4, and exhale for 6 counts. Mentally scan from your head to toes, releasing tension with each exhale.

diaphragmatic-breathing-with-band.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing with Band
diaphragmatic-breathing-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band loosely around your torso at chest level with both hands.
diaphragmatic-breathing-with-band.endPoseDescription: Inhale deeply while gently pressing the band outward with your chest expansion, allowing your belly to expand naturally. Exhale slowly while relaxing the band tension.

shoulder-rolls-with-band.name: Shoulder Rolls with Band Resistance
shoulder-rolls-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at shoulder height with both hands in front of you. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
shoulder-rolls-with-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly roll your shoulders backward in a controlled circular motion while maintaining light tension on the band. Complete the full rotation and return to the starting position.

assisted-cat-cow-stretch.name: Assisted Cat-Cow Stretch
assisted-cat-cow-stretch.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your back and holding both ends in your hands. Your spine should be in a neutral position.
assisted-cat-cow-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band to assist as you round your spine, tucking your chin toward your chest in the cat position. Then release and arch your back slightly with your gaze upward in the cow position.

standing-torso-rotation-with-band.name: Standing Torso Rotation with Band
standing-torso-rotation-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands extended in front of you. Engage your core and keep your hips still.
standing-torso-rotation-with-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your torso to one side, pulling the band across your body while keeping your arms at chest level. Hold briefly and return to center, then rotate to the opposite side.

hip-flexor-stretch-with-band.name: Hip Flexor Stretch with Band Assist
hip-flexor-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge position, holding a resistance band around your back knee. Keep your torso upright.
hip-flexor-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band forward to deepen the hip flexor stretch on the back leg while maintaining an upright posture. Feel the stretch in the front of your hip and thigh.

gentle-spinal-twist.name: Gentle Spinal Twist
gentle-spinal-twist.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a light resistance band across your chest. Arms are extended out to the sides.
gentle-spinal-twist.endPoseDescription: Slowly drop both knees to one side while keeping your shoulders flat on the ground and using the band for light support. Feel a gentle twist through your spine and hold.

band-assisted-chest-opening.name: Band-Assisted Chest Opening
band-assisted-chest-opening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat, holding a resistance band behind your back at elbow height with both arms bent. Your chest is slightly rounded forward.
band-assisted-chest-opening.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band to open your chest and bring your shoulder blades together, extending your arms back slightly. Hold the stretch while taking slow, deep breaths.

band-pull-apart-posture.name: Band Pull-Apart for Posture
band-pull-apart-posture.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height holding a resistance band with both hands. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
band-pull-apart-posture.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return to the starting position with control.

seated-neck-rolls.name: Seated Neck Rolls
seated-neck-rolls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your back straight and look forward with a neutral head position.
seated-neck-rolls.endPoseDescription: Slowly drop your chin toward your chest in a controlled gentle motion. Feel a comfortable stretch along the back of your neck and upper shoulders.

supine-knee-to-chest-stretch.name: Supine Knee to Chest Stretch
supine-knee-to-chest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a padded surface with both legs extended and arms at your sides. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
supine-knee-to-chest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly pull one knee toward your chest using both hands while keeping the other leg extended on the floor. Hold gently to feel a stretch in the hip and lower back.

seated-marching-in-place.name: Seated Marching in Place
seated-marching-in-place.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms relaxed at your sides. Maintain good posture with your back against the chair.
seated-marching-in-place.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up toward your chest while keeping the other foot on the floor. Alternate legs in a marching motion at a comfortable, controlled pace.

supine-pelvic-tilts.name: Supine Pelvic Tilts
supine-pelvic-tilts.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. Keep arms at your sides with palms down on the floor.
supine-pelvic-tilts.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your pelvis to flatten your lower back against the floor by engaging your abdominal muscles. Hold briefly, then relax and return to neutral spine position.

seated-shoulder-rolls.name: Seated Shoulder Rolls
seated-shoulder-rolls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat and arms relaxed at your sides. Keep your back straight and look straight ahead.
seated-shoulder-rolls.endPoseDescription: Roll both shoulders backward in a smooth circular motion, then reverse direction. Perform the movement slowly and controlled to release tension.

quadruped-arm-and-leg-lifts.name: Quadruped Arm and Leg Lifts
quadruped-arm-and-leg-lifts.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core gently engaged.
quadruped-arm-and-leg-lifts.endPoseDescription: Slowly extend one arm forward and the opposite leg backward to hip height in a controlled manner. Return to starting position and alternate sides.

seated-figure-four-hip-stretch.name: Seated Figure Four Hip Stretch
seated-figure-four-hip-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and good posture. Keep your core gently engaged and shoulders relaxed.
seated-figure-four-hip-stretch.endPoseDescription: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure four shape, then gently lean forward from the hips. Feel a deep stretch in the outer hip of the crossed leg.

standing-wall-supported-marching.name: Standing Wall Supported Marching
standing-wall-supported-marching.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with feet about hip-width apart, hands lightly touching the wall for balance. Maintain upright posture with core engaged.
standing-wall-supported-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly march in place by lifting one knee toward hip height while keeping the other foot on the ground. Alternate legs in a controlled, gentle rhythm.

supine-glute-bridges.name: Supine Glute Bridges
supine-glute-bridges.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
supine-glute-bridges.endPoseDescription: Lift your hips off the floor by squeezing your glute muscles, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly back down.

seated-shoulder-raise.name: Seated Shoulder Raise
seated-shoulder-raise.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold dumbbells at your sides with arms hanging naturally.
seated-shoulder-raise.endPoseDescription: Raise dumbbells out to the sides until arms are at shoulder height. Keep a slight bend in elbows throughout the movement.

neck-shoulder-stretch.name: Neck and Shoulder Stretch
neck-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your back straight and shoulders relaxed. Keep your chin level and looking forward.
neck-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a stretch along the left side of your neck. Hold for 15-20 seconds, then repeat on the other side.

standing-bicep-curl.name: Standing Bicep Curl
standing-bicep-curl.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
standing-bicep-curl.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders while keeping elbows fixed at your sides. Lower weights in a controlled manner back to starting position.

dumbbell-lateral-step.name: Dumbbell Lateral Step
dumbbell-lateral-step.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding light dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
dumbbell-lateral-step.endPoseDescription: Step sideways to the right, keeping your chest up and core engaged. Return to center and repeat on the left side.

hand-wrist-circles.name: Gentle Hand and Wrist Circles
hand-wrist-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with arms extended in front of you at shoulder height with palms facing down. Keep your elbows straight but not locked.
hand-wrist-circles.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate both hands and wrists in full circles, creating smooth circular motions from the wrist joint. Continue rotating in one direction for 10 circles, then reverse.

shoulder-pendulum-swings.name: Shoulder Pendulum Swings
shoulder-pendulum-swings.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and let your affected arm hang naturally at your side. Lean slightly forward at the hips for support.
shoulder-pendulum-swings.endPoseDescription: Gently swing your arm forward and backward in a pendulum motion, allowing gravity to assist the movement. Gradually increase the range of motion without forcing it.

knee-extension-hold.name: Knee Extension and Hold
knee-extension-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit in a firm chair with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Keep your affected knee bent at approximately 90 degrees.
knee-extension-hold.endPoseDescription: Slowly straighten your leg by tightening the thigh muscle, lifting your foot slightly off the floor until your knee is fully extended. Hold for 3-5 seconds while maintaining the contraction.

hip-abduction-lying.name: Hip Abduction Lying
hip-abduction-lying.startPoseDescription: Lie on your unaffected side with your body in a straight line and hips stacked. Keep your head resting on your lower arm for comfort.
hip-abduction-lying.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your top leg toward the ceiling to about 45 degrees, keeping the leg straight and your core engaged. Lower the leg back down with control without letting it touch the bottom leg.

elbow-flexion-light-resistance.name: Elbow Flexion with Light Resistance
elbow-flexion-light-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair and hold a light dumbbell (1-3 lbs) in your affected hand with your arm at your side and palm facing forward. Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
elbow-flexion-light-resistance.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your forearm upward, bringing the weight toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary. Pause briefly at the top, then lower back down with control.

ankle-alphabet-tracing.name: Ankle Alphabet Tracing
ankle-alphabet-tracing.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair and extend one leg out in front of you or rest your foot on another chair. Keep your thigh supported and relaxed.
ankle-alphabet-tracing.endPoseDescription: Use your ankle and foot to trace the letters of the alphabet in the air as if writing on an invisible board. Move slowly and deliberately to maintain joint control throughout.

wall-pushups-modified.name: Wall Push-Ups Modified
wall-pushups-modified.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall at arm's length away with feet shoulder-width apart and palms placed flat against the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body straight from head to heels.
wall-pushups-modified.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and lean your body forward toward the wall in a controlled manner. Push back to the starting position, engaging your chest and shoulder muscles without straining your joints.

seated-hamstring-stretch.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
seated-hamstring-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair and extend one leg out in front of you with a slight knee bend while keeping the other foot flat on the floor. Maintain an upright posture with good spinal alignment.
seated-hamstring-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently hinge forward at the hips, reaching toward your extended leg while maintaining a neutral spine. Feel the stretch along the back of your thigh without bouncing or forcing the movement.

finger-dexterity-putty.name: Finger Dexterity Exercises with Putty
finger-dexterity-putty.startPoseDescription: Sit in a comfortable position and hold soft therapy putty in your hand with fingers relaxed and extended. The putty should be soft enough to manipulate without pain.
finger-dexterity-putty.endPoseDescription: Slowly squeeze, stretch, and manipulate the putty using different finger combinations, rolling it, pinching it, and pressing individual fingers into it. Work through various controlled movements for functional hand strength and joint protection.

banded-bicep-curl.name: Banded Bicep Curl
banded-bicep-curl.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet, holding one end in each hand with arms at your sides. Keep your elbows tucked close to your torso.
banded-bicep-curl.endPoseDescription: Curl both hands upward toward shoulders, bending at the elbows while keeping the band under tension. Lower back to the starting position with control.

banded-glute-bridge.name: Banded Glute Bridge
banded-glute-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down.
banded-glute-bridge.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while pushing outward against the band. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower back down with control.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

banded-row.name: Banded Row
banded-row.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and loop the resistance band around a stationary object at chest height or hold it in both hands. Extend your arms forward with elbows slightly bent.
banded-row.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together and bending your elbows. Return to the starting position with controlled movement.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

banded-overhead-press.name: Banded Overhead Press
banded-overhead-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet. Hold one end in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
banded-overhead-press.endPoseDescription: Press both arms overhead, extending the elbows fully while keeping the band taut. Lower back to shoulder height with controlled movement.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

banded-squat.name: Banded Squat
banded-squat.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet, holding one end in each hand at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
banded-squat.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees as if sitting back into a chair, maintaining tension in the band. Drive through your heels to return to standing.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

marching-in-place.name: Marching in Place
marching-in-place.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together, arms at your sides, and maintain good posture. Engage your core and prepare to lift your knees.
marching-in-place.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward your chest while swinging the opposite arm forward, then alternate sides in a marching rhythm. Maintain a steady pace and upright posture throughout.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

banded-standing-hip-abduction.name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
banded-standing-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and loop a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees. Place your hands on your hips or hold onto a wall for balance.
banded-standing-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Keep your torso stable and step one leg out to the side, creating tension in the band. Return to the starting position and repeat on the other leg.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

brisk-walking.name: Brisk Walking
brisk-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture with shoulders relaxed.
brisk-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk at a moderate to brisk pace with arms swinging naturally at 90-degree angles. Maintain an elevated heart rate while still being able to hold a conversation.

standing-arm-circles.name: Standing Arm Circles
standing-arm-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your chest open and core engaged throughout the movement.
standing-arm-circles.endPoseDescription: Make slow, controlled circular motions with your arms in both forward and backward directions. Complete circles at a steady pace while maintaining shoulder stability.

seated-torso-twist.name: Seated Torso Twist
seated-torso-twist.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and cross your arms over your chest. Maintain good posture with your spine neutral.
seated-torso-twist.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your torso to one side, twisting from the waist while keeping your hips stable. Hold briefly and return to center before repeating on the opposite side.
conditions_seen_in: chair-based exercises for limited mobility elderly

standing-quad-sets.name: Standing Quad Sets
standing-quad-sets.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding onto a sturdy surface for balance with feet hip-width apart. Keep one leg straight and slightly engaged while the other remains relaxed.
standing-quad-sets.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on the front of your thigh by straightening the leg and flexing the muscle. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds and release.

standing-balance-stance.name: Standing Balance Stance
standing-balance-stance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and arms extended in front of you or holding onto a stable surface. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
standing-balance-stance.endPoseDescription: Lift one foot slightly off the ground and balance on the other leg while maintaining steady posture. Keep your gaze fixed on a point ahead to improve balance.

pursed-lip-breathing-arm-raises.name: Pursed-Lip Breathing with Arm Raises
pursed-lip-breathing-arm-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Take a slow breath in through your nose for a count of 2.
pursed-lip-breathing-arm-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to shoulder height while exhaling slowly through pursed lips for a count of 4. Lower arms back down as you inhale.

dumbbell-overhead-press.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
dumbbell-overhead-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
dumbbell-overhead-press.endPoseDescription: Press dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner, extending arms fully without locking elbows. Return to shoulder height with controlled breathing.

dumbbell-bicep-curls-breathing.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls with Breathing
dumbbell-bicep-curls-breathing.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in each hand with arms hanging at your sides and palms facing forward. Maintain neutral spine.
dumbbell-bicep-curls-breathing.endPoseDescription: Curl dumbbells toward shoulders while exhaling, keeping elbows stationary at your sides. Lower dumbbells back down with controlled inhale.

walking-metronome-pacing.name: Walking with Metronome Pacing
walking-metronome-pacing.startPoseDescription: Stand upright in an open space, ready to walk at a comfortable pace. Focus on maintaining an even breathing rhythm synchronized with your steps.
walking-metronome-pacing.endPoseDescription: Walk forward at a steady, controlled pace while practicing pursed-lip breathing. Maintain upright posture and even stride length throughout.

seated-chest-stretch-breathing.name: Seated Chest Stretch with Breathing
seated-chest-stretch-breathing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor, hands clasped gently behind your head. Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows out to the sides.
seated-chest-stretch-breathing.endPoseDescription: Gently arch your back and open your chest while taking a deep breath in through your nose. Hold the stretch while exhaling slowly through pursed lips.

dumbbell-bent-over-rows.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Rows
dumbbell-bent-over-rows.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, slightly bend knees, and hinge at hips about 45 degrees. Hold dumbbells with straight arms hanging below shoulders.
dumbbell-bent-over-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull dumbbells up to ribcage level, squeezing shoulder blades together while exhaling. Lower dumbbells back down with controlled inhale.

diaphragmatic-breathing-supine.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing in Supine
diaphragmatic-breathing-supine.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place one hand on your chest and one on your abdomen.
diaphragmatic-breathing-supine.endPoseDescription: Breathe deeply through your nose, allowing your abdomen to expand while keeping chest relatively still. Exhale slowly through pursed lips, feeling abdomen fall.

standing-dumbbell-lateral-raises.name: Standing Dumbbell Lateral Raises
standing-dumbbell-lateral-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in hands at your sides with palms facing inward. Engage core and maintain neutral spine.
standing-dumbbell-lateral-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise dumbbells out to sides to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend while exhaling. Lower dumbbells back down with controlled inhale.

seated-marching-arm-movements.name: Seated Marching with Arm Movements
seated-marching-arm-movements.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor and dumbbells at your sides. Maintain good posture with shoulders back.
seated-marching-arm-movements.endPoseDescription: Lift knees alternately while swinging dumbbells in coordination with leg movements, maintaining steady breathing throughout the exercise.

quadriceps-sets-breathing-focus.name: Quadriceps Sets with Breathing Focus
quadriceps-sets-breathing-focus.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with legs extended, a small rolled towel under one knee. Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
quadriceps-sets-breathing-focus.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle of the bent knee, straightening the leg while exhaling. Hold briefly, then relax while inhaling, maintaining controlled breathing.

single-leg-stand.name: Single Leg Stand
single-leg-stand.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides or extended for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.
single-leg-stand.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to approximately 90 degrees. Maintain an upright posture and hold this position while keeping your standing leg stable.

tandem-stance.name: Tandem Stance
tandem-stance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or extended outward for balance. Keep your gaze fixed on a point at eye level.
tandem-stance.endPoseDescription: Position one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe alignment, as if walking a tightrope. Maintain an upright posture and hold this narrow stance.

sit-to-stand.name: Sit to Stand
sit-to-stand.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor positioned hip-width apart. Lean your torso slightly forward with hands either crossed on your chest or on the chair seat.
sit-to-stand.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels to stand up fully, extending your hips and knees to reach a standing position. Stand tall with good posture before returning to the seated position.

heel-raises.name: Heel Raises
heel-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a sturdy counter or wall for light balance support. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
heel-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as comfortable. Pause briefly at the top before lowering your heels back down.

tandem-walking.name: Tandem Walking
tandem-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright next to a wall or sturdy railing for light support. Position your feet in a heel-to-toe alignment as if walking a narrow line.
tandem-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly while maintaining the heel-to-toe position, keeping one foot nearly in front of the other. Continue walking along the wall support while maintaining balance.

clock-reach.name: Clock Reach
clock-reach.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg in the center of an imaginary clock face, lightly touching a wall or railing for balance. Keep your standing leg slightly bent and core engaged.
clock-reach.endPoseDescription: Reach your other leg out to different points around the clock (12, 3, 6, 9 o'clock positions) while maintaining single-leg balance. Return the reaching leg back to center before each new reach.

wall-push-ups.name: Wall Push-Ups
wall-push-ups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall at arm's length away with feet hip-width apart and hands placed on the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
wall-push-ups.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows to lower your body toward the wall while keeping your core engaged and body aligned. Push back to the starting position by straightening your arms.

banded-quadriceps-sets.name: Banded Quadriceps Sets
banded-quadriceps-sets.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your back supported and a small rolled towel placed under one knee. A resistance band is looped around that thigh for added resistance.
banded-quadriceps-sets.endPoseDescription: Tighten your thigh muscle and straighten your leg forward against the band resistance, squeezing the quadriceps at the top. Lower back down with control and repeat on both legs.

banded-standing-hip-extension.name: Banded Standing Hip Extension
banded-standing-hip-extension.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or rail with hands lightly resting on it for balance and a resistance band looped around both feet. Keep your standing leg straight and core tight.
banded-standing-hip-extension.endPoseDescription: Move one leg backward against the band resistance while maintaining an upright torso and avoiding excessive lower back arch. Squeeze your glutes at the back, then return to the starting position.

gentle-knee-flexion.name: Gentle Knee Flexion
gentle-knee-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back supported against the chair.
gentle-knee-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one foot off the ground by bending the knee, raising your shin toward your chest as far as comfortable. Hold briefly, then lower back down with control.

supine-hip-circles.name: Supine Hip Circles
supine-hip-circles.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a firm surface with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor. Keep the other leg extended or slightly bent for comfort.
supine-hip-circles.endPoseDescription: Draw slow, gentle circles with the bent knee, moving in a controlled circular motion. Keep movements small and pain-free, then reverse direction.

seated-hip-abduction.name: Seated Hip Abduction
seated-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Maintain an upright posture with good back support.
seated-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide one foot out to the side along the floor, opening the hip without twisting the torso. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

seated-ankle-circles.name: Seated Ankle Circles
seated-ankle-circles.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair and lift one foot slightly off the ground, keeping the knee bent at a comfortable angle. Rest your hands on your lap for balance.
seated-ankle-circles.endPoseDescription: Draw slow, controlled circles with your foot in the air, moving from the ankle joint. Complete circles in both directions, keeping the movement gentle and fluid.

seated-shoulder-press.name: Seated Shoulder Press
seated-shoulder-press.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your core engaged and back against the chair.
seated-shoulder-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion until arms are nearly fully extended. Hold briefly at the top before lowering back to shoulder height.

seated-bicep-curls.name: Seated Bicep Curls
seated-bicep-curls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, arms at sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Keep elbows stationary against your torso throughout the movement.
seated-bicep-curls.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells up toward shoulders by bending at the elbows, bringing weights to approximately shoulder height. Lower in a controlled manner back to the starting position.

seated-leg-extensions.name: Seated Leg Extensions
seated-leg-extensions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your back against the chair and core engaged.
seated-leg-extensions.endPoseDescription: Straighten one leg by extending at the knee until the leg is fully extended and parallel to the floor. Hold briefly, then lower back down with control and repeat on the other leg.

seated-chest-press.name: Seated Chest Press
seated-chest-press.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at chest level with elbows bent and palms facing forward. Keep your back against the chair for support.
seated-chest-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells forward away from your body until arms are nearly fully extended. Slowly return the weights to chest level in a controlled motion.

seated-tricep-extensions.name: Seated Tricep Extensions
seated-tricep-extensions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms bent at 90 degrees with the weight behind your head. Keep your elbows pointing forward and core tight.
seated-tricep-extensions.endPoseDescription: Extend your arms upward and forward, straightening at the elbows to lift the dumbbell overhead. Slowly lower the weight back behind your head with control.

seated-forward-fold-stretch.name: Seated Forward Fold Stretch
seated-forward-fold-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, legs extended in front of you or feet on the ground. Keep your spine straight and shoulders relaxed.
seated-forward-fold-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly fold forward at the hips, bringing your chest toward your thighs in a gentle stretch. Hold the stretch, feeling the elongation through your hamstrings and lower back.

tandem-stance-balance.name: Tandem Stance Balance
tandem-stance-balance.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides or extended for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.
tandem-stance-balance.endPoseDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, maintaining upright posture. Hold this position while keeping your gaze fixed on a focal point.

single-leg-stance.name: Single Leg Stance
single-leg-stance.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides or ready to use nearby support. Engage your core and maintain upright posture.
single-leg-stance.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to approximately 90 degrees. Keep your standing leg straight and arms out for balance if needed.

marching-high-knees.name: Marching in Place with High Knees
marching-high-knees.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees ready to swing. Maintain an engaged core and neutral spine.
marching-high-knees.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee toward chest height in a marching motion while swinging opposite arm forward. Alternate legs in a controlled, rhythmic pattern.

heel-toe-walking.name: Heel-Toe Walking
heel-toe-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and arms at sides or extended for balance. Look forward with good posture.
heel-toe-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk forward by landing on heels first and rolling through to toes with each step. Maintain slow, deliberate movements with controlled weight transfer.

seated-trunk-rotations.name: Seated Trunk Rotations
seated-trunk-rotations.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a bench with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
seated-trunk-rotations.endPoseDescription: Rotate your trunk to one side, keeping hips stable and facing forward. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side with controlled movement.

standing-hip-marches-wall.name: Standing Hip Marches with Wall Support
standing-hip-marches-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with hands lightly on it for balance, feet hip-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
standing-hip-marches-wall.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward hip height while maintaining upright posture. Lower the leg back down and repeat alternating sides in a controlled rhythm.

gait-training-walking.name: Gait Training with Walking Pattern Focus
gait-training-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with good posture, feet together, ready to walk forward. Focus on maintaining balance and awareness of body position.
gait-training-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly with deliberate steps, focusing on heel-strike, midstance, and toe-off phases. Maintain upright posture and consistent step length throughout.

sit-to-stand-practice.name: Sit to Stand Practice
sit-to-stand-practice.startPoseDescription: Sit on a sturdy chair or bench with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back against the backrest with hands on armrests if available.
sit-to-stand-practice.endPoseDescription: Lean forward slightly and push through your heels to stand up fully, extending hips and knees. Stand with good posture, then slowly lower back down to seated position.

resistance-band-wrist-extension.name: Resistance Band Wrist Extension
resistance-band-wrist-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected forearm resting on a table, palm facing downward. Hold a looped resistance band around your hand with light to moderate tension.
resistance-band-wrist-extension.endPoseDescription: Extend your wrist upward, lifting the back of your hand against the band resistance. Slowly lower back to the starting position with control.

resistance-band-finger-flexion.name: Resistance Band Finger Flexion
resistance-band-finger-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected hand relaxed in front of you, fingers extended. Loop a resistance band around your fingers with light tension.
resistance-band-finger-flexion.endPoseDescription: Curl your fingers inward, making a fist against the band resistance. Slowly release back to the extended position with controlled movement.

resistance-band-shoulder-abduction.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Abduction
resistance-band-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored under your feet. Your affected arm hangs at your side with the band in your hand.
resistance-band-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise your affected arm out to the side to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbow throughout. Lower back down with control.

resistance-band-elbow-flexion.name: Resistance Band Elbow Flexion
resistance-band-elbow-flexion.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your affected arm at your side, holding one end of a resistance band that is anchored under your feet. Your elbow should be slightly bent with palm facing forward.
resistance-band-elbow-flexion.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbow, bringing your hand up toward your shoulder against the band resistance. Slowly lower back to the starting position with controlled movement.

shoulder-flexor-stretch-band.name: Shoulder Flexor Stretch with Band
shoulder-flexor-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and hold a resistance band with both hands, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height. Keep your feet shoulder-width apart for stability.
shoulder-flexor-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your body while keeping your arms extended, feeling a stretch across your chest and front shoulders. Hold this comfortable stretch position.

heel-toe-raises.name: Heel-Toe Raises
heel-toe-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart near a wall or counter for light support. Keep your posture upright and hands available to lightly touch the support if needed.
heel-toe-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto your toes while keeping heels on the ground, then lower down and rock back onto your heels with toes lifted. Move in a slow, controlled rhythm.
conditions_seen_in: osteoporosis safe exercise program for 70 year old

tandem-standing.name: Tandem Standing
tandem-standing.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet together near a wall or sturdy support that you can hold if needed. Keep your posture upright and eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.
tandem-standing.endPoseDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, holding the stance for as long as safely possible. Maintain a tall posture and engaged core muscles.
