bicep-curls.name: Bicep Curls
bicep-curls.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged.
bicep-curls.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells up toward shoulders by bending at the elbows. Lower back to starting position with control.

goblet-squats.name: Goblet Squats
goblet-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
goblet-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower into a squat by bending at hips and knees, keeping weight in heels. Return to standing position by driving through heels.

seated-rows.name: Seated Rows
seated-rows.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at sides with arms extended forward. Maintain neutral spine alignment.
seated-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull dumbbells toward ribcage by bending elbows and retracting shoulder blades. Extend arms back to starting position with control.

tricep-extensions.name: Tricep Extensions
tricep-extensions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
tricep-extensions.endPoseDescription: Extend arms upward by straightening elbows until the dumbbell reaches overhead. Lower back to starting position with control.

standing-hip-abductions.name: Standing Hip Abductions
standing-hip-abductions.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Hold dumbbells at sides with arms straight.
standing-hip-abductions.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg out to the side while keeping it straight, raising it to hip height. Lower back to starting position and repeat on the other side.

quadriceps-stretches.name: Quadriceps Stretches
quadriceps-stretches.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and use a wall or chair for balance with one hand. Stand on one leg with good posture.
quadriceps-stretches.endPoseDescription: Bend the opposite knee and pull your foot toward your buttock using your hand, feeling a stretch on the front of the thigh. Keep knees aligned and avoid arching the back.

hip-abduction.name: Hip Abduction Exercises
hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with the bottom leg bent for support and the top leg straight and aligned with your body. Rest your head on your arm comfortably.
hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift the top leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight and externally rotated at the hip. Raise the leg to about 45 degrees and hold briefly before lowering.

patellar-tendon-strap.name: Patellar Tendon Strap Exercises
patellar-tendon-strap.startPoseDescription: Sit on a chair with one leg extended and a resistance band wrapped around the upper calf just below the knee. Keep good posture and core engaged.
patellar-tendon-strap.endPoseDescription: Extend the knee fully against the band resistance, tensioning the patellar tendon in a controlled manner. Hold the extended position and return slowly without fully relaxing the muscle.

supine-spinal-twist-stretch.name: Supine Spinal Twist Stretch
supine-spinal-twist-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms spread out to the sides in a T-position. Your spine should be neutral and relaxed against the floor.
supine-spinal-twist-stretch.endPoseDescription: Bend your right knee and bring it across your body toward the left side, allowing your torso and spine to twist gently. Keep your shoulders flat on the ground and look toward the right.

standing-lateral-band-walk.name: Standing Lateral Band Walk
standing-lateral-band-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Slightly bend your knees and lean forward with a neutral spine, maintaining tension in the band.
standing-lateral-band-walk.endPoseDescription: Step laterally to one side while maintaining tension in the band and keeping your torso upright. Take controlled steps sideways while the band remains taut, working your hip stabilizers.

prone-superman-hold.name: Prone Superman Hold
prone-superman-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on your stomach with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Your forehead rests on the floor in a neutral neck position.
prone-superman-hold.endPoseDescription: Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the ground simultaneously, creating a slight arch in your back. Hold this position while squeezing your back muscles and glutes.

seated-spinal-rotation-resistance-band.name: Seated Spinal Rotation with Resistance Band
seated-spinal-rotation-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band looped around a fixed point at chest height. Cross your arms over your chest while holding the band with tension.
seated-spinal-rotation-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso away from the anchor point, feeling a controlled stretch in your spine and obliques. Keep your hips stable and move only through your thoracic spine.

prone-y-t-w-raises-band.name: Prone Y-T-W Raises with Band
prone-y-t-w-raises-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with a resistance band underneath you and both ends held in your hands at shoulder level. Your forehead rests on the floor and core is engaged.
prone-y-t-w-raises-band.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms up and back against the band resistance, creating Y, T, and W shapes sequentially. Each position targets different back stabilizer muscles while maintaining a stable prone position.

standing-balance-hold.name: Standing Balance Hold
standing-balance-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with light fingertip contact on a chair or counter for light balance support if needed. Keep your eyes focused on a fixed point ahead of you.
standing-balance-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain your upright posture while gradually reducing hand support as balance improves. Try to stand independently with weight evenly distributed through both feet.

shin-stretch.name: Shin Stretch
shin-stretch.startPoseDescription: Kneel on a padded mat and sit your glutes back slightly toward your heels with the tops of your feet flat on the ground behind you. Keep your torso upright and place your hands behind you on the mat.
shin-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lean back on your hands while keeping your feet flat, creating a stretch across the front of your shins and tops of your feet. Only go as far back as comfort allows without pain.

dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat.startPoseDescription: Stand facing away from a bench or elevated surface with one foot elevated behind you on the bench, holding dumbbells at your sides. Your front leg is straight with feet positioned to allow for a deep lunge.
dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending your front knee until it reaches approximately 90 degrees, keeping your torso upright. Your back knee hovers just above the ground while dumbbells remain at your sides.

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with a slight bend in your knees. Your shoulders are back and your core is braced.
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hips, pushing your glutes backward while maintaining a neutral spine and slight knee bend. The dumbbells travel down the front of your legs until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.

single-leg-balance-dumbbell-hold.name: Single Leg Balance with Dumbbell Hold
single-leg-balance-dumbbell-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg. Your non-standing knee is lifted to hip height, creating an athletic stance.
single-leg-balance-dumbbell-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain the single-leg stance while keeping your standing knee slightly flexed and your core engaged. The dumbbell remains at your side as you balance without shifting weight or dropping the lifted knee.

dumbbell-step-up-knee-drive.name: Dumbbell Step-Up with Knee Drive
dumbbell-step-up-knee-drive.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a bench or step, holding dumbbells at your sides with your feet hip-width apart. Your posture is upright and you're positioned to step up onto the elevated surface.
dumbbell-step-up-knee-drive.endPoseDescription: Step up with one leg and drive the opposite knee up to hip height while standing tall on the bench. Your dumbbells remain at your sides as you complete the dynamic movement with control.

dumbbell-lateral-raise-single-leg.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise to Single Leg Stand
dumbbell-lateral-raise-single-leg.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms straight. Your non-standing leg is lightly touching the ground for light balance support if needed.
dumbbell-lateral-raise-single-leg.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to your sides to shoulder height while maintaining single-leg balance. Your core remains engaged and your standing knee stays slightly flexed throughout the movement.

external-rotation-resistance-band.name: External Rotation with Resistance Band
external-rotation-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your right elbow bent to 90 degrees against your side and a resistance band around your wrist. Your forearm points forward across your body.
external-rotation-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward against the band resistance, stopping when your forearm is perpendicular to your body. Slowly return to the starting position with controlled movement.

scapular-push-ups.name: Scapular Push-ups
scapular-push-ups.startPoseDescription: Position yourself in a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line. Keep your elbows locked and core engaged.
scapular-push-ups.endPoseDescription: Slightly depress your shoulder blades by dropping your chest a few inches without bending your elbows. Return to the starting position by retracting your scapulae upward.

quadruped-shoulder-rocks.name: Quadruped Shoulder Rocks
quadruped-shoulder-rocks.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-shoulder-rocks.endPoseDescription: Rock your hips backward toward your heels while keeping your arms extended, feeling the stretch through your shoulders and chest. Return to center and repeat the gentle rocking motion.

planks-with-shoulder-taps.name: Planks with Shoulder Taps
planks-with-shoulder-taps.startPoseDescription: Hold a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders, body in a straight line, and core fully engaged. Keep your hips stable and avoid rotating.
planks-with-shoulder-taps.endPoseDescription: Tap your right hand to your left shoulder while maintaining plank position, then return and tap your left hand to your right shoulder. Alternate sides in a controlled manner.

band-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Band-Resisted Shoulder External Rotation
band-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at elbow height with your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your side. Your forearm is positioned across your body horizontally.
band-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward away from your body against band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at your side. Your forearm moves to approximately 45-90 degrees from the starting position.

glute-bridge-band-loop.name: Glute Bridge with Band Loop
glute-bridge-band-loop.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Your arms are at your sides with palms down for stability.
glute-bridge-band-loop.endPoseDescription: Drive your hips upward toward the ceiling, engaging your glutes and maintaining outward pressure against the band with your knees. Your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders at the peak.

calf-stretch-band-assist.name: Calf Stretch with Band Assist
calf-stretch-band-assist.startPoseDescription: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you, placing a resistance band around the ball of one foot while holding the band's ends. Your back is upright and your other leg is relaxed.
calf-stretch-band-assist.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your body, bringing your toes and ball of the foot back toward your shin in a dorsiflexed position. You should feel a stretch along the calf and Achilles tendon of the working leg.

quadruped-hip-circles-band.name: Quadruped Hip Circles with Band
quadruped-hip-circles-band.startPoseDescription: Begin on your hands and knees with a resistance band looped around one knee, positioned on your forearms for added support. Your hips are directly over your knees and your core is braced.
quadruped-hip-circles-band.endPoseDescription: Lift the banded knee and make slow, controlled circles with it while maintaining tension in the band and stability in your core. Your supporting arm and leg remain stationary throughout the circular motion.

banded-monster-walk.name: Banded Monster Walk
banded-monster-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees, feet shoulder-width apart, and hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. Maintain a quarter-squat position with a slight forward lean.
banded-monster-walk.endPoseDescription: Take a large diagonal step forward and to one side, then bring the opposite leg to follow, creating a forward diagonal walking pattern. Maintain outward pressure on the band and the quarter-squat position throughout the movement.

prone-shoulder-flexion-band.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion with Band
prone-shoulder-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a table with your arms hanging off the edge, holding a resistance band in both hands with your arms at your sides. Your forehead rests on a small towel and your core is engaged.
prone-shoulder-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms up and forward against band resistance until they reach shoulder height or slightly above, maintaining a neutral spine. Your shoulders are engaged and your core remains braced throughout the movement.
